items.name: 人类
items.expectedDescription: Humans are known for their ability to adapt and thrive in the most challenging situations, including the mysterious loss of their home world, Golarion. Ambitious, creative, and endlessly curious, humans maintain a robust presence in the galaxy, often taking on positions of leadership or acting at the forefront of exploration. Humans can be found almost anywhere, doing almost anything.
items.description: 人类以在最严峻的处境中适应并繁荣的能力闻名，即使母星格拉利昂神秘失落也不例外。人类野心勃勃、富于创造力且永远充满好奇心，在星系中占据稳固地位，经常担任领导者或站在探索的最前沿。几乎在任何地方，都能找到从事几乎任何事情的人类。

items.name: 多才人类
items.expectedDescription: Humans were the most common ancestry on Golarion before that world disappeared, and they've since spread to the stars thanks to their versatility. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites (as with your ancestry feat, you can select this general feat at any point during character creation).
items.description: 格拉利昂消失之前，人类是这个世界最常见的族裔。此后，他们凭借多才多艺的天性遍布群星。选择一项你满足先决条件的通用专长。与你的族裔专长一样，你可以在创建角色的任意阶段选择这项通用专长。

items.name: 轻羽步
items.expectedDescription: You step carefully and quickly. You can Step into difficult terrain.
items.description: 你的步伐谨慎而迅捷。你可以用快步进入困难地形。

items.name: 诈骗者
items.expectedDescription:
You're a con artist and trickster who swindles unsuspecting dupes and blackmails rubes, but it's nothing personal—you're just in it for the credits. You might run an operation on the side, or you might spend your career moving from settlement to settlement until you get caught in the act.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Deception skill and a Lore skill related to a profession or subject you fake expertise in. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat.
items.description:
你是个诈骗高手，专门坑骗毫无戒心的冤大头，甚至敲诈那些容易上当的人——但这并非针对个人，你只是为了钱。你可能一边经营着自己的骗局，也可能四处流窜作案，直到被抓个正着。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是智力或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的欺骗技能和与你伪装专业知识相关的学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]（Charming Liar）技能专长。

items.name: 蛊惑人心
items.expectedDescription: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.
items.description: 凭借魅力，你能够将欺骗对象笼络为你的支持者。当你用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}动作取得大成功时，目标对你的态度改善一级，如同你用交涉技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}成功。每次交流，这个效果只会生效一次，如果你用相同结果对多个目标取得大成功，则选择一个生物的态度得到改善。你的谎言必须要透露看似重要的信息、鼓吹自己的地位、或巴结奉承对方，无关紧要的谎言无法起到作用。

items.name: 织维巫师
items.expectedDescription: A strange paradoxical event forever altered your existence, and now you can manipulate reality. You explore the infinite possibilities of the multiverse, possibly visualizing variant timelines or parallel worlds. You create fields that subvert space and time, allowing you to cast powerful magic. You've learned to focus on an anchoring memory, concept, or object to help you identify reality.
items.description: 一场奇异的悖论事件永久改变了你的存在，如今你可以操纵现实。你探索多元宇宙的无限可能，或许还能看到不同的时间线或平行世界。你创造颠覆时空的场域，借此施展强大的魔法。你已学会专注于一段作为锚点的记忆、一个概念或一件物品，以帮助自己辨识现实。

items.name: 悖论
items.expectedDescription:
Your existence is contrary to the status quo of the universe, causing quantum ripples that empower your spellcasting talent and open doorways to other worlds. Perhaps you're from an alternate reality or a different timeline, or perhaps you experienced an unnatural phenomenon that altered your path, discovered a time-glitching alien device, or wrote a treatise on quantum magical theory. Whatever your story, you've become a living paradox.

At 1st level, choose your paradox. Your chosen paradox determines the tradition of your spells, additional trained skills, additional spells you learn, and the effects of your quantum field. You also gain Focus Points and special focus spells called warp spells based on your paradox.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.42tQJXhySw9QKcn6]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.hFIB6wlYGK93zl4g]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1E12XmyqzIK1jXrY]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.cxBVbSITniNRwfMi]
items.description:
你的存在本质有别于当下的宇宙，这种异常激发的量子涟漪正是你施法能力的源泉，为你开启通往崭新世界的道路。你可能来自被覆写的现实或是不同的时间线，也可能你接触了足以改变你命运的现象，发现了干涉时间的异星设备，或是发表了一篇关于量子魔法论的论文。不论你经历如何，你已经成为了活着的悖论。

在1级，选择你的悖论，其决定了你的施法根源、学习的额外法术、额外的受训技能，以及你量子场域中的效应。你也会获得聚能点和被称为曲织法术（warp spell）的聚能法术，其基于你的悖论。

items.name: 量子场域
items.expectedDescription:
You can draw on paradoxical forces to create a reality-warping quantum field. It might manifest as a haze in the air that shows shimmers of alternate realities, appear as walls of glowing magical equations, or any other display you choose. The effects of your quantum field are determined by your paradox. You can further enhance and manipulate your quantum field through your witchwarper feat selections and by casting warp spells. You can activate or extend the duration of your quantum field by using reality-warping magic.

You have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0] action, which lets you activate your quantum field. This action gains the arcane or occult trait based on the tradition of your selected paradox. You also have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ], which lets you establish your quantum field quickly at the start of combat.
items.description:
你可以借由彼此矛盾的力量创造出一片曲织现实的量子场域。这可能具现为弥漫在空气中的薄雾，不同现实在其中闪烁，也可能表现为写满晦涩魔法方程的墙体，或是你选择的任何形式。量子场域的效果由你的悖论决定。你可以通过织维巫师专长或者施放曲织法术来进一步增强和操控你的量子场域。你可以用曲织现实的魔力来激活你的量子场域或者延长其持续时间。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]动作，其允许你激活你的量子场域。这一动作会根据你悖论决定的施法根源相应获得奥术或异能特征。此外，你还获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.30Nw5q4vWKCQIBIZ]动作，可以在遭遇开始时快速激活量子场域。

items.name: 锚点
items.expectedDescription:
Whatever paradox altered the course of your existence, something helps keep you anchored to reality. This might be a physical object you carry, memories of your home, or loved ones. At 1st level, select an anchor.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.ENxkQJEIkz35yuMT]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.idjill6Zh7b3SLqE]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.Z1sThY5XgXiXQBIy]
items.description:
不论悖论如何改变了你的存在，仍有某些存在将你锚定在现实中。这可能是随身携带的实物，可能是你对家乡或所爱的记忆。在1级，选择一个锚点。

你的存在本身便是一个异常值，有违当下现实的正常参数。你或许遭遇了某种存在扰乱了你的核心存在，抑或你自另一个现实穿越面纱而来。

items.name: 曲织现实
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Your quantum field isn't active.

Your quantum field activates and lasts as long as you Sustain it (up to 10 minutes) or until the end of your next turn. Your quantum field is a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] centered on a point you choose within 100 feet. While your quantum field is active, you can use actions that have the anchoring trait. Your quantum field's other specific effects are determined by your paradox. Choose whether any given creature in the area is affected by your quantum field when you Warp Reality, each time you Sustain it, and when a creature enters your quantum field. Each time you Sustain a quantum field with the Sustain action (instead of an anchoring action), you can move it to a new position within 100 feet.

Your quantum field automatically deactivates if you're knocked out, if you Dismiss it, or if you move more than 100 feet away from it.
items.description:
需求 你的量子场域未激活。

你的量子场域激活，持续到你的下个回合结束，或者你可以维持其至多10分钟。你的量子场域是一个中心在你100尺内的@Template[type:burst|distance:20]区域。当你的量子场域被激活，你可以使用具有锚定特征的动作。你的量子场域的其他效果由你的悖论决定。当你使用曲织现实动作、每次你维持量子场域或一个生物进入你的量子场域时，你可以选择区域中的任何生物是否受到量子场域影响。每当你维持量子场域时（但不包括使用具有锚定特征的动作），你可以将它移动到100尺内一个新的位置。

你的量子场域会在你被击败、你将之解消、或者你移动远离其100尺以上时自动消散。

items.name: 量子脉冲
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You roll initiative.

You're always ready to let loose with your paradoxical abilities, and when imperiled, you instinctively release a pulse of quantum energy. As combat begins, you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0].
items.description:
触发 你骰先攻。

你随时准备好施放你的矛盾力量，危急时刻只需思绪一动便能创造场域。在战斗开始时，你使用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.ZoMpqQgDdlT13Jp0]动作。

items.name: 真切物件
items.expectedDescription:
A small object, usually something you wear or can hold with one appendage, gives you comfort. It might be a trinket or article of clothing with sentimental value, a gadget to fidget with, or perhaps it just has a texture you find pleasing.

Anchor Benefit The presence or weight of your chosen object helps ground you in this reality. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and Will saves against illusions and holograms.

Anchoring Effect Reduce your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition by 1. If you aren't frightened, you instead gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects and a +2 circumstance bonus to your Will DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} you until the start of your next turn. You can only benefit from this once per round.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.nvB1852vEPVqjxhR]
items.description:
一件小小的物品，通常是你穿戴或可以用一条肢体持握的物品，能够让你感到舒心。它可能是一件具有情感价值的小饰品或者衣物，一个可以摆弄的小玩意，又或者可能只是有着你觉得舒适的质地。

锚点增益你所选物品的存在或重量能够帮助你面对现实。你在对抗幻术或全息影像的察觉检定和意志豁免上获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 织维巫师施法
items.expectedDescription:
Your paradox grants you magical power. You can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a witchwarper, when you cast spells, you might describe your revelations about other realities aloud, accompanied by elegant gestures while arcane equations or occult symbols blaze around you.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a witchwarper, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Charisma or Intelligence modifier, depending on which you chose for your key attribute.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank, heightening it to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is always automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of witchwarper spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level witchwarper, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.

Warp Spells

You can create powerful magical phenomena known as warp spells. Warp spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a warp spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to contemplate infinite worlds or conduct quantum magical research.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.

Warp spells have the anchoring trait, unlike other focus spells. This trait means you can only use warp spells while your quantum field is active, and you automatically Sustain your quantum field when you cast warp spells.

You learn warp spells based on your paradox.
items.description:
你的悖论赋予了你魔法力量。你可以用施放法术行动来施法。作为织维巫师，当你施法时，你可能会大声描述关于其他现实的启示，兼有优雅的手势，而神秘符号或者奥法方程在你身周闪烁。

你每日最多可以施放三个1环法术。在施放法术前你必须已知这些法术，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习法术。你每日可以施放的法术数量被称为法术位。

随着你织维巫师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如下表所示。

你的某些法术需要你尝试一次法术攻击掷骰来确认法术的起效程度，或是迫使你的敌人投骰来对抗法术DC（通常是尝试一次豁免骰）。你的法术攻击骰和法术DC取决于你选择的关键属性以智力或魅力作为调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整，这通常等于你拥有的织维巫师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级织维巫师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级织维巫师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

曲织法术

你可以创造被称为曲织法术的强大魔法现象。曲织法术是一种聚能法术。施放一个曲织法术需要花费1聚能点，而你初始拥有一个含有1聚能点的聚能池。每日准备期间，你会将聚能池补满；你也可以花费10分钟使用重新聚能活动，沉思无穷世界或进行量子魔法研究，以恢复1聚能点。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你的等级的一半，向上取整，类似戏法一般。聚能法术不需要法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。选取专长能够给予你更多聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，但你的聚能池拥有不能超过3点聚能点。

与其他聚能法术不同，曲织法术具有锚定特征。此特征意味着你只能在量子场域生效期间使用曲织法术，且施放曲织法术时，你会自动维持量子场域。

你学习的曲织法术基于你的悖论。

items.name: 战斗手套
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These durable gloves fit over a wielder's hands (or other appendages) and feature weighted plates or spikes over the knuckles.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些耐用手套套在持用者的手上（或其他附肢上），指节处装有配重甲板或尖刺。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 普通容器
items.expectedDescription: Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.
items.description: 容器包含背包，公文箱，行李袋或是手提袋。一个容器最多可容纳4B物品且前2B不计入你的负载。如果你抓着容器或存放容器而非将其穿戴在个人身上，其将有L的负载而非可以忽略不计。

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
items.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球连结到该生物，使光球在该生物附近悬浮，并随其移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。若你已经有4个光亮术生效时施放此法术，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。

items.name: 移变激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]
items.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量，暂时改变目标武器造成的伤害类型。使用该武器的下一次打击会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、音波中由你选择的一种伤害类型，并且额外造成1d6伤害，类型为武器正常的伤害类型。

升阶（+2）额外伤害增加1d6。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]

items.name: 雷击术
items.expectedDescription:
You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.
items.description:
你呼唤一道伴随着雷鸣之声的闪电，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，基础反射豁免。穿戴金属护甲或者由金属构成的生物在豁免中承受-1环境减值，若它们受到该法术的伤害，会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击以及1d4点音波。

items.name: 曲织地形
items.expectedDescription:
You materialize terrain features from another reality within your quantum field. Choose one of the following effects, which lasts as long as your quantum field remains active, until you cast warp terrain again, or until you dismiss this spell.

  • You cause the area of your quantum field to become difficult terrain. You determine the appearance of the warped terrain. You and your allies can move through the warped terrain normally and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} using its features.
  • You suppress terrain in your field, turning any existing difficult or greater difficult terrain in your quantum field to normal terrain. This does not apply to effects that cause a creature to count squares as difficult terrain (such as a solarian's graviton-attunement attacks). If you're attempting to suppress terrain created by a spell or other magical effect, you must successfully counteract the effect.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the quantum field fill with fog, smoke, or another phenomenon that obscures vision. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}. You can instead suppress one of these effects within your quantum field.

Heightened (6th) You can choose to have the quantum field become greater difficult terrain, or suppress greater difficult terrain.
items.description:
你自另一现实中具现覆写量子场域中的地形特征。从以下效果中选择一项，只要你的量子场域保持激活，它就会一直持续，直到你再次施放曲织地形或者将其解消：

  • 你使量子场域中变为困难地形。你可以决定曲织地形的外观。你和你的盟友可以正常通过曲织地形，并可以利用其地形特征来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]
  • 你抚平场域中的地形，将其中存在的任何困难地形或高等困难地形变为普通地形。这不适用于那些令一个生物将方格视为困难地形的效果（例如恒星武士的引力子调谐攻击）。如果你试图抚平由法术制造的地形或其他魔法效果，你必须成功反制这些效果。

升阶（3环）你可以选择令量子场域中填满雾气、烟尘或其他阻碍视觉的现象。这一效果等同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]。你也可以转而尝试反制量子场域中的一个类似效果。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 舒适营房
items.expectedDescription:
You shape a shack 20 feet on each side and 10 feet high. This shack has the structure trait and the same restrictions as magic items that create structures. The walls of the cottage are simple and metal, with small, metal shuttered windows, and it has one metal door. It doesn't include its own lock, but it has a fastener to which a lock can be applied.

The interior contains three cots, one toilet, and a small stove powered by magic. The interior is lit with a small magical light that you can light or extinguish at will using a Sustain action. The climate inside the shack is comfortable and allows creatures inside it to withstand most hostile weather conditions, but incredible heat or cold, powerful storms, and winds of hurricane force or greater destroy the cottage. Other creatures can freely enter and exit the shack without damaging it, but if you exit the shack, the spell ends. You can Dismiss the spell.
items.description:
你创造一个每边20尺长，高10尺的简易营房。这个营房具有构造物特征，并且具有和创造建筑物的魔法物品相同的限制。营房有结构简单的金属结构，配有金属百叶窗和一道金属门（无内置锁具，但留有挂锁接口）。

内饰包含三张帆布床，一个厕所，一个小型魔法炉灶。营房内部由一个小型魔法灯照亮，你可以使用一个维持动作点亮或者或者熄灭它。营房内的气温十分舒适，其中的生物能够承受多数恶劣天气状况，但是酷热或者酷寒、猛烈的风暴、以及飓风的风力会摧毁营房。其他生物可以自由进出营房，且不会损伤到它，但如果你离开了营房，该法术结束。你可以解消该法术。

items.name: 加速术
items.expectedDescription:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}
items.description:
魔法强化了目标，令其行动迅速。它获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{迅捷}状态，并且每轮只能将额外动作用于打击或行走。

升阶（7环阶） 你能以至多6个生物为目标。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{法术效果：加速术}

items.name: 闪电束
items.expectedDescription:
A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing 4d12 electricity damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
items.description:
一束闪电从你手中绽放而出，造成4d12电击伤害。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d12。

items.name: 机智应变
items.expectedDescription: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{Untrained Improvisation} general feat. In addition, you can attempt skill actions that normally require you to be trained, even if you are untrained.
items.description: 你学会了该如何处理那些超出你能力范围的情况。你获得了@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.9jGaBxLUtevZYcZO]{即兴发挥}通用专长。此外，哪怕你在技能上的熟练度为未受训，你也可以尝试那些通常需要你具备受训熟练度才能进行的技能动作。

items.name: 即兴发挥
items.expectedDescription: You've learned how to handle situations when you're out of your depth. Your proficiency bonus to untrained skill checks is equal to your level –2. This improves to your level –1 at 5th level and your full level at 7th level. This doesn't allow you to use the skill's trained actions.
items.description: 你学会了如何处理超出自己能力范围的状况。你在未受训技能检定上的熟练度加值等于你的等级-2。达到5级后，熟练度加值变为你的等级-1，达到7级后，等于你的完整等级。本专长不会让你能够使用技能的受训动作。

items.name: 量子循环
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You cast a 2nd-rank or higher spell, and the spell targets a creature or area within your quantum field.

You expertly manipulate the effects of your quantum field to ensure that some of the energy from your spell is preserved and can be harnessed again. You regain an expended spell slot one spell rank lower than the triggering spell.
items.description:
频率每天一次

触发你施放一个2环或更高的法术指定处在量子场域内的一个生物或区域为目标。

你娴熟地操纵量子场域效应，以确保法术的部分能量被保留回收，可供再次利用。你重获一个比触发法术低一环的额外法术位。

items.name: 偏爱伪装
items.expectedDescription: You create a favored disguise that you can call upon at a moment's notice. When you Impersonate, you can decide that the disguise becomes your favored disguise. If you have a holoskin or can Change Shape, you can always adopt your favored disguise when Impersonating. You still roll Deception for the Impersonate check but count any critical failure results as failures instead. You can have one favored disguise and gain an additional favored disguise you can employ at expert, master, and legendary proficiency in Deception.
items.description: 你可以创造一个随时可调用的偏爱伪装。当你进行乔装（Impersonate）时，可选择将该伪装设置为偏爱伪装。如果你有全息皮肤（holoskin）或能够变形（Change Shape），你可以在乔装时总是采用偏爱伪装。你仍需为乔装进行欺骗检定，但将任何大失败结果改为失败。你初始拥有一套偏爱伪装，并在欺骗达到专家、大师和传奇熟练度时，各获得额外一套可用的偏爱伪装。

items.name: 趴爪族
items.expectedDescription: Pahtras are a humanoid feline species from a nearby star system. They're highly competitive and known for their achievements in magic, music, and war. Their home world was recently freed from the Veskarium's occupation, and they've joined the Pact Worlds.
items.description: 趴爪族是来自邻近恒星系的猫科类人生物。他们好胜心强，以魔法、音乐与战争领域的成就闻名。他们的母星最近摆脱了维斯卡里姆的占领，加入了协约世界。

items.name: 梅耶尔选民趴爪
items.expectedDescription: You have an undeniable streak of luck that you believe is a blessing from your ancestral god Meyel. You might come from a long line of mystics. Perhaps you were born at a holy site on Pulonis, or you reached out in fervent prayer at a time of crisis. Most of Meyel's chosen can point to at least one past event when their goddess might have intervened to save them from death or some other awful fate. Whether metaphorically or literally, you always seem to land on your feet. The first time each day that you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll the saving throw as a free action; this is a fortune effect.
items.description: 你有一股无法否认的好运气，你相信这是来自先祖之神梅耶尔的祝福。你可能出身于秘术师世家，可能出生在普洛尼斯上的一个圣地，也可能只是在危机时刻虔诚地祈祷。大多数梅耶尔的选民至少都能说出一件往事，那就是他们的女神曾经出手将他们从死亡或其他可怕的命运中拯救出来。无论是比喻义上还是字面意义上，你似乎总能“站稳脚跟”。每天第一次在豁免检定中大失败时，你可以使用一个自由动作立即重新进行一次豁免检定；这是一个幸运效果。

items.name: 偶像
items.expectedDescription:
Everybody wants their 15 minutes of fame, but for you, it's somehow become a lifestyle. Whether by luck or dedication, you're a star performer, celebrity, or popular influencer. Your face, voice, and style are commodities across known space, but for every adoring fan, there's a hater spreading gossip or paparazzi looking to capture your flaws.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.
items.description:
人人都想出名15分钟，但对你来说，这似乎已成为一种生活方式。无论是运气还是努力，你是一个出色的表演者、名人或受欢迎的影响者。你的面容、声音和风格是整个已知空间的商品，虽然崇拜你的粉丝很多，但是传播流言蜚语的黑粉以及试图挖你黑料的狗仔也同样多。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是体质或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的表演技能和媒体学识（Media Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]（Impressive Performance）技能专长。

items.name: 动人表演
items.expectedDescription: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
items.description: 你的表演令人钦佩，为你赢得粉丝。你可以使用表演代替交涉来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}。如果你在观众面前表演至少10分钟，就可以对完整观看了整场表演的至多10名观众建立印象，而不承受通常的减值。表演持续1小时时，目标数量增加至20名；持续2小时时，增加至50名。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.
items.description: 你是传导宇宙星辰之力的媒介——一名恒星骑士。引力与光代表这些力量的两极，而你可以在二者之间调整自身的调谐。作为这一循环的代行者，你显现出一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱恒星光谱的哪一极，你都可以在二者之间改变调谐，运用通过冥想和练习获得的恒星之力。

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]

items.name: 星辰调谐
items.expectedDescription:
As a solarian, your existence cycles between the aspects of stars. You begin with two aspects: photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) and graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity). At any time, you're considered graviton-attuned, photon-attuned, or unattuned. Many of your abilities have additional effects based on your current attunement, and some abilities swap your current state of attunement to another state.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] action.
items.description:
作为一名恒星武士，星辰面相间的循环决定了你的存在。你初始拥有两种面相：光量子（photon，星辰散发出热量、光以及等离子体的力量）或引力子（graviton，星辰通过引力吸引和束缚物体的力量）。在任何情况下，你都处在引力子调谐、光量子调谐、或未调谐三种情况之一。你的许多能力都会根据你的当前调谐产生额外的效果，而有些能力则会将你的当前调谐转变成另一种情况。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]动作。

items.name: 光晕涌动
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your nimbus surges with energy, forcing an opening in your foe's defenses. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Graviton-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.

Photon-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.
items.description:

items.expectedDescription:
You spend 10 minutes focusing on the composition of your solar weapon. You can change your solar weapon's damage type (typically choosing between bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), selected traits, and weapon group. Your weapon maintains your selections until the next time you Re-Forge Solar Weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 实光套装
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.
items.description:

固定在腰带或翻领上的投影器，用这层闪耀的硬光外壳包裹穿戴者的身体。军用制式硬光护甲遵循固定标准，而私人用户则能享用一系列可定制的时尚款式。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 星辰冲刺
items.expectedDescription:
You rush forward with a blast of stellar energy, getting into the thick of combat with ease. Stride twice. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during these moves.

Graviton-Attuned When you finish your Strides, enemies within 15 feet of you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save against your class DC. On a failure, they're pulled directly toward you, ending in an adjacent square if possible. You select the order these enemies are moved.

Photon-Attuned When you finish your Strides, you create a photon field in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on you. Until the start of your next turn, creatures outside the photon field are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to creatures inside the field.
items.description:
你在星辰能量的加持下冲刺向前，轻而易举地深入战场的中心。行走两次。在此次移动期间，你的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

引力子调谐当你完成行走时，你15尺内的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement]以对抗你的职业DC。失败时，敌人会被直线拉向你，直至其到达与你相邻范围内的一个方格（如果可能的话）。你可以选择敌人被拉向你的先后顺序。

光量子调谐当你完成行走时，你在以自身为中心的@Template[type:burst|distance:15]创造一个光量子场。直至你的下个回合开始，光量子场外部的生物对光量子场内的生物视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

items.name: 争胜之心
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An ally attempts a skill check with a skill that you have trained or better proficiency rank in.

You push yourself to be the best by competing with the triggering ally. Until the end of your next turn, you can attempt the same skill check to perform the same action or activity that the triggering ally performed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this skill check. If you achieve at least one degree of success higher than the triggering ally, this use of Competitive Spirit doesn't count toward its frequency. If you roll a critical failure on this skill check, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks attempted with that skill for the next hour as you try new techniques to improve your future attempts.
items.description:
频率每小时一次

触发一名盟友尝试进行你拥有受训或更高熟练度的技能检定

你通过与盟友竞争来激励自己变得更优秀。在你下一个回合结束之前，你可以尝试与触发争胜之心的盟友进行相同的技能检定，并且在此次技能检定中获得+2环境加值。如果你的成功度比触发该能力的盟友高一级，那么这次争胜之心不计入使用次数。若你在此项技能检定中出现大失败，接下来一小时内，当你尝试用新技巧改进后续尝试时，该技能的所有检定都将受到-1环境减值。

items.name: 人类
items.expectedDescription: Humans are known for their ability to adapt and thrive in the most challenging situations, including the mysterious loss of their home world, Golarion. Ambitious, creative, and endlessly curious, humans maintain a robust presence in the galaxy, often taking on positions of leadership or acting at the forefront of exploration. Humans can be found almost anywhere, doing almost anything.
items.description: 人类以在最严峻的处境中适应并繁荣的能力闻名，即使母星格拉利昂神秘失落也不例外。人类野心勃勃、富于创造力且永远充满好奇心，在星系中占据稳固地位，经常担任领导者或站在探索的最前沿。几乎在任何地方，都能找到从事几乎任何事情的人类。

items.name: 熟练人类（交涉）
items.expectedDescription: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.
items.description: 你的聪明才智让你有机会擅长多种技能。你选择的一项技能获得受训熟练度。5级时，你在该所选技能上的熟练度提升至专家。

items.name: 法外狂徒
items.expectedDescription:
You're a career criminal with a nasty reputation. Perhaps unfair circumstances forced you into a life of crime, or maybe you enjoy the thrill you get from pulling off a heist or living through a shoot-out. Either way, this life is the only one you know, and thanks to the bounty on your head, you're in it until the casket drops or you make enough creds to buy a new one.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k] skill feat.
items.description:
你是一个声名狼藉的职业罪犯。也许是不公平的环境迫使你走上了犯罪生涯，或者你享受从抢劫中获得的刺激感或经历火拼的快感。无论如何，你只熟悉这种生活——而悬赏令的存在，更让你注定无法脱身，要么横死街头，要么赚够钱买条新命。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的威吓技能和黑道学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k]（Intimidating Shot）技能专长。

items.name: 威吓射击
items.expectedDescription: You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe with your ranged weapon by firing it into the air, using ammo equal to the weapon's expend and the weapon's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take a –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
items.description: 你尝试通过向空中开枪来对一个在你远程武器射程内的敌人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]，使用的弹药数量等于武器的耗弹量，使用武器的最大射程替代挫败士气通常的30尺范围。即便目标与你语言不通，此检定也不会受到-4环境减值。

items.name: 使节
items.expectedDescription: You're a master influencer. You make your way in the universe with a charming smile, quick wit, and keen sense of self-preservation. You're a leader who motivates your teammates, pushes them past their limits, and helps them through tough spots. You excel at getting others to do what you want, but you're always ready to face trouble head-on when things take a turn for the worse. You might be a con artist, diplomat, performer, or military officer—or you might take on whatever role the situation demands.
items.description: 你是影响他人的大师。你凭借迷人的微笑、敏捷的才思和敏锐的自保意识闯荡宇宙。你是激励队友、推动他们突破极限并助其渡过难关的领袖。你擅长让他人依照你的意愿行事，但在局势恶化时，也总准备好直面麻烦。你可能是骗子、外交官、表演者或军官，也可能根据局势的需要扮演任何角色。

items.name: 使节指令
items.expectedDescription:
Envoys encourage their allies with directives. A directive is an order that benefits allies who follow it. Envoy directives include a way for the envoy to lead by example by spending more actions for increased effects. Directives have the auditory or visual trait depending on how you inspire your allies.

You begin with one envoy directive. You can learn more directives through the envoy class, envoy class feats, and your leadership style. You can issue one directive a round. Unless otherwise stated, an envoy's directive and the benefits it grants last until the beginning of your next turn.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] envoy directive.
items.description:
使节通过指令来鼓励盟友。指令是对遵守指令的盟友有利的命令。使节指令包括让使节以身作则的方式，花费更多动作来获得更多效果。指令具有听觉或视觉特征，取决于你激励盟友的方式。

你初始有一个使节指令。你可以通过使节职业，使节职业专长，和你的领导风格学到更多指令。你每轮可以下达一个指令。除非另有说明，使节的指令及其赋予的增益会持续到你的下回合开始。

你获得“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]”使节指令。

items.name: 领导风格
items.expectedDescription:
Whether it comes naturally, or you trained for it, you've developed a personal style of leading others. At 1st level, select a leadership style. You become trained in the indicated leadership skill, you gain the indicated leadership perk, and know the associated leadership directive.
