items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 商用型修理工具包
items.expectedDescription: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
items.description: 修理工具包包含各种各样的允许你在旅行途中进行简单修理的精密工具和供应品。你可以用修理工具包使用手艺技能修理物品。如果你穿戴着修理工具包，你可以抽出和替换一个穿戴在身上的修理工具包，作为使用动作的一部分。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 虚能噬
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你召唤虚空之力以伤害生命力。该目标承受2d4虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。 如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}直至你的下回合开始。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 邪影触须
items.expectedDescription:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
items.description:
黑暗触须从你的指尖蜿蜒伸出，掠过空中。你对在线形区域内的活物造成2d4虚能伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。每个线形区域内的活物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半虚能伤害，并且不受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚能伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该虚能伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 激励铃声
items.expectedDescription:
You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. The creature who owns the target comm unit regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.NmhqKZyMgQSHbyHj]

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.
items.description:
你会让目标通讯装置播放一首宇宙编曲的、专属于其拥有者的个人主题曲。当你施放该法术时，拥有该目标通讯单元的生物会恢复 1d8+4生命值，所有速度获得+5尺状态加值，并且在持续时间内，只要通讯单元继续播放铃声，对恐惧效果的豁免就会获得 +1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.NmhqKZyMgQSHbyHj]

升阶 （+1） 治疗量增加 1d8+4。

items.name: 阴影弹指
items.expectedDescription:
With a snap of your fingers, you beckon the target's shadow to obey you. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, you can choose to either attack or stalk the target with its shadow. If you choose to attack, attempt a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 1d10 cold damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit). This attack uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

If you stalk, attempt a spell attack roll against the target's AC the first time the target uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using until the end of your next turn; dealing 1d10 cold damage on a hit. If the attack is a critical hit, the shadow disrupts that action.

Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose to either attack the target or command the shadow to stalk the target until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
你打响指，唤令目标的影子服从。你施放此法术时，以及此后每轮中每个回合首次维持法术时，可以选择让目标的影子攻击或跟踪它。如果选择攻击，对目标的AC尝试一次法术攻击掷骰，命中时造成1d10寒冷伤害（重击时造成双倍伤害）。该攻击承受并计入你的多次攻击减值。

如果选择跟踪，直到你的下回合结束，当目标首次使用操作类或移动类动作、进行远程攻击，或在其使用的移动类动作中离开一个方格时，对目标的AC尝试一次法术攻击掷骰，命中时造成1d10寒冷伤害。如果该攻击重击，影子打断那个动作。

每次维持法术时，你可以选择攻击目标，或命令影子跟踪目标，直到你的下回合结束。

升阶（+1）寒冷伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 冷门武器（苦痛大砍刀）
items.expectedDescription:
You've familiarized yourself with a weapon from another ancestry or culture. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon with a trait corresponding to an ancestry (such as vesk or ysoki) or that's common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon, and for the purpose of determining your proficiency, you treat it as a simple weapon.

If you're trained in all martial weapons, you can instead choose an uncommon advanced weapon that has an ancestry's trait or is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon and have familiarity with that weapon. For the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a martial weapon.
items.description:
你熟悉了另一族裔或文化的武器。选择一种罕见的简易或军用武器，该武器须具有对应某个族裔的特征，例如维斯克蜥人或鼠族，或是在另一种文化中属于常见武器。你获得该武器的使用权限，并在决定熟练度时将其视为简易武器。

如果你受训于所有军用武器，可以改为选择一种罕见的进阶武器，它须具有某个族裔的特征，或在另一种文化中属于常见武器。你获得该武器的使用权限，并熟悉该武器。在决定熟练度时，将其视为军用武器。

items.name: 群组通讯
items.expectedDescription: Creatures in your bond can communicate telepathically while within 120 feet of one another. As long as two bonded creatures are on the same plane of existence and both are alive, they remain aware of one another's present state, general direction and distance from one another, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE] action.
items.description: 你纽带中的生物在彼此处于120尺内时能够通过心灵感应交流。只要两个联结生物处于同一个位面中并且都还活着，它们能够彼此知晓对方当前的状态，了解彼此的方向和距离，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE]动作。

items.name: 网络法术
items.expectedDescription: You channel your spell to manifest from one of your allies instead of yourself. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one of your bonded allies instead of yourself. Use the ally's space to determine the spell's source, range, and area of effect, but line of sight and line of effect must be met from both you and your ally when the spell is cast. While this might fool someone who only sees your ally, unless you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or the spell has the subtle trait, any creature able to see both you and your ally can easily determine you're the source of the spell. If the spell has the subtle trait, you and your ally can Cast the Spell in a way that makes the ally appear to have cast it without that trait.
items.description: 你引导你的法术从你的一个盟友而不是你自己身上显现。如果你下一个动作是施放具有区域、射程或目标的法术，取代你自身，该法术从你一个纽带中的盟友处显现。使用盟友的位置来确定法术的来源，射程和效果区域，但在法术被施放时，视线和效果线必须同时从你和盟友处满足。虽然这可能会愚弄那些只看到你的盟友的人，但除非你是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]状态或该法术具有晦匿特征，否则任何能看到你和你的盟友的生物都能轻易确定你是法术的源头。如果该法术具有晦匿特征，你与盟友可通过特定施法方式使盟友看似施放了该法术且不具有晦匿特征。

items.name: 标志性法术
items.expectedDescription: You've learned to cast some of your spells more flexibly, granting you extra control over your spellcasting. For each spell rank you have access to, choose one spell of that rank to be a signature spell. You don't need to learn heightened versions of signature spells separately; instead, you can heighten these spells freely. If you've learned a signature spell at a higher level than its minimum, you can also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If you swap out a signature spell, you can choose a replacement signature spell of the same spell rank at which you learned the previous spell. You can also retrain specifically to change a signature spell to a different spell of that rank without swapping any spells; this takes as much time as retraining a spell normally does.
items.description: 你学会了更灵活地施放部分法术，赋予你对施法的额外控制力。从每个你获得的法术环级上选择一个该等级的法术作为你的标志性法术。你不需要另外学习标志性法术的升阶版本；相反，你可以自由升阶这些法术。如果你学习了一个超过原本等级的标志性法术，你可以无需学习便施展这个法术的低级版本。如果你替换了标志性法术，你可以重新选择一个相同等级法术作为新的标志性法术。你还可以通过重训在不替换法术的情况下改变标志性法术，这会花费和通常重训法术相同的时间。

items.name: 反射专家
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic Your connection blesses you with insight that helps you dodge danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Soldier You've developed a knack for dodging danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Witchwarper Your awareness of possible dangers, through incredible analysis or an understanding of the wider multiverse, increases your reflexes. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.
items.description:
秘术师 你的联结赋予你洞见，帮助你闪避危险。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

士兵 你练就了躲避危险的诀窍。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

织维巫师 你凭借惊人的分析能力，或对更广大多元宇宙的理解，察觉到潜在危险，从而增强了反应能力。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 隐形术
items.expectedDescription:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.
items.description:
扭曲光线的幻觉包覆目标，令其变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这令该生物对所有生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪} ，但生物可以尝试寻找目标，令其改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。如果目标使用敌对动作，法术在敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时该法术不会结束。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力引导成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；或者，若你与一个至少有12点生命值的命能网络联结，可以改为将命能联结的生命值减少12点。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1） 造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2点（若消耗命能网络的生命值，则增加4点）。

items.name: 即时治疗
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An adjacent bonded ally takes damage.

You quickly expend energy from your vitality network toward a bonded ally. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] to the triggering ally.
items.description:
触发一名相邻盟友受到伤害。

你迅速从你的命能网络中消耗治疗能量，将其传递给纽带中的盟友。向触发盟友使用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]。

items.name: 健壮
items.expectedDescription: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
items.description: 在支撑到极限前，你的身体可以经受比大多数人更沉重的损伤。你的最大生命值提高等于你的等级的数值。你的恢复检定DC降低1点。

items.name: 战地医疗
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're holding or wearing a medkit.

You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and restore the corresponding amount of HP; this doesn't remove the wounded condition. As with Treat Wounds, you can attempt checks against higher DCs if you have the minimum proficiency rank. The target is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{immune} to your Battle Medicine for 1 day. This does not make them immune to, or otherwise count as, Treat Wounds.
items.description:
需求 你正持握或穿戴医疗包。

你即使在战斗中也能包扎伤口。尝试一次医疗检定，其DC与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}相同，并恢复相应数目的生命值；这不会移除受伤状态。如同治疗伤势，只要达到最低熟练度等级要求，你就可以尝试更高DC的检定。此后，目标对你的战地医疗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{免疫}1天。这不会使目标免疫治疗伤势，也不会以其他方式算作治疗伤势。

items.name: 强韧专家
items.expectedDescription:
Envoy Your physique is incredibly hardy. Your proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to expert.

Mystic Your physique has grown hardier from your adventures. Your proficiency rank for Fortitude saves increases to expert.
items.description:
使节你的体魄异常坚韧。你的强韧豁免熟练度提升为专家。

秘术师历经冒险，你的体魄愈发强健。你的强韧豁免熟练度提升至专家。

items.name: 集体主义
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 10 feet fails a skill check requiring 3 actions or fewer.

You broadcast helpful encouragement or pertinent information to your ally's mind. Your ally rerolls the triggering skill check and takes the better result.
items.description:
频率每日一次

触发10尺内一名盟友在一次需求不超过3动作的技能检定上失败。

你向你盟友的心灵中传递去积极的鼓励以及相关的信息。你的盟友重掷触发技能检定，并采用较好的结果。

items.name: 命尽其用
items.expectedDescription:
With careful focus, you guarantee vital energy lost from a target is caught by your vitality network. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals void damage to a living creature, your vitality network gains Hit Points equal to twice the spell's rank.

Special You can Waste Not without the spellshape trait. If you do and your next action is to Strike with a weapon that deals void damage, your vitality network gains 2 Hit Points per weapon damage die.
items.description:
通过专注凝神，你确保目标流失的生命能量被你的命能网络捕获。如果你下个动作是施放一个对活物造成虚能伤害的法术，你的命能网络获得等同于法术环级两倍的生命值。

特殊你能够以不带有塑法特征使用命尽其用。如果你这样做且你的下次攻击是使用造成虚能伤害的武器进行的打击，你的命能网络获得每武器伤害骰2点生命值。

items.name: 装死
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You take damage.

You lie @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and Impersonate a corpse. As long as you don't take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, a creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge. You can Ready an Action without ending this effect if you're a master in Deception.
items.description:
触发你受到伤害。

你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]并乔装（Impersonate）一具尸体。只要你没有采取任何需要身体动作的行动，你看起来就像死了一样。要识破你的伪装，生物必须通过搜索（Seeking）或回忆知识（Recalling Knowledge）成功对抗你的欺骗DC。如果你在欺骗技能上具有大师熟练度，你可以在不结束此效果的情况下准备（Ready）一个动作。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 分担痛苦
items.expectedDescription:
You telepathically share the sensation of agonizing pain with a creature. The target takes 3d12 mental damage and attempts a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) The spell targets up to four creatures and deals 6d12 mental damage.
items.description:
你以心灵感应向一个生物分享剧痛的感受。目标受到3d12心灵伤害，并尝试意志豁免。

大成功 生物不受影响。

成功 生物受到一半伤害。

失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 生物受到全部伤害，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 法术至多以四个生物为目标，并造成6d12心灵伤害。

items.name: 缓慢术
items.expectedDescription:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.
items.description:
你令目标周围的时间膨胀，令其行动缓慢。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1} ，持续1轮。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 1}，持续1分钟。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢 2}，持续1分钟。

升阶（6环） 你能以至多10个生物为目标。

items.name: 商用型轻量化翅膀
items.expectedDescription: Foldable wings are attached to your shoulder blades or a similar location on your body that allows them to lift your weight and assist your flying movements. You can deploy the wings with an Interact action, but you can't deploy or use them while you're wearing more than light armor. While the wings are deployed and you're not encumbered, you gain a fly Speed of 20 feet and a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight.
items.description: 可折叠的翅膀连接在你的肩胛骨或身上类似的位置，能将你抬升起来，并辅助你进行飞行移动。你可以通过交互动作展开翅膀，但穿着超过轻甲的护甲时无法展开或使用。当翅膀展开且你未陷入力竭状态时，你获得20尺飞行速度，且进行空中机动的特技检定时拥有+1物品加值。

items.name: 专家施法者
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic You've formed a more powerful bond with your connection. Your proficiency ranks for spell attack modifiers and spell DCs increase to expert.

Witchwarper Extended practice of magic has improved your capabilities. Your proficiency ranks for class DC, spell attack modifier, and spell DC increase to expert.
items.description:
秘术师你与你的联结建立了更强大的纽带。你的法术攻击调整值和法术DC熟练度提升至专家。

织维巫师长期的魔法练习提升了你的能力。你的职业DC、法术攻击调整值和法术DC熟练度提升至专家。

items.name: 战术型医疗包
items.expectedDescription: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. Tactical medical toolkits provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. A medkit is a toolkit.
items.description: 其中装有止痛药、绷带、无菌纱布和缝合工具，供医疗检定使用，以 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{急救}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{治疗疾病}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{治疗中毒}，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}。战术型医疗工具组为此类检定提供+1物品加值。医疗包是一种工具组。

items.name: 痛苦日记（商用型）（交涉）
items.expectedDescription:
Your raw emotions empower the poems and phrases penned in this synthetic leather journal. After spending 1 day writing in your pain journal, select Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance. Once a skill is selected for a pain journal, it can't be changed. Reading directly from the journal harnesses your painful memories, projects your emotions, and gives you a +1 item bonus to checks using the selected skill.

Activate—Painful Memory 2 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You recite a poem of utter anguish to spread your misery to another creature, casting a 3rd-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk] (DC 23).
items.description:
你原始的情绪赋予这本人造革日记本中的诗篇与短句力量。花费1天时间在痛苦日记中书写后，选择交涉、威吓或表演技能。一旦为痛苦日记选定技能，便无法更改。直接阅读日记能调动你的痛苦回忆，投射你的情绪，使你在使用所选技能的检定中获得+1物品加值。

启动—痛苦回忆 2 （操作）

频率 每天一次

效果 你吟诵一首极度痛苦的诗，将悲苦传给另一生物，施放3环 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.EhN3GjdjXChMdiFk] （DC 23）。

items.name: 闪烁
items.expectedDescription:
You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.
items.description:
你在当前位面和其他位面之间快速闪现。你对除了力场的所有伤害类型获得5点抗力。在你的每个回合结束时，你自动向随机方向传送10尺，由GM决定。你可以维持该法术，来进行如此的传送。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{法术效果：闪烁}

升阶（+2） 该抗力提高3。

items.name: 基因再生
items.expectedDescription:
You imbue the target's genetic code with a stimulating regenerative property that begins healing its wounds. The target temporarily gains regeneration 7, which restores 7 Hit Points to it at the start of each of its turns. While it has regeneration, the target can't die from taking damage, and its dying condition can't increase to a value that would kill it (this stops most creatures' dying condition at dying 3), though if its wounded value becomes 4 or higher, it stays @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until its wounds are treated. If the target takes acid or fire damage, its regeneration deactivates until after the end of its next turn.

Once during the spell's duration, the creature can forgo healing Hit Points that round to regrow one damaged or ruined organ or reattach a severed body part by spending an Interact action to hold the body part to the area it was severed from.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.4cFhz9knnHUHj3wi]

Heightened (+1) Increase the regeneration value by 2.
items.description:
你为目标的遗传密码注入激发再生的性质，开始治疗其伤口。目标暂时获得再生7，在其每个回合开始时恢复7点生命值。拥有再生期间，目标不会因受到伤害而死亡，其濒死状态也无法增加至足以使其死亡的数值（对大多数生物而言，这会使濒死状态停在濒死3）；不过，如果其受伤值达到4或更高，它会持续@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}，直到伤势得到治疗。如果目标受到酸蚀或火焰伤害，其再生会停止运作，直到下回合结束之后。

在法术持续期间限一次，该生物可以在一轮内放弃治疗生命值，来重新长出一个受损或毁坏的器官，或重新接上一个被切断的身体部位，要花费一个交互动作将身体部位固定在被切断的部位上。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.4cFhz9knnHUHj3wi]

升阶 （+1） 再生增加2。

items.name: 辐射纽带
items.expectedDescription: When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG], you can select any number of bonded allies to transfer to, though the total maximum number of Hit Points you can transfer doesn't increase.
items.description: 当你@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]时，你可以选择任意数量纽带中的盟友进行转移，但你可以转移的生命值总量不会增加。

items.name: 看护师
items.expectedDescription: You zealously monitor a patient's progress to administer treatment faster. When you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}, your patient becomes immune for only 10 minutes instead of 1 hour. This applies only to your Treat Wounds activities, not any other the patient receives.
items.description: 你热心监测伤患的恢复情况，以便能更快实施治疗。在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}时，你的伤患只会免疫治疗伤势10分钟而非1小时。此效果只应用于你的治疗伤势行动，伤患接受的其它治疗伤势不受影响。

items.name: 希伦虫人
items.expectedDescription:
The insectile shirrens split from the destructive Swarm, forsaking the ruthless hive mind to pursue personal freedom and end the cycle of interstellar violence. Shirrens are a species of telepaths devoted to their own individualism, building chosen communities, and living in harmony with other peoples.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.RM78QDGhVPlPrcvG]{Shirren}
items.description:
昆虫般的希伦虫人脱离了破坏性的虫群，舍弃其冷酷无情的集体心智，转而追求个人自由，并终结星际暴力的循环。希伦虫人拥有心灵感应能力，珍视个体独立，建立自主选择的社群，并与其他族群和谐共处。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.RM78QDGhVPlPrcvG]{希伦虫人}

items.name: 有限心灵感应
items.expectedDescription: You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
items.description: 你可以与30尺内的生物以心灵交流，但只能与和你具有共同语言的生物交流。这不会让你读取它们的思想，传递的信息也不会多于普通言语所能表达的内容。

items.name: 叛逆希伦虫人
items.expectedDescription: Despite the passage of time, you remain resolute in your defiance of the Swarm and all forms of mental control. If you roll a success on a Will saving throw against an effect that was created by a creature with the kucharn trait or a creature that you know is allied with the Swarm, you get a critical success instead. You gain these benefits against any creature affected by a spell or effect that controls it. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.nAJeT29ZJvqeg98h] action.
items.description: 时光流逝，你依然坚定反抗虫群和一切形式的心灵控制。当你进行意志豁免，对抗具有虫族特征的生物或你知道与虫群结盟的生物所创造的效果时，若掷骰结果为成功，则改为大成功。对抗任何受到控制其行为的法术或效果影响的生物时，你也获得这些益处。此外，你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.nAJeT29ZJvqeg98h]动作。

items.name: 叛逆反抗
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect You decry one foe within 100 feet that you can see as a tyrant or villain and prepare yourself to defy them, even until death. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on your attack rolls against this foe, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the attacks, spells, and effects of this foe. These benefits last for 1 minute.
items.description:
频率每日一次

效果你谴责100尺内一个你能看见的敌人是暴君或恶徒，并决意反抗它，即使付出生命也在所不惜。你对该敌人的攻击检定获得+1环境加值，且对抗该敌人的攻击、法术和效果的豁免获得+1环境加值。这些益处持续1分钟。

items.name: 门徒
items.expectedDescription:
You're a loyal disciple of a particular deity. You might have been raised in a religious culture or perhaps felt a kindred calling toward a god later in life, but you've honed your skills and devoted your life to living as a follower of that deity.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be an attribute specified in your deity's Divine Attribute entry, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the deity's listed divine skill and a Lore skill related to your deity (Abadar Lore, for example). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.NY2R5hNgdkSRPkTV] skill feat even if you do not meet the feat's prerequisites.
items.description:
你是某个特定神祇的忠实门徒。你可能在成长中受到某种宗教文化熏陶，或者在后来的生活中感受到了对这位神的召唤，但你已经磨练了自己的技能，并致力于作为这位神的信徒生活。

选择两项属性提升。一项须是与该神的神圣属性（Divine Attribute）相关的属性，另一项为自选属性提升。

你在神祇的神圣技能和神祇相关的学识（例如阿巴达尔学识）上受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.NY2R5hNgdkSRPkTV]技能专长且无需满足该专长的先决条件。

items.name: 神圣护符
items.expectedDescription: You can construct and bless a religious symbol of your deity in 10 minutes. While such talismans are traditionally scraps of paper with a religious symbol drawn on them, they can take many forms, including body art, a sticker, or even a virtual emoji. You can create a talisman only for yourself and for the deity you worship. As long as you continue to engage in activities that match your deity's edicts you gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls. If you violate your deity's anathema, the talisman is destroyed, and you take a –1 status penalty to initiative rolls and Perception checks until you complete an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.
items.description: 你可以在10分钟内制作并祝福一个属于所信神祇的宗教徽记。这些护符传统上是画有宗教徽记的纸片，但也能采用许多形式，包括身体绘画、贴纸，甚至虚拟表情符号。你只能为自己制作护符，且必须属于你所崇拜的神祇。只要你持续从事符合神祇敕令的活动，先攻检定便获得+1状态加值。如果违反神祇的禁忌，护符便被摧毁，且你在先攻检定和察觉检定上承受–1状态减值，直到完成一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{赎罪}仪式。

items.name: 秘术师
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit, channeling the fundamental forces that connect and bind everything in the cosmos. You can draw upon this supernatural wellspring to form deep spiritual bonds with your allies, empower them in combat, and restore their health should they become injured. Your powers take unique shape based on the connection you choose, granting new and more powerful spells as you explore your connection on a deeper level.
items.description: 你是传导者，引导着连接并维系宇宙万物的基本力量。你可以汲取这股超自然源泉，与盟友建立深厚的灵性纽带，在战斗中强化他们，并在他们受伤时恢复其健康。你的力量因所选联结而呈现独特形态；随着你对联结的探索不断深入，你将获得新的、更强大的法术。

items.name: 命能网络
items.expectedDescription:
Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to 6 + 4 Hit Points per level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] action that you can use to take Hit Points out of your network and into yourself or your allies as healing.

Life-and-death situations help strengthen your bonds with your allies. At the start of each turn in combat, when you regain actions, your vitality network regains 4 Hit Points; if you're master in spell DC, it regains 6 Hit Points instead; if you're legendary, it regains 8 Hit Points. When you Refocus, your vitality network regains all its Hit Points.
items.description:
你的灵魂支持着一个连结并治愈你纽带中生物的能量网络。你的命能网络具有等同于6+每等级4点生命值的最大容量。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]动作，可以用来从你的网络中提取生命值并将其转移到自己或盟友身上进行治疗。

生死攸关的情况有助于加固你与盟友的纽带。在战斗中每回合开始，当你重新获得动作时，你的命能网络会恢复4点生命值；如果你的法术DC为大师熟练度，它改为恢复6点生命值；如果你达到传奇熟练度，它会恢复8点生命值。当你再聚能时，你的命能网络会恢复全部生命值。

items.name: 联结
items.expectedDescription:
All mystics have a supernatural connection with a cosmic force that grants magical powers. The exact nature of your connection can vary widely—you might worship a god or pantheon, embody a metaphysical concept, become a conduit for nature's wrath, or something else. Even mystics who share the same connection might interpret the source of their powers differently. At 1st level, choose your connection. Your chosen connection determines the type of spells you cast and the spell tradition you choose spells from, your additional trained skill, the epiphanies you learn, and a harmony that usually grants creatures a special benefit when you heal them with your vitality network.

所有秘术师都与赋予魔法力量的宇宙伟力有着超自然的联结。你联结的具体性质可以有很大的不同——你可能崇拜一位神或万神殿，具现为一种形而上的概念，成为自然之怒的传导者，或是其他形态。即使是拥有相同联结的秘术师也可能对力量来源作出不同解读。1级时，选择你的联结。你所选的联结决定了你施放的法术类型和法术根源，你的额外受训技能，你掌握的顿悟，以及一种协调，一种在你用命能网络治愈生物时通常会赋予它们的特殊增益。

items.name: 转移命能
items.expectedDescription: You can transfer up to 10 Hit Points (minimum 1) from your vitality network into yourself or a bonded creature you can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action had the void trait. The amount you can transfer increases by 10 at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level.
items.description: 你能从你的命能网络中转移至多10点生命值（最小1点）到你自身或60尺内一名你能感知到纽带中的生物身上。这能对具有虚能治疗的生物生效，如同此动作具有虚能特征。你能转移的数值分别在5级，10级，15级和20级时增加10点。

items.name: 阴影
items.expectedDescription:
You know every shadow is a portal to the Netherworld, and like an artist molding clay, you sculpt that realm's shadowy substance into dreadful and wondrous shapes at your whim.

Tradition divine

Connection Skill Stealth

Connection Spells cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}; 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}; 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow}; 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast}; 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPXzPl7YbMEIGWfi]{Mislead}; 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0jadeyQIItIuRgeH]{Eclipse Burst}; 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]{Disappearance}; 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MJx7DmjsWYzDZ3a4]{Phantasmagoria}

The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while in this dim light and can use the concealed condition to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. This lasts until the end of your next turn.

Perfect Harmony You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.u9NU2bULHg3S5FaP] action. When you Transfer Vitality, the target can use this action once before the end of their next turn.
items.description:
你知道每一片阴影都是通往影界的大门，如同艺术家捏塑黏土，你随心所欲地将那片领域的阴影物质塑造成令人战栗又充满奇迹的形态。

根源神术

联结技能隐秘

联结法术 戏法: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]; 1环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]; 2环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]; 3环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]; 4环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]; 5环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]; 6环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPXzPl7YbMEIGWfi]; 7环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0jadeyQIItIuRgeH]; 8环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]; 9环: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MJx7DmjsWYzDZ3a4]

顿悟法术 初始: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.uh9Br4yrKvJA6zq0]; 进阶: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.rluzzX2ml4yFWnYw]; 高等: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.pgjlPNfXCpEYyLVu]

协调当你转移命能时，目标的阴影会变暗并膨胀，将目标周围@Template[type:emanation|distance:10]范围内的明亮光照减弱为昏暗光照。这是一种魔法黑暗，可以压制非魔法光亮或尝试反制魔法光亮。目标在这种昏暗光照下将变为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]，并可以使用此隐蔽状态进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]。这会持续到你的下个回合结束。

完美协调你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.u9NU2bULHg3S5FaP]{暗影步法}动作。当你转移命能时，目标在其下个回合结束前可以使用一次此动作。

items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

你总是知道其他联结生物的大致距离和方向，他们的生命值总数，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。这种能力在跨位面（包括漂流域中的通行）时不起作用，一些特殊的魔法或科技效果可能会干扰你侦测盟友的能力。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

items.name: 宗-莎琳
items.expectedDescription:
The Embrace

Zon-Shelyn is the divine reunion of Shelyn the Eternal Rose and her estranged brother, the Midnight Lord Zon-Kuthon. Together, the siblings represent the concepts of overcoming suffering through art, finding beauty in strange and unusual places, and reunion with lost loved ones.

Areas of Concern art, alternative fashion, creativity, music, pain, strange beauty

Edicts channel your pain into art, seek beauty in all places, express yourself creatively according to your own aesthetics

Anathema suffer in silence, destroy or copy another's creative works, conform to society's beauty standards
items.description:
美暗拥一

宗-莎琳是永恒玫瑰莎琳与她疏远已久的兄长、午夜领主宗-库松的神性重聚。兄妹二神共同代表着通过艺术克服痛苦、在奇异罕见之处发现美，以及与失散的挚爱重逢的理念。

关注领域艺术、另类时尚、创造力、音乐、痛苦、奇异之美

典范将自身痛苦融入艺术，在所有地方寻找美，根据自己的美学创造性地表达自己

禁忌默默忍受痛苦，破坏或复制他人的创作作品，屈从于大众的审美标准

items.name: 电弧手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Instead of traditional ammunition, this bulky pistol contains a capacitor that generates arcs of electricity. Its stock is crafted from polycarbon or other synthetic insulators, often tinted bright yellow and inscribed with the universal bolt symbol for high voltage.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把笨重的手枪不使用传统弹药，而是内置一个能够产生电弧的电容器。枪托由聚碳材料或其他合成绝缘材料制成，通常染成亮黄色，并刻有表示高压电的通用闪电符号。

items.name: 微纤护甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This light armor is woven from ultralight fibers that flex with a wearer's movements but turn hard as steel on impact.
items.description:
强化： 1

此轻甲以超轻纤维编织，随穿戴者的动作弯曲，但受到冲击时会硬如钢铁。

items.name: 苦痛大砍刀
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This fierce but deceptively elegant polearm rips apart enemies with a motor-powered fangblade. An adjustable pulse trigger allows the wielder to channel extra pain through the weapon.
items.description:
强化： 1

这把凶猛却又出奇优雅的长柄武器，以马达驱动的獠牙刃撕裂敌人。可调节的脉冲扳机让持用者能够通过武器施加额外痛苦。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 商用型修理工具包
items.expectedDescription: A repair toolkit contains a variety of delicate tools and supplies that allows you to perform simple repairs while traveling. You can use a repair toolkit to Repair items using the Crafting skill. You can draw and replace a worn repair toolkit as part of the action that uses it.
items.description: 修理工具包包含各种各样的允许你在旅行途中进行简单修理的精密工具和供应品。你可以用修理工具包使用手艺技能修理物品。如果你穿戴着修理工具包，你可以抽出和替换一个穿戴在身上的修理工具包，作为使用动作的一部分。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 诡枪术
items.expectedDescription:
You condense a beam of mind-assaulting eldritch energy from the dark spaces between the stars and fire it at a target. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 mental damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你自星辰之间的幽深领域凝聚一束袭魂慑魄的怪异能量攻击目标。尝试一次远程法术攻击骰对抗目标的AC，如果命中，你造成2d6心灵伤害，在大成功时造成双倍伤害。

升阶（+1）伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 神导术
items.expectedDescription:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}
items.description:
你请求超自然存在的引导，赋予目标在持续时间结束前的一次攻击掷骰、察觉检定、豁免或技能检定上获得+1状态加值。目标在掷骰前选择是否使用该加值。如果目标使用该加值，该法术结束。无论怎样结束，该目标接下来会临时免疫1小时。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{法术效果：神导术}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{效果：神导术免疫}

items.name: 虚能噬
items.expectedDescription:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你召唤虚空之力以伤害生命力。该目标承受2d4虚能伤害，这有一次基础强韧豁免。 如果该生物在豁免中大失败，它还会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭 1}直至你的下回合开始。

升阶（+1） 该伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 邪影触须
items.expectedDescription:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.
items.description:
黑暗触须从你的指尖蜿蜒伸出，掠过空中。你对在线形区域内的活物造成2d4虚能伤害和@Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]]伤害。每个线形区域内的活物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 该生物不受影响。

成功 该生物承受一半虚能伤害，并且不受持续流血伤害。

失败 该生物承受完整伤害。

大失败 该生物承受双倍虚能伤害和双倍持续流血伤害。

升阶（+1） 该虚能伤害增加2d4，持续流血伤害增加1。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 激励铃声
items.expectedDescription:
You cause the target comm unit to play a cosmically composed personal theme song specific to its owner. The creature who owns the target comm unit regains 1d8+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell, a +5-foot status bonus to all Speeds, and a +1 status bonus to saves against fear effects for the duration as long as the comm unit continues to play the ringtone.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.NmhqKZyMgQSHbyHj]

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d8+4.
items.description:
你会让目标通讯装置播放一首宇宙编曲的、专属于其拥有者的个人主题曲。当你施放该法术时，拥有该目标通讯单元的生物会恢复 1d8+4生命值，所有速度获得+5尺状态加值，并且在持续时间内，只要通讯单元继续播放铃声，对恐惧效果的豁免就会获得 +1状态加值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.NmhqKZyMgQSHbyHj]

升阶 （+1） 治疗量增加 1d8+4。

items.name: 阴影弹指
items.expectedDescription:
With a snap of your fingers, you beckon the target's shadow to obey you. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it each turn on subsequent rounds, you can choose to either attack or stalk the target with its shadow. If you choose to attack, attempt a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 1d10 cold damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit). This attack uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

If you stalk, attempt a spell attack roll against the target's AC the first time the target uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using until the end of your next turn; dealing 1d10 cold damage on a hit. If the attack is a critical hit, the shadow disrupts that action.

Each time you Sustain the spell, you can choose to either attack the target or command the shadow to stalk the target until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10.
items.description:
你打响指，唤令目标的影子服从。你施放此法术时，以及此后每轮中每个回合首次维持法术时，可以选择让目标的影子攻击或跟踪它。如果选择攻击，对目标的AC尝试一次法术攻击掷骰，命中时造成1d10寒冷伤害（重击时造成双倍伤害）。该攻击承受并计入你的多次攻击减值。

如果选择跟踪，直到你的下回合结束，当目标首次使用操作类或移动类动作、进行远程攻击，或在其使用的移动类动作中离开一个方格时，对目标的AC尝试一次法术攻击掷骰，命中时造成1d10寒冷伤害。如果该攻击重击，影子打断那个动作。

每次维持法术时，你可以选择攻击目标，或命令影子跟踪目标，直到你的下回合结束。

升阶（+1）寒冷伤害增加1d10。

items.name: 冷门武器（苦痛大砍刀）
items.expectedDescription:
You've familiarized yourself with a weapon from another ancestry or culture. Choose an uncommon simple or martial weapon with a trait corresponding to an ancestry (such as vesk or ysoki) or that's common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon, and for the purpose of determining your proficiency, you treat it as a simple weapon.

If you're trained in all martial weapons, you can instead choose an uncommon advanced weapon that has an ancestry's trait or is common in another culture. You gain access to that weapon and have familiarity with that weapon. For the purpose of proficiency, you treat it as a martial weapon.
items.description:
你熟悉了另一族裔或文化的武器。选择一种罕见的简易或军用武器，该武器须具有对应某个族裔的特征，例如维斯克蜥人或鼠族，或是在另一种文化中属于常见武器。你获得该武器的使用权限，并在决定熟练度时将其视为简易武器。

如果你受训于所有军用武器，可以改为选择一种罕见的进阶武器，它须具有某个族裔的特征，或在另一种文化中属于常见武器。你获得该武器的使用权限，并熟悉该武器。在决定熟练度时，将其视为军用武器。

items.name: 群组通讯
items.expectedDescription: Creatures in your bond can communicate telepathically while within 120 feet of one another. As long as two bonded creatures are on the same plane of existence and both are alive, they remain aware of one another's present state, general direction and distance from one another, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE] action.
items.description: 你纽带中的生物在彼此处于120尺内时能够通过心灵感应交流。只要两个联结生物处于同一个位面中并且都还活着，它们能够彼此知晓对方当前的状态，了解彼此的方向和距离，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.XSMTalRsPwQ0beIE]动作。

items.name: 网络法术
items.expectedDescription: You channel your spell to manifest from one of your allies instead of yourself. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with an area, range, or target, the spell manifests from one of your bonded allies instead of yourself. Use the ally's space to determine the spell's source, range, and area of effect, but line of sight and line of effect must be met from both you and your ally when the spell is cast. While this might fool someone who only sees your ally, unless you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} or the spell has the subtle trait, any creature able to see both you and your ally can easily determine you're the source of the spell. If the spell has the subtle trait, you and your ally can Cast the Spell in a way that makes the ally appear to have cast it without that trait.
items.description: 你引导你的法术从你的一个盟友而不是你自己身上显现。如果你下一个动作是施放具有区域、射程或目标的法术，取代你自身，该法术从你一个纽带中的盟友处显现。使用盟友的位置来确定法术的来源，射程和效果区域，但在法术被施放时，视线和效果线必须同时从你和盟友处满足。虽然这可能会愚弄那些只看到你的盟友的人，但除非你是@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]状态或该法术具有晦匿特征，否则任何能看到你和你的盟友的生物都能轻易确定你是法术的源头。如果该法术具有晦匿特征，你与盟友可通过特定施法方式使盟友看似施放了该法术且不具有晦匿特征。

items.name: 标志性法术
items.expectedDescription: You've learned to cast some of your spells more flexibly, granting you extra control over your spellcasting. For each spell rank you have access to, choose one spell of that rank to be a signature spell. You don't need to learn heightened versions of signature spells separately; instead, you can heighten these spells freely. If you've learned a signature spell at a higher level than its minimum, you can also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If you swap out a signature spell, you can choose a replacement signature spell of the same spell rank at which you learned the previous spell. You can also retrain specifically to change a signature spell to a different spell of that rank without swapping any spells; this takes as much time as retraining a spell normally does.
items.description: 你学会了更灵活地施放部分法术，赋予你对施法的额外控制力。从每个你获得的法术环级上选择一个该等级的法术作为你的标志性法术。你不需要另外学习标志性法术的升阶版本；相反，你可以自由升阶这些法术。如果你学习了一个超过原本等级的标志性法术，你可以无需学习便施展这个法术的低级版本。如果你替换了标志性法术，你可以重新选择一个相同等级法术作为新的标志性法术。你还可以通过重训在不替换法术的情况下改变标志性法术，这会花费和通常重训法术相同的时间。

items.name: 反射专家
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic Your connection blesses you with insight that helps you dodge danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Soldier You've developed a knack for dodging danger. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.

Witchwarper Your awareness of possible dangers, through incredible analysis or an understanding of the wider multiverse, increases your reflexes. Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to expert.
items.description:
秘术师 你的联结赋予你洞见，帮助你闪避危险。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

士兵 你练就了躲避危险的诀窍。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

织维巫师 你凭借惊人的分析能力，或对更广大多元宇宙的理解，察觉到潜在危险，从而增强了反应能力。你的反射豁免熟练度等级提升至专家。

items.name: 恐惧术
items.expectedDescription:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
你将恐惧植入目标；它必须尝试一次意志豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 1}。

失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 2}。

大失败 目标获得 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 3}，并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{逃跑}，持续1轮。

升阶（3环） 你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 治疗术
items.expectedDescription:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
items.description:
你引导命能，以治疗活物或者伤害不死生物。如果目标是自愿活物，你使其恢复1d8生命值。如果目标是不死生物，你对其造成等量命能伤害，并且它可以进行基础强韧豁免。你在施放该法术时花费的动作数量决定其目标，范围，区域和其他参数。

1 该法术的射程为接触。

2（专注）该法术的射程为30尺。如果你在治疗一个活物，回复的生命值增加8。

3（专注）你在@Template[emanation|distance:30]内释放命能。这会以区域中所有活物和不死生物为目标。

升阶（+1） 治疗或者伤害的量增加1d8，两个动作版本的额外治疗增加8。

items.name: 隐形术
items.expectedDescription:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.
items.description:
扭曲光线的幻觉包覆目标，令其变得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{隐形}。这令该生物对所有生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{无踪} ，但生物可以尝试寻找目标，令其改为@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{藏匿}。如果目标使用敌对动作，法术在敌对动作完成后结束。

升阶（4环） 该法术持续1分钟，但目标使用敌对动作时该法术不会结束。

items.name: 灵魂激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You channel your life force into a spear of energy. You lose 6 Hit Points or, if you're in a bond with a vitality network that has at least 12 Hit Points, you can reduce the vitality bond's Hit Points by 12 instead. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, you deal 6d6 spirit damage. On a critical hit, the target takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage dealt by 2d6 and the Hit Points lost by 2 (or by 4 if you spend Hit Points from a vitality network).
items.description:
你将生命力引导成一支能量长矛。你失去6点生命值；或者，若你与一个至少有12点生命值的命能网络联结，可以改为将命能联结的生命值减少12点。对目标的AC进行一次远程法术攻击。命中时，你造成6d6精魂伤害。重击时，目标受到双倍伤害并陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{流失1}。

升阶（+1） 造成的伤害增加2d6，失去的生命值增加2点（若消耗命能网络的生命值，则增加4点）。

items.name: 商用型医疗包
items.expectedDescription: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.
items.description: 这些医疗包包含了对于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]的医疗检定所必需的镇痛剂，绷带，无菌纱布以及缝合工具。医疗包是一种工具包。

items.name: 即时治疗
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An adjacent bonded ally takes damage.

You quickly expend energy from your vitality network toward a bonded ally. @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] to the triggering ally.
items.description:
触发一名相邻盟友受到伤害。

你迅速从你的命能网络中消耗治疗能量，将其传递给纽带中的盟友。向触发盟友使用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]。

items.name: 健壮
items.expectedDescription: Your body can withstand more punishment than most before succumbing. Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. You reduce the DC of recovery checks by 1.
items.description: 在支撑到极限前，你的身体可以经受比大多数人更沉重的损伤。你的最大生命值提高等于你的等级的数值。你的恢复检定DC降低1点。

items.name: 战地医疗
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're holding or wearing a medkit.

You can patch up wounds, even in combat. Attempt a Medicine check with the same DC as for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} and restore the corresponding amount of HP; this doesn't remove the wounded condition. As with Treat Wounds, you can attempt checks against higher DCs if you have the minimum proficiency rank. The target is then @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{immune} to your Battle Medicine for 1 day. This does not make them immune to, or otherwise count as, Treat Wounds.
items.description:
需求 你正持握或穿戴医疗包。

你即使在战斗中也能包扎伤口。尝试一次医疗检定，其DC与@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{治疗伤势}相同，并恢复相应数目的生命值；这不会移除受伤状态。如同治疗伤势，只要达到最低熟练度等级要求，你就可以尝试更高DC的检定。此后，目标对你的战地医疗@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.2XEYQNZTCGpdkyR6]{免疫}1天。这不会使目标免疫治疗伤势，也不会以其他方式算作治疗伤势。

items.name: 维斯克蜥人
items.expectedDescription: Vesk are a warmongering, reptilian people who conquered the eight worlds in their solar system shortly after they developed spaceflight, forming the Veskarium empire. Vesk tend to embrace conflict and respect strength and military might.
items.description: 维斯克是好战的爬行类种族，在发展出太空航行技术后不久，便征服了自己恒星系中的八个世界，建立维斯卡里姆帝国。维斯克倾向于拥抱冲突，尊重力量和军事威势。

items.name: 快步维斯克蜥人
items.expectedDescription: You come from a line of vesk who were constantly on the move. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
items.description: 你来自一群持续移动的维斯克蜥人。你的速度提高5尺。

items.name: 特种兵
items.expectedDescription:
You enlisted in a military or were recruited by a paramilitary group as a career trooper. As long as you've got enough guns and the right squad to back you up, you can handle just about anything.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j] feat.
items.description:
你作为一名职业特种兵入伍或被一支准军事组织招募。只要你有足够的枪支和正确的小队支持，你可以处理几乎任何事情。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或体质，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的运动技能和战争学识（Warfare Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j]（Barricade）技能专长。

items.name: 设置障碍
items.expectedDescription: You hastily create a barricade using nearby items, junk, or debris. The barricade provides lesser cover for you and one other ally, though you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to increase this benefit to standard cover. The barricade is flimsy and falls apart at the end of your next turn.
items.description: 你迅速利用附近的物品、垃圾或碎片建立一道障碍物。该障碍物为你和另一个盟友提供次等掩蔽，但你可以用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]动作来将这一好处提升为标准掩蔽。这个障碍物很脆弱，会在你下一个回合结束时散架。

items.name: 士兵
items.expectedDescription: You're a master of area weapons, heavy armor, and soaking damage. You fight in the thick of the battle and unleash devastating salvos against your foes as you take withering fire in return. By laying down a barrage of suppressing fire with powerful weapons, you set your allies up to fulfill their respective roles while encouraging enemies to focus on you.
items.description: 你精通区域武器和重甲，也擅长承受伤害。你奋战在战斗最激烈的地方，向敌人倾泻毁灭性的齐射，同时承受对方猛烈的还击。你以强大的武器铺设压制火力，吸引敌人将注意力集中在自己身上，为盟友各司其职创造条件。

items.name: 士兵战斗风格
items.expectedDescription:
As a soldier, you train using a specific style of fighting. Your style determines how you approach combat and often changes how you take advantage of your ability to suppress targets. Choose a soldier fighting style.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.ajzZpzc8uMtgU6N8]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.T78VQC8oaD1Odz1k]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.VDEYb7aAwAjBp8Av]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.5mOTKBsn8OsEvFaA]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.FSAqTE67445EvyX8]
items.description:
作为士兵，你专注于一种特殊战斗风格。你的风格决定了你如何战斗，以及你如何压制目标。选择一种士兵战斗风格。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.ajzZpzc8uMtgU6N8]
