items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 游击兵
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in close-quarters missions that require you to operate in crowded or tight spaces, such as inside buildings or vehicles, down narrow alleys, or in busy downtown streets. Whether you're a mugger, bodyguard, assassin, or urban mercenary, you favor pistols and can use them efficiently in tight spaces. You're trained in Acrobatics. You gain a skill feat for Acrobatics.

Exploit: You're trained to fight in close combat using pistols. Your ranged Strikes with one-handed ranged weapons don't trigger reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Enhanced Exploit: Your point-blank shots are particularly deadly. When you make a successful Strike against an adjacent enemy with a one-handed ranged weapon, you calculate the damage as if the lowest-rolled weapon damage die for the attack had the maximum result instead. At 17th level, the two lowest-rolled damage dice increase to the maximum result.
items.description:
你专精于在拥挤和狭窄的空间中执行近距离任务，如建筑物内部、载具内、狭窄的小巷和繁忙的商业街。无论你是抢劫犯、保镖、刺客还是城市雇佣兵，你偏爱手枪，并能在狭小空间内高效地使用它们。你在特技上受训，并获得一个特技技能专长。

秘技：你受到训练，在近距离冲突中使用手枪战斗。你使用单手远程武器的远程攻击不会触发因远程攻击而触发的反应。

进阶秘技：你的近距离射击格外致命。当你用单手远程武器对相邻敌人进行一次成功的打击时，你将掷出的最低的武器伤害骰视为最大值。在17级时，你将掷出的最低的两个伤害骰变为最大值。

items.name: 四平八稳
items.expectedDescription: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
items.description: 即使在恶劣的条件下，你也能轻易保持平衡。每当你检定成功地使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}动作时，改为大成功。你在狭窄平面和不稳地面尝试保持平衡时不会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

items.name: 迅捷处理器
items.expectedDescription: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.
items.description: 你可以快速识别周围的环境，你可以使用该信息来在危险中或在危险情况驾驶车辆时获得优势。你在用于掷骰先攻的察觉检定上获得+1环境加值，在用于掷骰先攻的驾驶（Piloting）检定上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 机动瞄准
items.expectedDescription: You're rarely still, and you've learned to reliably hit your targets even while moving. You Stride and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] with a gun you're wielding.
items.description: 你极少处于静止状态，并学会了在移动时也能准确地击中目标。你行走，然后用你正持握的一把枪械@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 商用型力场护盾
items.expectedDescription:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 6 Hit Points and replenishes 2 Hit Points on your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{Effect: Force Field 6}

Activate—Raise Force Field 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.
items.description:
力场护盾能够吸收伤害，其生命值取决于型号。启用期间，你将承受的任何物理或能量伤害，都会先从力场护盾的生命值中扣除，再从你的生命值中扣除，包括临时生命值。如果你举着盾牌，力场护盾和盾牌都会受到伤害。如果一次攻击或效果的伤害使力场护盾降至0生命值，你承受溢出的伤害，力场护盾关闭，并在10分钟内无法再次启动。启用的力场护盾每轮在你的回合开始时恢复所列数量的生命值。

如果你的力场护盾是战术型或更高型号，它还能保护你免受致命打击。每当你在力场护盾启用期间受到重击时，尝试一次对抗所列DC的纯骰检定。成功时，此次重击变为普通命中。

此力场护盾具有6生命值，在你的回合恢复2生命值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{效果：力场护盾6}

启动—升起力场护盾 1（操作）

频率每日三次

效果你的力场护盾启用，持续1分钟或直到其生命值降至0。

items.name: 商用型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

这类手雷点燃化学物质，引发炽热的爆炸，造成1d8点火焰伤害，并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免（@Template[burst|distance:5]）。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，对抗燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被推离手雷。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 第二皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 零度短刃
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Unfolding like a switchblade, a supercooled chamber within this weapon instantly forms a blade of ice.
items.description:
强化： 1

此武器如弹簧折刀般展开，内部过冷腔室瞬间形成一片冰刃。

items.name: 商用型渗透者工具包
items.expectedDescription: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.
items.description: 你需要渗透者工具包来用贼活技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]（部分类型）。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 专心致志
items.expectedDescription: You're highly focused on your target and able to discern their moves. When you roll a success on a Reflex or Will save against your mark, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 你的高度专注于目标，可以识别他们的行动。当你在对抗你标靶的反射豁免或意志豁免中成功时，将结果改为大成功。

items.name: 专精技能组
items.expectedDescription: At 3rd level, 7th level, and 15th level, you gain a skill feat. This feat must be for the trained skill from your operative's specialization.
items.description: 3级，7级，15级时，你获得一个技能专长。该专长必须是来自你的特工专精所提供的受训技能。

items.name: 抢人头
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An ally ends their turn after hitting a creature two or more times or critically hitting a creature.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a quick shot at a foe your ally is focusing their attacks on. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] at the creature your triggering ally hit and then make a ranged Strike against that creature.
items.description:
触发一个盟友在命中一个生物两次及以上或重击一个生物后结束他们的回合。

需求你持用一把枪械。

你向一个盟友正在全力攻击的生物打出一发快枪。你@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]你的触发盟友命中的生物，然后对该生物进行一次远程打击。

items.name: 族裔典范
items.expectedDescription: Whether through instinct, study, or magic, you feel a deeper connection to your ancestry. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat.
items.description: 凭借天性、研究或魔法的帮助，你与自己族裔的关联比常人更深。你获得一个1级族裔专长。

items.name: 夜视适应
items.expectedDescription: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.
items.description: 你的眼部处理器中的纳米机已经适应了黑暗，增强了你在黑暗中的视力。你获得黑暗视觉。

items.name: 轻身落
items.expectedDescription: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
items.description: 模仿自猫的高空特技动作让你能够缓冲坠落的损伤。将坠落距离视为缩短10尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到专家，将坠落距离视为缩短25尺，达到大师后，缩短50尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到传奇，无论坠落距离多高，你始终能够以脚着地，不会受到任何伤害。

items.name: 全息影像怀疑者
items.expectedDescription: You easily spot the tiny glitches and imperfections in holograms. Even if you aren't Searching, you always attempt a check to disbelieve holograms and effects with the illusion and tech traits that normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or Interact with them.
items.description: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障与瑕疵。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜寻}，你也总会尝试检定以识破全息影像，以及那些具有幻术和科技特征、通常要求你搜寻或与其交互才能识破的效果。

items.name: 大师射手
items.expectedDescription: You are a highly skilled sharpshooter and never go anywhere without your gun. Your proficiency rank increases to master with simple and martial guns, and increases to expert with advanced guns. You gain access to the critical specialization effect for all weapons for which you have expert proficiency.
items.description: 你是枪不离身的顶级神射手。你在简易和军用枪械上的熟练提升为大师，在进阶枪械上的熟练提升为专家。你获得所有你具有专家熟练度武器的重击专精效果。

items.name: 城市干员
items.expectedDescription: You are accustomed to urban environments and can move swiftly through a crowded cityscape. You ignore difficult terrain in urban environments, and greater difficult terrain from urban environments is only difficult terrain for you.
items.description: 你十分熟悉在城市环境内工作，并能迅速在喧闹的市井间穿行。你忽略城市环境中的困难地形，且城市环境中的高等困难地形对你仅是普通困难地形。

items.name: 先进瞄准系统
items.expectedDescription: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} once per day as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell.
items.description: 你的眼部处理器配备了先进的瞄准系统，可以让你更容易地定位你的敌人并读取他们的动作。你可以施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{料敌机先}作为1环奥术内在法术，每日一次。

items.name: 切换目标
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The creature you've currently @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} condition.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

As your target falls, you immediately home in on the next. You Aim at a different creature.
items.description:
触发你当前@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]的生物获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]状态。

需求你持用一把枪械

在你的目标倒下时，你立即瞄准下一个目标。你对一个不同的生物进行瞄准。

items.name: 电诈专家
items.expectedDescription: You're skilled at running digital fraud schemes. You can Create a Forgery using [[/act create-forgery skill=computers]]{Computers} instead of Society. Digital forgeries are compared against your Computers DC. Using information gained from a successful forgery usually requires additional checks, including Deception and Society, and casting too wide a net runs the risk of a potential victim figuring out your ruse and turning you in to the authorities.
items.description: 你擅长实施数字诈骗。你可以使用[[/act create-forgery skill=computers]]{计算机}代替社群来伪造文书。数字伪造品以你的计算机DC作为对抗难度。使用成功伪造所得的信息，通常还需要其他检定，包括欺骗和社群；撒网过广也会带来风险，潜在受害者可能识破骗局，并向当局举报你。

items.name: 仿生人
items.expectedDescription: Androids first emerged as synthetic beings crafted by many technologically advanced civilizations throughout the galaxy. The first androids were created by humanoid peoples in their own images, but after the technology that animated the living constructs spread, androids began displaying a fantastic diversity of forms. Androids in the Pact Worlds were originally designed as servants, but today androids and other robotic beings stand as equals to organic ancestries under the Pact. Some androids have formed their own independent communities, while most integrate seamlessly into Pact Worlds societies. Unlike many other technological constructs, androids are more than intricate synthetic organs and complex programming, and each possesses their own soul.
items.description: 仿生人最初是星系中许多科技发达的文明制造的合成生命。最早的仿生人是类人生物按照自身形象创造的，但随着赋予这些活体构装体生命的技术传播开来，仿生人也开始呈现出千姿百态的形貌。协约世界的仿生人最初被设计为仆役，但如今，根据协约，仿生人与其他机器人生命已与有机族裔享有平等地位。一些仿生人建立了独立的社群，大多数则顺利融入协约世界的社会。与许多其他科技构装体不同，仿生人并不只是精密的合成器官与复杂的程序；每个仿生人都拥有自己的灵魂。

items.name: 构装体
items.expectedDescription: Your synthetic body resists ailments better than those of purely biological organisms. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.
items.description: 你的人造身体比单纯的生物机体更能抵抗疾患。你对疾病、毒素和辐射的豁免检定获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 改造狂热派仿生人
items.expectedDescription: You or your previous iterations have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades, enabling you to personally customize your body and its capabilities. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that you can use to install armor upgrades and that doesn't count toward your armor's total number of upgrades. You can install and uninstall armor upgrades into your personal upgrade slot using the Install Upgrade activity. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this armor upgrade already installed in your upgrade slot (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting upgrade).
items.description: 你或你前一次迭代已将你的身体兼容了护甲强化，可以让你自定义自己的身体和其功能。你的身体有一个护甲强化槽位。你可以使用安装强化模块（Install Upgrade）行动来安装或卸载护甲强化模块到你的强化模块槽位上。选择一项1级或以下物品等级的常见护甲强化模块。你初始时已在强化模块槽位上安装有此护甲强化模块（你不需要支付信用点来购买此初始强化模块）。

items.name: 黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets. The open networks known as infospheres are your home and the place you can do your best work. You're highly competent when it comes to cracking code or accessing secure data.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9] skill feat.
items.description:
你一直对计算机和虚拟空间很有天赋，并努力学习技术秘密。被称为信息圈的开放网络是你的家，也是你大展身手的地方。无论是破解代码还是访问加密数据，你都游刃有余。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或智力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的计算机技能和信息圈学识（Infosphere Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]（Phreaker）技能专长。

items.name: 电话黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've learned how to hack using alternative methods. You can use Computers to Disable a Device or Hack a system using any computer, comm unit, or terminal instead of a hacking toolkit. If you're an expert in Computers and the equipment you use is at least 3rd level, you gain a +1 item bonus to Disable a Device or Hack.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf] skill feat, you can use this feat to Combat Hack or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} without a hacking toolkit.
items.description:
你学会了以其他方法骇入。你可以用任意计算机、通讯器或终端，使用计算机技能解除装置或骇入系统，无需骇客工具包。如果你在计算机达到专家，且所用设备至少为3级，则你解除装置或骇入的检定获得+1物品加值。

特殊如果你具有@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]技能专长，就可以使用此专长，在没有骇客工具包的情况下进行战斗骇入或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}。

items.name: 特工
items.expectedDescription: You're a focused, quick-witted professional who thrives in high-stakes combat. Your deadly aim and tactical training give you an edge over the competition—for you, even the most powerful enemy is just another mark to take out. You have impressive prowess in your chosen field of specialization.
items.description: 你是专注而机敏的专业人士，在生死攸关的战斗中如鱼得水。致命的瞄准技巧与战术训练使你在较量中占优——对你而言，即使最强大的敌人也只是另一个需要解决的目标。你在自己选择的专精领域中拥有非凡的造诣。

items.name: 神射手
items.expectedDescription: You can spot a target's weak points, letting you deal additional precision damage with most types of ranged weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] action.
items.description: 你能看穿目标的弱点，令你可以用大多数类型的远程武器造成额外精准伤害。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]动作。

items.name: 特工专精
items.expectedDescription:
As an operative, you have a particular set of skills based on your tactical style. These different specializations help define your character and the approach you take to most situations. Choose an operative's specialization. This specialization grants you training in one skill, a skill feat for that skill, and an exploit. At 9th level, you gain the enhanced exploit granted by your specialization. The specializations presented in this book are as follows.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.1bgDbGzALewzo7cy]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.u4hB3FGFJwGtjrZB]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.HSKJ1VkPdlMkcqzc]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.OCWsQQ95P7ecp7Rn]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.EpxKCi6G0KnWQhHP]
items.description:
作为特工，你拥有一套基于你战术风格的独特技能组。这些不同的专精有助于明确你的角色和你在大多数情况下采取的行动方式。选择一项特工专精，专精会提供一项技能上的受训，一个对应的技能专长及一项秘技。9级时，你获得专精提供的进阶秘技。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.class-features.Item.EpxKCi6G0KnWQhHP]

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 游击兵
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in close-quarters missions that require you to operate in crowded or tight spaces, such as inside buildings or vehicles, down narrow alleys, or in busy downtown streets. Whether you're a mugger, bodyguard, assassin, or urban mercenary, you favor pistols and can use them efficiently in tight spaces. You're trained in Acrobatics. You gain a skill feat for Acrobatics.

Exploit: You're trained to fight in close combat using pistols. Your ranged Strikes with one-handed ranged weapons don't trigger reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Enhanced Exploit: Your point-blank shots are particularly deadly. When you make a successful Strike against an adjacent enemy with a one-handed ranged weapon, you calculate the damage as if the lowest-rolled weapon damage die for the attack had the maximum result instead. At 17th level, the two lowest-rolled damage dice increase to the maximum result.
items.description:
你专精于在拥挤和狭窄的空间中执行近距离任务，如建筑物内部、载具内、狭窄的小巷和繁忙的商业街。无论你是抢劫犯、保镖、刺客还是城市雇佣兵，你偏爱手枪，并能在狭小空间内高效地使用它们。你在特技上受训，并获得一个特技技能专长。

秘技：你受到训练，在近距离冲突中使用手枪战斗。你使用单手远程武器的远程攻击不会触发因远程攻击而触发的反应。

进阶秘技：你的近距离射击格外致命。当你用单手远程武器对相邻敌人进行一次成功的打击时，你将掷出的最低的武器伤害骰视为最大值。在17级时，你将掷出的最低的两个伤害骰变为最大值。

items.name: 四平八稳
items.expectedDescription: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
items.description: 即使在恶劣的条件下，你也能轻易保持平衡。每当你检定成功地使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}动作时，改为大成功。你在狭窄平面和不稳地面尝试保持平衡时不会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

items.name: 迅捷处理器
items.expectedDescription: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.
items.description: 你可以快速识别周围的环境，你可以使用该信息来在危险中或在危险情况驾驶车辆时获得优势。你在用于掷骰先攻的察觉检定上获得+1环境加值，在用于掷骰先攻的驾驶（Piloting）检定上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 机动瞄准
items.expectedDescription: You're rarely still, and you've learned to reliably hit your targets even while moving. You Stride and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] with a gun you're wielding.
items.description: 你极少处于静止状态，并学会了在移动时也能准确地击中目标。你行走，然后用你正持握的一把枪械@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 商用型力场护盾
items.expectedDescription:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 6 Hit Points and replenishes 2 Hit Points on your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{Effect: Force Field 6}

Activate—Raise Force Field 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.
items.description:
力场护盾能够吸收伤害，其生命值取决于型号。启用期间，你将承受的任何物理或能量伤害，都会先从力场护盾的生命值中扣除，再从你的生命值中扣除，包括临时生命值。如果你举着盾牌，力场护盾和盾牌都会受到伤害。如果一次攻击或效果的伤害使力场护盾降至0生命值，你承受溢出的伤害，力场护盾关闭，并在10分钟内无法再次启动。启用的力场护盾每轮在你的回合开始时恢复所列数量的生命值。

如果你的力场护盾是战术型或更高型号，它还能保护你免受致命打击。每当你在力场护盾启用期间受到重击时，尝试一次对抗所列DC的纯骰检定。成功时，此次重击变为普通命中。

此力场护盾具有6生命值，在你的回合恢复2生命值。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{效果：力场护盾6}

启动—升起力场护盾 1（操作）

频率每日三次

效果你的力场护盾启用，持续1分钟或直到其生命值降至0。

items.name: 商用型爆燃手雷
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 Area Fire

Critical 5 feet

These grenades use an ignited chemical to explode in a blast of intense heat and deal 1d8 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save (@Template[burst|distance:5]). If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against incendiary grenades are knocked away from the grenade.
items.description:
启动 1区域射击

重击击退5尺

这类手雷点燃化学物质，引发炽热的爆炸，造成1d8点火焰伤害，并进行 @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] 豁免（@Template[burst|distance:5]）。如果你可以使用手雷的重击专精效果，对抗燃烧手雷的豁免检定大失败的生物会被推离手雷。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.expectedDescription: You need an infiltrator's toolkit to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.
items.description: 你需要渗透者工具包来用贼活技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]（部分类型）。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 专心致志
items.expectedDescription: You're highly focused on your target and able to discern their moves. When you roll a success on a Reflex or Will save against your mark, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 你的高度专注于目标，可以识别他们的行动。当你在对抗你标靶的反射豁免或意志豁免中成功时，将结果改为大成功。

items.name: 专精技能组
items.expectedDescription: At 3rd level, 7th level, and 15th level, you gain a skill feat. This feat must be for the trained skill from your operative's specialization.
items.description: 3级，7级，15级时，你获得一个技能专长。该专长必须是来自你的特工专精所提供的受训技能。

items.name: 抢人头
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An ally ends their turn after hitting a creature two or more times or critically hitting a creature.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a quick shot at a foe your ally is focusing their attacks on. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] at the creature your triggering ally hit and then make a ranged Strike against that creature.
items.description:
触发一个盟友在命中一个生物两次及以上或重击一个生物后结束他们的回合。

需求你持用一把枪械。

你向一个盟友正在全力攻击的生物打出一发快枪。你@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]你的触发盟友命中的生物，然后对该生物进行一次远程打击。

items.name: 族裔典范
items.expectedDescription: Whether through instinct, study, or magic, you feel a deeper connection to your ancestry. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat.
items.description: 凭借天性、研究或魔法的帮助，你与自己族裔的关联比常人更深。你获得一个1级族裔专长。

items.name: 夜视适应
items.expectedDescription: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark. You gain darkvision.
items.description: 你的眼部处理器中的纳米机已经适应了黑暗，增强了你在黑暗中的视力。你获得黑暗视觉。

items.name: 轻身落
items.expectedDescription: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
items.description: 模仿自猫的高空特技动作让你能够缓冲坠落的损伤。将坠落距离视为缩短10尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到专家，将坠落距离视为缩短25尺，达到大师后，缩短50尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到传奇，无论坠落距离多高，你始终能够以脚着地，不会受到任何伤害。

items.name: 全息影像怀疑者
items.expectedDescription: You easily spot the tiny glitches and imperfections in holograms. Even if you aren't Searching, you always attempt a check to disbelieve holograms and effects with the illusion and tech traits that normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or Interact with them.
items.description: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障与瑕疵。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜寻}，你也总会尝试检定以识破全息影像，以及那些具有幻术和科技特征、通常要求你搜寻或与其交互才能识破的效果。

items.name: 维斯克蜥人
items.expectedDescription: Vesk are a warmongering, reptilian people who conquered the eight worlds in their solar system shortly after they developed spaceflight, forming the Veskarium empire. Vesk tend to embrace conflict and respect strength and military might.
items.description: 维斯克是好战的爬行类种族，在发展出太空航行技术后不久，便征服了自己恒星系中的八个世界，建立维斯卡里姆帝国。维斯克倾向于拥抱冲突，尊重力量和军事威势。

items.name: 快步维斯克蜥人
items.expectedDescription: You come from a line of vesk who were constantly on the move. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
items.description: 你来自一群持续移动的维斯克蜥人。你的速度提高5尺。

items.name: 特种兵
items.expectedDescription:
You enlisted in a military or were recruited by a paramilitary group as a career trooper. As long as you've got enough guns and the right squad to back you up, you can handle just about anything.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Constitution, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and the Warfare Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j] feat.
items.description:
你作为一名职业特种兵入伍或被一支准军事组织招募。只要你有足够的枪支和正确的小队支持，你可以处理几乎任何事情。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或体质，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的运动技能和战争学识（Warfare Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.9S5mBcJujWOYCE6j]（Barricade）技能专长。

items.name: 设置障碍
items.expectedDescription: You hastily create a barricade using nearby items, junk, or debris. The barricade provides lesser cover for you and one other ally, though you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} to increase this benefit to standard cover. The barricade is flimsy and falls apart at the end of your next turn.
items.description: 你迅速利用附近的物品、垃圾或碎片建立一道障碍物。该障碍物为你和另一个盟友提供次等掩蔽，但你可以用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]动作来将这一好处提升为标准掩蔽。这个障碍物很脆弱，会在你下一个回合结束时散架。

items.name: 士兵
items.expectedDescription: You're a master of area weapons, heavy armor, and soaking damage. You fight in the thick of the battle and unleash devastating salvos against your foes as you take withering fire in return. By laying down a barrage of suppressing fire with powerful weapons, you set your allies up to fulfill their respective roles while encouraging enemies to focus on you.
items.description: 你精通区域武器和重甲，也擅长承受伤害。你奋战在战斗最激烈的地方，向敌人倾泻毁灭性的齐射，同时承受对方猛烈的还击。你以强大的武器铺设压制火力，吸引敌人将注意力集中在自己身上，为盟友各司其职创造条件。

items.name: 士兵战斗风格
items.expectedDescription:
As a soldier, you train using a specific style of fighting. Your style determines how you approach combat and often changes how you take advantage of your ability to suppress targets. Choose a soldier fighting style.

作为士兵，你专注于一种特殊战斗风格。你的风格决定了你如何战斗，以及你如何压制目标。选择一种士兵战斗风格。

items.name: 狂轰滥炸
items.expectedDescription:
There's nothing like a big gun (or maybe several) to get you through tough times. You've come to terms with the fact that a stray bullet from one of your barrages might sometimes hit an ally, but you try to minimize such instances of "friendly fire." You've trained to avoid harming allies with your barrages and learned to expertly position your attacks around them.

When you attack with an area weapon, you can select a number of allies within the area equal to half your Constitution modifier. The selected allies are unaffected by the attack. In addition, enemies who succeed (but not critically succeed) on their save against an area attack you make are still @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until the start of your next turn.
items.description:
没什么比一把或数把可靠的重炮更能让你克服艰难险阻。你已经接受这样一个事实：你的武器可能会击中你的盟友，但你会努力减少这种无意义的“友军伤害”。经过训练，你学会了在攻击中避开盟友，调整射击使其绕开他们。

当你使用区域武器攻击时，你可以在攻击区域中选择数量等同于你体质调整值一半的盟友。所选盟友免受你的攻击。此外，在你的区域攻击中豁免成功（但没有大成功）的敌人依然会@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]，直到你的下个回合开始。

items.name: 移动军械库
items.expectedDescription:
Your endurance training empowers you to carry a load of heavy equipment. When determining your Strength for using armor, you can instead choose to use your Constitution modifier. If you already meet the Strength requirement for the armor you're wearing, reduce that armor's Bulk by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

In addition, increase the amount of Bulk you can carry before becoming encumbered by half your Constitution modifier rounded up. Increase your maximum carried Bulk by your Constitution modifier.
items.description:
你的耐力训练使你能够携带大量重型装备。判定你穿戴护甲所用的力量时，你可以改用体质调整值。如果你已经达到了护甲的力量需求，你能将该护甲的负载减少1（最小为1）。

此外，你判定超载的负载上限增加你体质调整值的一半（向上取整）。你的最大负载上限增加你体质调整值。

items.name: 压制火力
items.expectedDescription: You have a knack for using powerful weapons to harry your foes and hinder their movement, preventing them from operating at their peak. When you make an attack with the area trait (such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]), you use it in a manner that suppresses your targets. Enemies in the affected area who fail their save against your attack become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until the start of your next turn. A suppressed target takes a –1 circumstance penalty on attack rolls and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds. Some soldier abilities and class feats interact further with the suppressed condition.
items.description: 你懂得如何使用强大的武器来阻碍敌人，并遏阻他们以全盛姿态行动。当你进行一次具有区域特征的攻击（例如来自@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]动作），你将以压制目标的方式来运用它。受影响区域内的生物如果没有成功通对你攻击的豁免，便会陷入@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF]状态，直到你的下个回合开始。被压制的目标在攻击骰上有-1环境减值，在速度上有-10尺状态减值。有些士兵能力和职业专长会和被压制状态产生进一步交互。

items.name: 主目标
items.expectedDescription: You can focus fire on a single target when unleashing the full devastation of your powerful area weaponry. Before you make an area attack with a weapon (such as from the Area Fire or Auto-Fire actions), you can make a ranged Strike as a free action with the same weapon against a single creature in the area, who's selected as your primary target. If your attack is a burst, you must select the creature closest to the center of the attack. If your attack is a cone or line, you must select the creature closest to you. If two or more creatures are equidistant, you can choose which one is your primary target. On a hit, if your primary target rolls a success against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire action, they get a failure instead. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty.
items.description: 当你完全倾泻手中强大武装的毁灭性火力时，你可以对一个目标制造尤为强大的火力。当你进行一次具有区域效果的攻击前（例如区域射击或自动射击动作），你可以以自由动作以相同的武器对区域中单个生物进行一次远程打击，将其作为你的主目标。如果你的攻击是爆发，你必须选择最接近攻击中心的生物。如果你的攻击为锥形或线形，你必须选择最接近你的生物。如果两个或两个以上的生物距离相等或最近，你可以选择其中一个作为你的主目标。如果你使用此次打击成功命中你的主目标，且目标对你的区域射击或自动射击掷骰出成功结果，其改为获得失败结果。此次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值。

items.name: 无所畏惧
items.expectedDescription: Whether it comes from a sense of duty or a desire to succeed, you rarely flinch when confronted by fearsome foes. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
items.description: 无论是出于使命感，还是对成功的渴望，当你面对广阔宇宙的恐怖时你鲜有退缩，并能用你的力量激励你的盟友。如果你在对抗恐惧效果的豁免骰掷出成功结果时，你改为获得大成功。

items.name: 快速切换
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You're wielding a two-handed weapon, and an enemy creature moves adjacent to you.

You can switch weapons in stressful situations so that you quickly set yourself up to punish incoming foes. You stow your current weapon and draw another two-handed weapon. If you have multiple sets of arms, you can instead Switch Hands.
items.description:
触发你正持用双手武器，并且一个敌对生物移动至和你相邻

你可以在紧张局势下切换武器，迅速做好准备，迎头痛击来袭的敌人。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 多什斧
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

The traditional weapon of the Veskarium, this powered poleaxe features one to three triangular blades forged for both wide overhead swings and tactical parrying.
items.description:
强化： 1

作为维斯卡里姆（Veskarium）的传统武器，这把动力长柄斧配有一至三枚三角刃，既适合大幅过顶挥击，也适合战术性格挡。

items.name: 机枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

These proven and reliable automatic weapons are capable of firing in short bursts or completely emptying their magazines to clear a battlefield.
items.description:
强化： 1

这些久经考验、可靠耐用的自动武器，既可以短点射，也能彻底打空弹匣，扫清战场。

items.name: 念力巨蜥护甲
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Flexible but sturdy plates layered together form this traditional armor worn by lashunta cavalry on Castrovel. In times past, a shotalashu cavalry member forged their armor from their mount's shed skin, or more rarely, the skin of a fallen mount, to honor them in future battles. Synthetic imitations are fashionable on some parts of Castrovel.
items.description:
强化： 1

这种由柔韧而坚固的甲片层叠制成的传统护甲，由卡斯卓韦（Castrovel）的拉申塔人（Lashunta）骑兵穿戴。过去，念力巨蜥骑兵（shotalashu cavalry）会用坐骑蜕下的皮，或更少见地用阵亡坐骑的皮制作护甲，以便在今后的战斗中纪念它们。合成仿制品在卡斯卓韦的某些地区颇为流行。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.

在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 趴爪族
items.expectedDescription: Pahtras are a humanoid feline species from a nearby star system. They're highly competitive and known for their achievements in magic, music, and war. Their home world was recently freed from the Veskarium's occupation, and they've joined the Pact Worlds.
items.description: 趴爪族是来自邻近恒星系的猫科类人生物。他们好胜心强，以魔法、音乐与战争领域的成就闻名。他们的母星最近摆脱了维斯卡里姆的占领，加入了协约世界。

items.name: 梅耶尔选民趴爪
items.expectedDescription: You have an undeniable streak of luck that you believe is a blessing from your ancestral god Meyel. You might come from a long line of mystics. Perhaps you were born at a holy site on Pulonis, or you reached out in fervent prayer at a time of crisis. Most of Meyel's chosen can point to at least one past event when their goddess might have intervened to save them from death or some other awful fate. Whether metaphorically or literally, you always seem to land on your feet. The first time each day that you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll the saving throw as a free action; this is a fortune effect.
items.description: 你有一股无法否认的好运气，你相信这是来自先祖之神梅耶尔的祝福。你可能出身于秘术师世家，可能出生在普洛尼斯上的一个圣地，也可能只是在危机时刻虔诚地祈祷。大多数梅耶尔的选民至少都能说出一件往事，那就是他们的女神曾经出手将他们从死亡或其他可怕的命运中拯救出来。无论是比喻义上还是字面意义上，你似乎总能“站稳脚跟”。每天第一次在豁免检定中大失败时，你可以使用一个自由动作立即重新进行一次豁免检定；这是一个幸运效果。

items.name: 偶像
items.expectedDescription:
Everybody wants their 15 minutes of fame, but for you, it's somehow become a lifestyle. Whether by luck or dedication, you're a star performer, celebrity, or popular influencer. Your face, voice, and style are commodities across known space, but for every adoring fan, there's a hater spreading gossip or paparazzi looking to capture your flaws.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.
items.description:
人人都想出名15分钟，但对你来说，这似乎已成为一种生活方式。无论是运气还是努力，你是一个出色的表演者、名人或受欢迎的影响者。你的面容、声音和风格是整个已知空间的商品，虽然崇拜你的粉丝很多，但是传播流言蜚语的黑粉以及试图挖你黑料的狗仔也同样多。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是体质或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的表演技能和媒体学识（Media Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]（Impressive Performance）技能专长。

items.name: 动人表演
items.expectedDescription: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
items.description: 你的表演令人钦佩，为你赢得粉丝。你可以使用表演代替交涉来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}。如果你在观众面前表演至少10分钟，就可以对完整观看了整场表演的至多10名观众建立印象，而不承受通常的减值。表演持续1小时时，目标数量增加至20名；持续2小时时，增加至50名。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.
items.description: 你是传导宇宙星辰之力的媒介——一名恒星骑士。引力与光代表这些力量的两极，而你可以在二者之间调整自身的调谐。作为这一循环的代行者，你显现出一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱恒星光谱的哪一极，你都可以在二者之间改变调谐，运用通过冥想和练习获得的恒星之力。

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

items.name: 星辰调谐
items.expectedDescription:
As a solarian, your existence cycles between the aspects of stars. You begin with two aspects: photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) and graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity). At any time, you're considered graviton-attuned, photon-attuned, or unattuned. Many of your abilities have additional effects based on your current attunement, and some abilities swap your current state of attunement to another state.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] action.
items.description:
作为一名恒星武士，星辰面相间的循环决定了你的存在。你初始拥有两种面相：光量子（photon，星辰散发出热量、光以及等离子体的力量）或引力子（graviton，星辰通过引力吸引和束缚物体的力量）。在任何情况下，你都处在引力子调谐、光量子调谐、或未调谐三种情况之一。你的许多能力都会根据你的当前调谐产生额外的效果，而有些能力则会将你的当前调谐转变成另一种情况。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]动作。

items.name: 光晕涌动
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your nimbus surges with energy, forcing an opening in your foe's defenses. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Graviton-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.

Photon-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.
items.description:
触发 你触及范围内的一个生物使用操作或移动动作，进行远程攻击，或者使用移动动作时离开一个方格。

你的光晕迸发能量，强行撕开敌人的防御。对触发生物进行一次近战打击。这次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，你的多重攻击减值也不应用于此次打击。

引力子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到其回合结束。

光量子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到其回合开始。

items.name: 重铸恒星武器
items.expectedDescription:
You spend 10 minutes focusing on the composition of your solar weapon. You can change your solar weapon's damage type (typically choosing between bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), selected traits, and weapon group. Your weapon maintains your selections until the next time you Re-Forge Solar Weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
你花费10分钟的时间专注于调整你恒星武器的构造。你可以更改武器的伤害类型（通常情况下在钝击、穿刺或挥砍之中选择），所选的武器特征，以及所属的武器组。恒星武器会始终保留你的选择，直至你下一次重铸恒星武器。

items.name: 调和
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per round

You steady your body and mind and attune yourself to the stellar aspect of your choice. You become attuned to photon or graviton. You can also manifest any of your solar manifestations if they're currently dormant and if you have the free hands to use them.

Special In addition to the above usage, you can also Attune as a free action when you roll initiative.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

频率 每轮一次

稳定身心，与所选的星辰面相调谐一致。你变得与光量子或引力子调谐。你可以也选择显现你的恒星显象，只要它们当前处于休眠状态，且你有一只空手来使用它们。

特殊 除了上述用法外，你可以在掷骰先攻时，以自由动作使用调和。
