items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 实光套装
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.
items.description:
强化： 1

固定在腰带或翻领上的投影器，用这层闪耀的硬光外壳包裹穿戴者的身体。军用制式硬光护甲遵循固定标准，而私人用户则能享用一系列可定制的时尚款式。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 星辰冲刺
items.expectedDescription:
You rush forward with a blast of stellar energy, getting into the thick of combat with ease. Stride twice. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during these moves.

Graviton-Attuned When you finish your Strides, enemies within 15 feet of you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save against your class DC. On a failure, they're pulled directly toward you, ending in an adjacent square if possible. You select the order these enemies are moved.

Photon-Attuned When you finish your Strides, you create a photon field in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on you. Until the start of your next turn, creatures outside the photon field are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to creatures inside the field.
items.description:
你在星辰能量的加持下冲刺向前，轻而易举地深入战场的中心。行走两次。在此次移动期间，你的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

引力子调谐当你完成行走时，你15尺内的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement]以对抗你的职业DC。失败时，敌人会被直线拉向你，直至其到达与你相邻范围内的一个方格（如果可能的话）。你可以选择敌人被拉向你的先后顺序。

光量子调谐当你完成行走时，你在以自身为中心的@Template[type:burst|distance:15]创造一个光量子场。直至你的下个回合开始，光量子场外部的生物对光量子场内的生物视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

items.name: 争胜之心
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An ally attempts a skill check with a skill that you have trained or better proficiency rank in.

You push yourself to be the best by competing with the triggering ally. Until the end of your next turn, you can attempt the same skill check to perform the same action or activity that the triggering ally performed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this skill check. If you achieve at least one degree of success higher than the triggering ally, this use of Competitive Spirit doesn't count toward its frequency. If you roll a critical failure on this skill check, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks attempted with that skill for the next hour as you try new techniques to improve your future attempts.
items.description:
频率每小时一次

触发一名盟友尝试进行你拥有受训或更高熟练度的技能检定

你通过与盟友竞争来激励自己变得更优秀。在你下一个回合结束之前，你可以尝试与触发争胜之心的盟友进行相同的技能检定，并且在此次技能检定中获得+2环境加值。如果你的成功度比触发该能力的盟友高一级，那么这次争胜之心不计入使用次数。若你在此项技能检定中出现大失败，接下来一小时内，当你尝试用新技巧改进后续尝试时，该技能的所有检定都将受到-1环境减值。

items.name: 星辰韧性
items.expectedDescription: Stellar energy flows throughout your entire being like an unstoppable tidal wave, strengthening both body and mind. Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to expert. When you roll a success on a Fortitude or Will save against a mental or incapacitation effect, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] as a free action.
items.description: 星辰能量如汹涌海潮般贯穿你的整个躯体，强化身心。你在强韧豁免上的熟练度提升至专家。当你在对抗心灵或失能效果的强韧或意志豁免上骰出成功结果时，你可以用自由动作进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]。

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 碎星冲击
items.expectedDescription:
You pour all your effort into making a single attack with your solar weapon that's so powerful it shatters the weapon. Strike with your solar weapon. The Strike deals one additional weapon damage die. Your solar weapon shatters and must be manifested to continue using it.

Graviton-Attuned On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]

Photon-Attuned On a hit, you additionally deal persistent fire damage equal to half your level, rounded up.
items.description:
你使用恒星武器使出倾尽全力的一击，其威力之强竟让你的恒星武器粉碎。使用你的恒星武器进行一次打击。此次打击额外造成一颗武器伤害骰的伤害。此后，你的恒星武器碎裂开来，你必须重新显现才能继续使用它。

引力子调谐命中时，目标在速度上承受-10尺状态减值，直到你的下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]

光量子调谐命中时，你对目标额外造成等同于你等级一半的持续火焰伤害，向上取整。

items.name: 飞跑
items.expectedDescription: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
items.description: 你的脚步变得更快。你的速度提高5尺。

items.name: 轻身落
items.expectedDescription: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
items.description: 模仿自猫的高空特技动作让你能够缓冲坠落的损伤。将坠落距离视为缩短10尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到专家，将坠落距离视为缩短25尺，达到大师后，缩短50尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到传奇，无论坠落距离多高，你始终能够以脚着地，不会受到任何伤害。

items.name: 磁力靴
items.expectedDescription: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. While active, they grant you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb metal surfaces as well as a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you when you're standing on a metal surface. In areas of zero gravity, while wearing a pair of magboots, you can move your Speed across metal surfaces and don't gain the untethered condition.
items.description: 磁力靴可以用一个交互动作启动或关闭。激活时，它们使你在用于攀爬金属表面的运动检定上获得+1物品加值；站在金属表面上时，你对抗以下检定的强韧DC或反射DC还会获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊} 你（当你站在金属表面上时）。在零重力区域内，穿戴一双磁力靴时，你可以沿金属表面移动至多你的速度，且不会获得失重状态。

items.name: 便携式放大器
items.expectedDescription: This small device is typically synced up to an instrument, microphone, or the audio playback on a datapad. It amplifies the audio volume, reducing the DC of Perception checks to hear the audio by 5.
items.description: 这款小型设备通常同步连接至乐器，麦克风或数据板的音频播放器上。其能放大音频音量，将听到音频的察觉检定的DC降低5点。

items.name: 商用型太阳镜
items.expectedDescription: Sunshades make everyone look cooler.
items.description: 太阳镜让任何人都显得更酷。

items.name: +1武器潜能水晶（恒星耀斑）
items.expectedDescription: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
items.description: 此物品将模拟恒星活动所需的专注凝为晶体。恒星武器或恒星耀斑的攻击检定获得+1物品加值，且该武器或耀斑可以从一颗轨道水晶中受益。

items.name: +1武器潜能水晶（恒星武器）
items.expectedDescription: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
items.description: 此物品将模拟恒星活动所需的专注凝为晶体。恒星武器或恒星耀斑的攻击检定获得+1物品加值，且该武器或耀斑可以从一颗轨道水晶中受益。

items.name: 恒星武士武器专家
items.expectedDescription: Your connection to stellar forces make your weapons lethal. Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons, martial weapons, and unarmed attacks increase to expert. Whenever you get a critical hit with your solar flare or solar weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.
items.description: 你与星辰力量的联结令你的武器致命无比。你在简易武器、军用武器以及无武装攻击上的熟练度提升至专家。你使用你的恒星耀斑或恒星武器造成重击时，你获得其重击专精效果。

items.name: 光晕结界
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You would be damage by an attack, spell, or other effect.

Requirements You're aware of the triggering effect and not offguard.

You harness your solar nimbus to protect yourself from harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (rounded up) until the start of your next turn. You choose the type of resistance when you use this action, depending on your current attunement.

You can use Nimbus Ward as a reaction only when the requirements and trigger are met, but you can use it as a 1-action activity without the requirements or trigger being met.

Graviton-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of damage: bludgeoning, force, piercing, or slashing.

Photon-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.
items.description:
触发你将要被一次攻击，法术或其他效果伤害。

需求你能够意识到触发效果且没有措手不及。

你驾驭恒星光晕保护自身免受伤害。你获得等同于你等级一半（向上取整）的抗力，直到你的下个回合开始。你在使用此动作时，根据你当前的调谐状态选择抗力的类型。

你只能在需求与触发满足时，以反应动作使用光晕结界，但你可以将其作为1动作行动使用，而无需满足需求与触发。

引力子调谐你的抗力可以是下列伤害类型之一：钝击、力场、穿刺或挥砍。

光量子调谐你的抗力可以是下列能量伤害类型之一：酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。

items.name: 战争眷恩
items.expectedDescription: You're an accomplished battledancer and warrior, blessed by seers, honed by ancestral tradition, and capable of feats beyond the natural abilities of your peers. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{Tailwind} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.
items.description: 你是技艺精湛的战舞者与战士，得到先知祝福，受祖传技艺磨砺，能作出超越同族天生能力的壮举。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{顺风奔行}，作为1环原能内在法术，每日可以施放一次。

items.name: 战斗攀爬
items.expectedDescription: Your techniques allow you to fight as you climb. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing and can Climb with a hand occupied. You must still use another hand and both legs to Climb.
items.description: 你拥有一边攀爬一边战斗的技术。你在攀爬期间不会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，并且能够在一只手被占用的情况下攀爬。你在攀爬时仍然必须用上另一只手和双腿。

items.name: 仿生人
items.expectedDescription: Androids first emerged as synthetic beings crafted by many technologically advanced civilizations throughout the galaxy. The first androids were created by humanoid peoples in their own images, but after the technology that animated the living constructs spread, androids began displaying a fantastic diversity of forms. Androids in the Pact Worlds were originally designed as servants, but today androids and other robotic beings stand as equals to organic ancestries under the Pact. Some androids have formed their own independent communities, while most integrate seamlessly into Pact Worlds societies. Unlike many other technological constructs, androids are more than intricate synthetic organs and complex programming, and each possesses their own soul.
items.description: 仿生人最初是星系中许多科技发达的文明制造的合成生命。最早的仿生人是类人生物按照自身形象创造的，但随着赋予这些活体构装体生命的技术传播开来，仿生人也开始呈现出千姿百态的形貌。协约世界的仿生人最初被设计为仆役，但如今，根据协约，仿生人与其他机器人生命已与有机族裔享有平等地位。一些仿生人建立了独立的社群，大多数则顺利融入协约世界的社会。与许多其他科技构装体不同，仿生人并不只是精密的合成器官与复杂的程序；每个仿生人都拥有自己的灵魂。

items.name: 构装体
items.expectedDescription: Your synthetic body resists ailments better than those of purely biological organisms. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.
items.description: 你的人造身体比单纯的生物机体更能抵抗疾患。你对疾病、毒素和辐射的豁免检定获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 改造狂热派仿生人
items.expectedDescription: You or your previous iterations have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades, enabling you to personally customize your body and its capabilities. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that you can use to install armor upgrades and that doesn't count toward your armor's total number of upgrades. You can install and uninstall armor upgrades into your personal upgrade slot using the Install Upgrade activity. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this armor upgrade already installed in your upgrade slot (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting upgrade).
items.description: 你或你前一次迭代已将你的身体兼容了护甲强化，可以让你自定义自己的身体和其功能。你的身体有一个护甲强化槽位。你可以使用安装强化模块（Install Upgrade）行动来安装或卸载护甲强化模块到你的强化模块槽位上。选择一项1级或以下物品等级的常见护甲强化模块。你初始时已在强化模块槽位上安装有此护甲强化模块（你不需要支付信用点来购买此初始强化模块）。

items.name: 黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets. The open networks known as infospheres are your home and the place you can do your best work. You're highly competent when it comes to cracking code or accessing secure data.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9] skill feat.
items.description:
你一直对计算机和虚拟空间很有天赋，并努力学习技术秘密。被称为信息圈的开放网络是你的家，也是你大展身手的地方。无论是破解代码还是访问加密数据，你都游刃有余。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或智力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的计算机技能和信息圈学识（Infosphere Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]（Phreaker）技能专长。

items.name: 电话黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've learned how to hack using alternative methods. You can use Computers to Disable a Device or Hack a system using any computer, comm unit, or terminal instead of a hacking toolkit. If you're an expert in Computers and the equipment you use is at least 3rd level, you gain a +1 item bonus to Disable a Device or Hack.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf] skill feat, you can use this feat to Combat Hack or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} without a hacking toolkit.
items.description:
你学会了以其他方法骇入。你可以用任意计算机、通讯器或终端，使用计算机技能解除装置或骇入系统，无需骇客工具包。如果你在计算机达到专家，且所用设备至少为3级，则你解除装置或骇入的检定获得+1物品加值。

特殊如果你具有@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]技能专长，就可以使用此专长，在没有骇客工具包的情况下进行战斗骇入或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}。

items.name: 特工
items.expectedDescription: You're a focused, quick-witted professional who thrives in high-stakes combat. Your deadly aim and tactical training give you an edge over the competition—for you, even the most powerful enemy is just another mark to take out. You have impressive prowess in your chosen field of specialization.
items.description: 你是专注而机敏的专业人士，在生死攸关的战斗中如鱼得水。致命的瞄准技巧与战术训练使你在较量中占优——对你而言，即使最强大的敌人也只是另一个需要解决的目标。你在自己选择的专精领域中拥有非凡的造诣。

items.name: 神射手
items.expectedDescription: You can spot a target's weak points, letting you deal additional precision damage with most types of ranged weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] action.
items.description: 你能看穿目标的弱点，令你可以用大多数类型的远程武器造成额外精准伤害。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]动作。

items.name: 特工专精

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 游击兵
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in close-quarters missions that require you to operate in crowded or tight spaces, such as inside buildings or vehicles, down narrow alleys, or in busy downtown streets. Whether you're a mugger, bodyguard, assassin, or urban mercenary, you favor pistols and can use them efficiently in tight spaces. You're trained in Acrobatics. You gain a skill feat for Acrobatics.

Exploit: You're trained to fight in close combat using pistols. Your ranged Strikes with one-handed ranged weapons don't trigger reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Enhanced Exploit: Your point-blank shots are particularly deadly. When you make a successful Strike against an adjacent enemy with a one-handed ranged weapon, you calculate the damage as if the lowest-rolled weapon damage die for the attack had the maximum result instead. At 17th level, the two lowest-rolled damage dice increase to the maximum result.
items.description:
你专精于在拥挤和狭窄的空间中执行近距离任务，如建筑物内部、载具内、狭窄的小巷和繁忙的商业街。无论你是抢劫犯、保镖、刺客还是城市雇佣兵，你偏爱手枪，并能在狭小空间内高效地使用它们。你在特技上受训，并获得一个特技技能专长。

秘技：你受到训练，在近距离冲突中使用手枪战斗。你使用单手远程武器的远程攻击不会触发因远程攻击而触发的反应。

进阶秘技：你的近距离射击格外致命。当你用单手远程武器对相邻敌人进行一次成功的打击时，你将掷出的最低的武器伤害骰视为最大值。在17级时，你将掷出的最低的两个伤害骰变为最大值。

You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.description: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障与瑕疵。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜寻}，你也总会尝试检定以识破全息影像，以及那些具有幻术和科技特征、通常要求你搜寻或与其交互才能识破的效果。

items.name: 大师射手

items.description: 你是枪不离身的顶级神射手。你在简易和军用枪械上的熟练提升为大师，在进阶枪械上的熟练提升为专家。你获得所有你具有专家熟练度武器的重击专精效果。

items.name: 先进瞄准系统

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} once per day as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell.
items.description: 你的眼部处理器配备了先进的瞄准系统，可以让你更容易地定位你的敌人并读取他们的动作。你可以施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{料敌机先}作为1环奥术内在法术，每日一次。

特工你学会了迅速移动，避开爆炸、哨戒炮塔以及更可怕的威胁。你的反射豁免熟练度提升至大师。反射豁免掷骰结果为成功时，改为大成功。

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, making you faster to react during combat. If you take the Incredible Initiative feat, your circumstance bonus to initiative rolls becomes +3 instead.
items.description: 你磨练出了对细节的洞察力。你的察觉熟练提升为大师。此外，你在先攻检定上获得+2环境加值，让你做战斗中能更快做出反应。如果你选择了惊奇先攻专长，你在先攻检定上的环境加值改为+3。

items.name: 武器专精
items.expectedDescription:
Envoy, Operative, Witchwarper You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 damage if you're a master, and 4 damage if you're legendary.

Mystic You've learned to protect yourself and your allies with your weapons. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master and 4 if you're legendary.

Solarian You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you've practiced with most. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master, and 4 if you're legendary.

Soldier You inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master, and 4 if you're legendary.
items.description:
使节、特工、织维巫师你学会了用自己最熟悉的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

秘术师你学会了用武器保护自己和盟友。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

恒星武士你学会了用自己最常练习的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

士兵你用最熟悉的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

items.name: 战术型力场护盾
items.expectedDescription:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 14 Hit Points and replenishes 3 Hit Points on your turn, and @Check[flat|dc:20].

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{Effect: Force Field 14}

Activate—Raise Force Field 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.
items.description:
力场护盾能够吸收伤害，其生命值取决于型号。启用期间，你将承受的任何物理或能量伤害，都会先从力场护盾的生命值中扣除，再从你的生命值中扣除，包括临时生命值。如果你举着盾牌，力场护盾和盾牌都会受到伤害。如果一次攻击或效果的伤害使力场护盾降至0生命值，你承受溢出的伤害，力场护盾关闭，并在10分钟内无法再次启动。启用的力场护盾每轮在你的回合开始时恢复所列数量的生命值。

如果你的力场护盾是战术型或更高型号，它还能保护你免受致命打击。每当你在力场护盾启用期间受到重击时，尝试一次对抗所列DC的纯骰检定。成功时，此次重击变为普通命中。

此力场护盾具有14生命值，在你的回合恢复3生命值，并使用@Check[flat|dc:20]。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{效果：力场护盾14}

启动—升起力场护盾 1（操作）

频率每日三次

效果你的力场护盾启用，持续1分钟或直到其生命值降至0。

items.name: 战术型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(3d6+6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 一触即发
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger The last creature you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{Aimed} at since the start of your last turn uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You attempt a ranged Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
items.description:
触发自你的上回合开始后，最后一个被你@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]{瞄准}的生物使用操作类或移动类动作、进行远程攻击，或在移动类动作中离开一个方格。

需求你持用一把枪械

你对触发生物进行一次远程打击。这次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，你的多重攻击减值也不适用于这个打击。

items.name: 飞扑卧倒
items.expectedDescription: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.
items.description: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速飞扑，找到可以伏身的地方。你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}，着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，随后立即@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，从而压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。

items.name: 夺取载具
items.expectedDescription: You Board and Take Control of an adjacent vehicle.
items.description: 你可以登上（Board）相邻载具并尝试接管操控（Take Control）。

items.name: 人类
items.expectedDescription: Humans are known for their ability to adapt and thrive in the most challenging situations, including the mysterious loss of their home world, Golarion. Ambitious, creative, and endlessly curious, humans maintain a robust presence in the galaxy, often taking on positions of leadership or acting at the forefront of exploration. Humans can be found almost anywhere, doing almost anything.
items.description: 人类以在最严峻的处境中适应并繁荣的能力闻名，即使母星格拉利昂神秘失落也不例外。人类野心勃勃、富于创造力且永远充满好奇心，在星系中占据稳固地位，经常担任领导者或站在探索的最前沿。几乎在任何地方，都能找到从事几乎任何事情的人类。

items.name: 熟练人类（交涉）
items.expectedDescription: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.
items.description: 你的聪明才智让你有机会擅长多种技能。你选择的一项技能获得受训熟练度。5级时，你在该所选技能上的熟练度提升至专家。

items.name: 法外狂徒
items.expectedDescription:
You're a career criminal with a nasty reputation. Perhaps unfair circumstances forced you into a life of crime, or maybe you enjoy the thrill you get from pulling off a heist or living through a shoot-out. Either way, this life is the only one you know, and thanks to the bounty on your head, you're in it until the casket drops or you make enough creds to buy a new one.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Intimidation skill and the Underworld Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k] skill feat.
items.description:
你是一个声名狼藉的职业罪犯。也许是不公平的环境迫使你走上了犯罪生涯，或者你享受从抢劫中获得的刺激感或经历火拼的快感。无论如何，你只熟悉这种生活——而悬赏令的存在，更让你注定无法脱身，要么横死街头，要么赚够钱买条新命。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是力量或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的威吓技能和黑道学识受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.zdycsO9Z0wHBZ17k]（Intimidating Shot）技能专长。

items.name: 威吓射击
items.expectedDescription: You attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} a foe with your ranged weapon by firing it into the air, using ammo equal to the weapon's expend and the weapon's maximum range rather than the usual range of 30 feet. This check doesn't take a –4 circumstance penalty if the target doesn't share a language with you.
items.description: 你尝试通过向空中开枪来对一个在你远程武器射程内的敌人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]，使用的弹药数量等于武器的耗弹量，使用武器的最大射程替代挫败士气通常的30尺范围。即便目标与你语言不通，此检定也不会受到-4环境减值。

items.name: 使节
items.expectedDescription: You're a master influencer. You make your way in the universe with a charming smile, quick wit, and keen sense of self-preservation. You're a leader who motivates your teammates, pushes them past their limits, and helps them through tough spots. You excel at getting others to do what you want, but you're always ready to face trouble head-on when things take a turn for the worse. You might be a con artist, diplomat, performer, or military officer—or you might take on whatever role the situation demands.
items.description: 你是影响他人的大师。你凭借迷人的微笑、敏捷的才思和敏锐的自保意识闯荡宇宙。你是激励队友、推动他们突破极限并助其渡过难关的领袖。你擅长让他人依照你的意愿行事，但在局势恶化时，也总准备好直面麻烦。你可能是骗子、外交官、表演者或军官，也可能根据局势的需要扮演任何角色。

items.name: 使节指令
items.expectedDescription:
Envoys encourage their allies with directives. A directive is an order that benefits allies who follow it. Envoy directives include a way for the envoy to lead by example by spending more actions for increased effects. Directives have the auditory or visual trait depending on how you inspire your allies.

You begin with one envoy directive. You can learn more directives through the envoy class, envoy class feats, and your leadership style. You can issue one directive a round. Unless otherwise stated, an envoy's directive and the benefits it grants last until the beginning of your next turn.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] envoy directive.
items.description:
使节通过指令来鼓励盟友。指令是对遵守指令的盟友有利的命令。使节指令包括让使节以身作则的方式，花费更多动作来获得更多效果。指令具有听觉或视觉特征，取决于你激励盟友的方式。

你初始有一个使节指令。你可以通过使节职业，使节职业专长，和你的领导风格学到更多指令。你每轮可以下达一个指令。除非另有说明，使节的指令及其赋予的增益会持续到你的下回合开始。

你获得“@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]”使节指令。

items.name: 领导风格
items.expectedDescription:
Whether it comes naturally, or you trained for it, you've developed a personal style of leading others. At 1st level, select a leadership style. You become trained in the indicated leadership skill, you gain the indicated leadership perk, and know the associated leadership directive.

items.name: 干掉他！
items.expectedDescription:
You single out an enemy for you and your allies to focus your attacks on. Select an enemy within 60 feet that you can see. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to attacks against that target until the beginning of your next turn.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, Strike the target. You gain a status bonus to the damage roll equal to your Charisma modifier. Regardless of whether the Strike hits, you and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to damage on subsequent Strikes made against the enemy until the start of your next turn. Increase the damage by 1 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.ey2zSEnprAGgvrij]
items.description:
你选定一名敌人，让自己和盟友集中攻击它。选择60尺内你能看见的一个敌人。你和盟友对该目标的攻击获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。

以身作则 若你使用了两个动作，打击该目标。你在伤害掷骰中获得等同于自身魅力调整值的状态加值。无论该次打击是否命中，你和盟友随后对该敌人进行打击时，伤害均获得+1状态加值，直到你的下个回合开始。此伤害在以下每个等级增加1：5、10、15与20级。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.ey2zSEnprAGgvrij]

items.name: 枪炮齐鸣
items.expectedDescription:
You lead your team by making an impression with firepower. Your bombastic personality has a barrage of gunfire to back it up, and you always shoot first.

Leadership Skill Acrobatics

Leadership Perk You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2kwXTUjYYhoAGySr]{Incredible Initiative} as a bonus feat.

Leadership Directive @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.RNilk6Evoi0xNbWX]
items.description:
你带领团队，以强大的火力给人留下深刻印象。你张扬的性格背后是密集的枪声，而你总是先发制人。

领导技能特技

领导奖励你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.2kwXTUjYYhoAGySr]作为奖励专长。

领导指令 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.RNilk6Evoi0xNbWX]

items.name: 准备武器！
items.expectedDescription:
With quick commands, you get your allies to ready their equipment. You and all allies within 30 feet can Interact to draw, Switch Hands, or swap weapons as a free action.

Lead by Example If you used two actions, you can Strike, Area Fire, or Auto-Fire with a weapon you drew or swapped to (including by changing active set of hands). If your Strike hits or if a target failed its save against your Area Fire or Auto-Fire, one ally can make a Strike against the same target as a reaction.
items.description:
通过快速的命令，你让盟友准备好他们的装备。你和30尺内所有盟友可以用一个自由动作交互拔出武器、换手（Switch Hands）、切换武器。

以身作则如果你使用两个动作，你可以用你拔出或切换的武器（包括改变主动手）进行打击，区域射击，或自动射击。如果你的打击命中或目标对抗你的区域射击或自动射击豁免失败，一名盟友可以用一个反应动作对相同目标进行打击。

items.name: 惊奇先攻
items.expectedDescription: You react more quickly than others can. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls.
items.description: 你的反应比他人更迅速。你的先攻检定获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 短刀
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Invaluable as both a weapon and a tool, knives come in a variety of shapes, styles, and materials ranging from starmetals to ceramics.
items.description:
强化： 1

刀兼具武器和工具价值，有各种形状和样式，材料则从星金到陶瓷不一而足。

items.name: 商用型医疗包
items.expectedDescription: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}.
items.description: 这些医疗包包含了对于@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]，@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]的医疗检定所必需的镇痛剂，绷带，无菌纱布以及缝合工具。医疗包是一种工具包。

items.name: 第二皮肤
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 0

Soft but resilient fabric contours perfectly to the wearer's body, offering basic protection without sacrificing comfort. Second skin is commonly worn underneath casual clothing.
items.description:
强化： 0

柔软而坚韧的面料完美贴合穿戴者的身体，在不牺牲舒适度的情况下提供基础防护。第二皮肤通常穿在日常衣服里面。

items.name: 半自动手枪
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:
强化： 1

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 商用型黑客工具包
items.expectedDescription: A hacking toolkit is required for Computers checks to Hack computers. You can use a hacking toolkit to access a computer without using a user interface, but this requires physical contact with the computer or contact via an infosphere or a similar linked network.

items.name: 评估
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

You spend 1 minute observing a specific individual, 10 minutes researching a specific individual on the infosphere, or 1 hour networking and gathering information. This subject is your asset. If you assess your asset via observation, you don't need to know their identity, but if you assess your asset via research or networking, you must know their identity, which requires at least two relevant pieces of information about them. Examples of relevant information could include their name, their place of origin, their current residence, the name of their parent or significant other, their employer, or their organizational affiliation. The GM determines what constitutes relevant information for this purpose, based on the asset you've selected.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Perception checks against or in relation to your asset, and a +1 circumstance bonus to attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about your asset.

You gain the benefits of the 2-action @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy] when using 1-action Get 'Em! on an asset.

You can maintain a number of assets equal to your Charisma modifier. If you Size Up other assets after that, your new asset replaces a previous one.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.XRjekIgkv8qsAxJv]{Effect: Size Up}
items.description:
频率每小时一次

你花费1分钟观察一名特定个体，花费10分钟在信息圈上研究一名特定个体，或花费1小时拓展人脉并搜集信息。此人即为你的情报对象。如果你通过观察评估情报对象，无需知道其身份；但若通过研究或人脉评估情报对象，你必须知道其身份，这至少需要两条与其相关的信息。相关信息的例子包括姓名、出生地、当前住址、父母或伴侣的姓名、雇主或所属组织。GM根据你所选的情报对象，决定什么属于适用的相关信息。

你针对情报对象或与其有关的欺骗、交涉、威吓及察觉检定获得+1环境加值，且你尝试对情报对象@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}时获得+1环境加值。

你对情报对象使用单动作的干掉他！时，获得双动作@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.cmCtfURzpbzkxWsy]的好处。

你可以维持等于自身魅力调整值数量的情报对象。此后，若你再评估其他情报对象，新对象会取代一个之前的对象。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 希伦虫人
items.expectedDescription:
The insectile shirrens split from the destructive Swarm, forsaking the ruthless hive mind to pursue personal freedom and end the cycle of interstellar violence. Shirrens are a species of telepaths devoted to their own individualism, building chosen communities, and living in harmony with other peoples.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.RM78QDGhVPlPrcvG]{Shirren}
items.description:
昆虫般的希伦虫人脱离了破坏性的虫群，舍弃其冷酷无情的集体心智，转而追求个人自由，并终结星际暴力的循环。希伦虫人拥有心灵感应能力，珍视个体独立，建立自主选择的社群，并与其他族群和谐共处。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.journals.JournalEntry.Cf6Ej0OgFpqg2VoF.JournalEntryPage.RM78QDGhVPlPrcvG]{希伦虫人}

items.name: 有限心灵感应
items.expectedDescription: You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
items.description: 你可以与30尺内的生物以心灵交流，但只能与和你具有共同语言的生物交流。这不会让你读取它们的思想，传递的信息也不会多于普通言语所能表达的内容。

items.name: 叛逆希伦虫人
items.expectedDescription: Despite the passage of time, you remain resolute in your defiance of the Swarm and all forms of mental control. If you roll a success on a Will saving throw against an effect that was created by a creature with the kucharn trait or a creature that you know is allied with the Swarm, you get a critical success instead. You gain these benefits against any creature affected by a spell or effect that controls it. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.nAJeT29ZJvqeg98h] action.
items.description: 时光流逝，你依然坚定反抗虫群和一切形式的心灵控制。当你进行意志豁免，对抗具有虫族特征的生物或你知道与虫群结盟的生物所创造的效果时，若掷骰结果为成功，则改为大成功。对抗任何受到控制其行为的法术或效果影响的生物时，你也获得这些益处。此外，你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.nAJeT29ZJvqeg98h]动作。

items.name: 叛逆反抗
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per day

Effect You decry one foe within 100 feet that you can see as a tyrant or villain and prepare yourself to defy them, even until death. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on your attack rolls against this foe, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the attacks, spells, and effects of this foe. These benefits last for 1 minute.
items.description:
频率每日一次

效果你谴责100尺内一个你能看见的敌人是暴君或恶徒，并决意反抗它，即使付出生命也在所不惜。你对该敌人的攻击检定获得+1环境加值，且对抗该敌人的攻击、法术和效果的豁免获得+1环境加值。这些益处持续1分钟。

items.name: 门徒
items.expectedDescription:
You're a loyal disciple of a particular deity. You might have been raised in a religious culture or perhaps felt a kindred calling toward a god later in life, but you've honed your skills and devoted your life to living as a follower of that deity.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be an attribute specified in your deity's Divine Attribute entry, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the deity's listed divine skill and a Lore skill related to your deity (Abadar Lore, for example). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.NY2R5hNgdkSRPkTV] skill feat even if you do not meet the feat's prerequisites.
items.description:
你是某个特定神祇的忠实门徒。你可能在成长中受到某种宗教文化熏陶，或者在后来的生活中感受到了对这位神的召唤，但你已经磨练了自己的技能，并致力于作为这位神的信徒生活。

选择两项属性提升。一项须是与该神的神圣属性（Divine Attribute）相关的属性，另一项为自选属性提升。

你在神祇的神圣技能和神祇相关的学识（例如阿巴达尔学识）上受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.NY2R5hNgdkSRPkTV]技能专长且无需满足该专长的先决条件。

items.name: 神圣护符
items.expectedDescription: You can construct and bless a religious symbol of your deity in 10 minutes. While such talismans are traditionally scraps of paper with a religious symbol drawn on them, they can take many forms, including body art, a sticker, or even a virtual emoji. You can create a talisman only for yourself and for the deity you worship. As long as you continue to engage in activities that match your deity's edicts you gain a +1 status bonus to initiative rolls. If you violate your deity's anathema, the talisman is destroyed, and you take a –1 status penalty to initiative rolls and Perception checks until you complete an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.
items.description: 你可以在10分钟内制作并祝福一个属于所信神祇的宗教徽记。这些护符传统上是画有宗教徽记的纸片，但也能采用许多形式，包括身体绘画、贴纸，甚至虚拟表情符号。你只能为自己制作护符，且必须属于你所崇拜的神祇。只要你持续从事符合神祇敕令的活动，先攻检定便获得+1状态加值。如果违反神祇的禁忌，护符便被摧毁，且你在先攻检定和察觉检定上承受–1状态减值，直到完成一次@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{赎罪}仪式。

items.name: 秘术师
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit, channeling the fundamental forces that connect and bind everything in the cosmos. You can draw upon this supernatural wellspring to form deep spiritual bonds with your allies, empower them in combat, and restore their health should they become injured. Your powers take unique shape based on the connection you choose, granting new and more powerful spells as you explore your connection on a deeper level.
items.description: 你是传导者，引导着连接并维系宇宙万物的基本力量。你可以汲取这股超自然源泉，与盟友建立深厚的灵性纽带，在战斗中强化他们，并在他们受伤时恢复其健康。你的力量因所选联结而呈现独特形态；随着你对联结的探索不断深入，你将获得新的、更强大的法术。

items.name: 命能网络
items.expectedDescription:
Your soul supports a network of energy that connects and heals those in your bond. Your vitality network has a maximum capacity equal to 6 + 4 Hit Points per level. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG] action that you can use to take Hit Points out of your network and into yourself or your allies as healing.

Life-and-death situations help strengthen your bonds with your allies. At the start of each turn in combat, when you regain actions, your vitality network regains 4 Hit Points; if you're master in spell DC, it regains 6 Hit Points instead; if you're legendary, it regains 8 Hit Points. When you Refocus, your vitality network regains all its Hit Points.
items.description:
你的灵魂支持着一个连结并治愈你纽带中生物的能量网络。你的命能网络具有等同于6+每等级4点生命值的最大容量。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]动作，可以用来从你的网络中提取生命值并将其转移到自己或盟友身上进行治疗。

生死攸关的情况有助于加固你与盟友的纽带。在战斗中每回合开始，当你重新获得动作时，你的命能网络会恢复4点生命值；如果你的法术DC为大师熟练度，它改为恢复6点生命值；如果你达到传奇熟练度，它会恢复8点生命值。当你再聚能时，你的命能网络会恢复全部生命值。

items.name: 联结
items.expectedDescription:
All mystics have a supernatural connection with a cosmic force that grants magical powers. The exact nature of your connection can vary widely—you might worship a god or pantheon, embody a metaphysical concept, become a conduit for nature's wrath, or something else. Even mystics who share the same connection might interpret the source of their powers differently. At 1st level, choose your connection. Your chosen connection determines the type of spells you cast and the spell tradition you choose spells from, your additional trained skill, the epiphanies you learn, and a harmony that usually grants creatures a special benefit when you heal them with your vitality network.

所有秘术师都与赋予魔法力量的宇宙伟力有着超自然的联结。你联结的具体性质可以有很大的不同——你可能崇拜一位神或万神殿，具现为一种形而上的概念，成为自然之怒的传导者，或是其他形态。即使是拥有相同联结的秘术师也可能对力量来源作出不同解读。1级时，选择你的联结。你所选的联结决定了你施放的法术类型和法术根源，你的额外受训技能，你掌握的顿悟，以及一种协调，一种在你用命能网络治愈生物时通常会赋予它们的特殊增益。

items.name: 转移命能
items.expectedDescription: You can transfer up to 10 Hit Points (minimum 1) from your vitality network into yourself or a bonded creature you can sense within 60 feet. This works on creatures with void healing as though this action had the void trait. The amount you can transfer increases by 10 at 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th level.
items.description: 你能从你的命能网络中转移至多10点生命值（最小1点）到你自身或60尺内一名你能感知到纽带中的生物身上。这能对具有虚能治疗的生物生效，如同此动作具有虚能特征。你能转移的数值分别在5级，10级，15级和20级时增加10点。

items.name: 阴影
items.expectedDescription:
You know every shadow is a portal to the Netherworld, and like an artist molding clay, you sculpt that realm's shadowy substance into dreadful and wondrous shapes at your whim.

Tradition divine

Connection Skill Stealth

Connection Spells cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}; 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}; 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XXqE1eY3w3z6xJCB]{Invisibility}; 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WsUwpfmhKrKwoIe3]{Slow}; 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zR67Rt3UMHKC5evy]{Flicker}; 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IqJ9URobmJ9L9UBG]{Shadow Blast}; 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WPXzPl7YbMEIGWfi]{Mislead}; 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0jadeyQIItIuRgeH]{Eclipse Burst}; 8th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wfleiawxsfhpRRwf]{Disappearance}; 9th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MJx7DmjsWYzDZ3a4]{Phantasmagoria}

Epiphany Spells initial: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.uh9Br4yrKvJA6zq0]; advanced: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.rluzzX2ml4yFWnYw]; greater: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.pgjlPNfXCpEYyLVu]

Harmony When you Transfer Vitality, the target's shadow darkens and swells, reducing bright light within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] of the target to dim light. This is a form of magical darkness and can overcome non-magical light sources or attempt to counteract magical light. The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} while in this dim light and can use the concealed condition to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide}. This lasts until the end of your next turn.

Perfect Harmony You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.u9NU2bULHg3S5FaP] action. When you Transfer Vitality, the target can use this action once before the end of their next turn.
items.description:
你知道每一片阴影都是通往影界的大门，如同艺术家捏塑黏土，你随心所欲地将那片领域的阴影物质塑造成令人战栗又充满奇迹的形态。

items.name: 初等顿悟
items.expectedDescription:
You discover the basic truth of your connection. You learn your chosen connection's initial epiphany spell. Epiphany spells are a type of focus spell. It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell, and you start with a focus pool of 1 Focus Point. You refill your focus pool during your daily preparations, and you can regain 1 Focus Point by spending 10 minutes using the Refocus activity to spend time with your bonded allies or otherwise ponder the nature of your connection.

Focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up, much like cantrips. Focus spells don't require spell slots, and you can't cast them using spell slots. Taking feats can give you more focus spells and increase the size of your focus pool, though your focus pool can never hold more than 3 Focus Points.
items.description:
你发现了你联结中最基本的真理。你获得了所选联结的初始顿悟法术。顿悟法术是一种聚能法术。施放聚能法术需要消耗1点聚能点，并且你在开始时拥有一个1点聚能点的聚能池。你在每日准备时重新填满你的聚能池，你可以通过花费10分钟使用再聚能行动来恢复1点聚能点，这包括与纽带中的盟友共度时光，或思考你联结的本质。

聚能法术会自动升阶到你等级的一半，向上取整，和戏法类似。聚能法术无需法术位，你也不能使用法术位来施放它们。获取专长能够赋予你聚能法术并增大你的聚能池，不过你的聚能池不能容纳超过3点聚能点。

items.name: 秘术师施法
items.expectedDescription:
You are a spellcaster and can cast spells using the Cast a Spell activity. As a mystic, when you cast spells, you might intone a prayer or hum a song inspired by your epiphanies, you might gesture or dance in patterns that follow the flow of your connection's network, and you might accompany your spellcasting with wisps of energy flowing between you and your bonded allies.

Each day, you can cast up to three 1st-rank spells. You must know spells to cast them, and you learn them via the spell repertoire class feature. The number of spells you can cast each day is called your spell slots.

As you increase in level as a mystic, your number of spells per day increases, as does the highest rank of spells you can cast, as shown on the Mystic Spells per Day table.

Some of your spells require you to attempt a spell attack to see how effective they are or have your enemies roll against your spell DC (typically by attempting a saving throw). Since your key attribute is Wisdom, your spell attack modifiers and spell DCs use your Wisdom modifier.

Heightening Spells

When you get spell slots of 2nd rank and higher, you can fill those slots with stronger versions of lower-rank spells. This increases the spell's rank to match the spell slot. You must have a spell in your spell repertoire at the rank you want to cast in order to heighten it to that rank. Many spells have specific improvements when they're heightened to certain ranks. The signature spells class feature lets you heighten certain spells freely.

Cantrips

Some of your spells are cantrips. A cantrip is a special type of spell that doesn't use spell slots. You can cast a cantrip at will, any number of times per day. A cantrip is automatically heightened to half your level rounded up—this is usually equal to the highest rank of mystic spell slot you have. For example, as a 1st-level mystic, your cantrips are 1st-rank spells, and as a 5th-level mystic, your cantrips are 3rd-rank spells.
items.description:
你是一名施法者，并且可以使用施法行动进行施放法术。作为一名秘术师，当你施放法术时，你可能会吟唱祷词或哼唱受顿悟启发的歌谣，你可能会用手势或舞蹈来追随你联结网络的流变，又或许会在施法时让能量丝缕在你与纽带中的盟友间流淌。

每天，你可以施放至多三个1环法术。你必须知晓法术才能施放它们，你可以通过法术库职业特性来学习它们。你每天可以施放的法术数量称作你的法术位。

随着你秘术师等级的提高，你每日的法术数量也会随之增加，你可施放的最高法术环级同样随之提升，如秘术师每日法术表所示。

一些法术需要你尝试法术攻击来判断他们多有效，或让你的敌人掷骰对抗你的法术DC（通常是尝试豁免骰）。因为你的关键属性是感知，你的法术攻击调整和法术DC都使用你的感知调整值。

升阶法术

当你获得2环级以及更高环级的法术位时，你可以在这些法术位施放较低环级的法术的强化版本。这会增加这些法术的环级，升阶到所消耗法术位的环级。你必须在法术库中拥有法术的该环级版本才能将法术升阶至某一环级。许多法术在升阶至特定环级时有特定的效果提升。标志性法术职业能力可以让你自由升阶特定的法术。

戏法

你的部分法术为戏法。戏法是一类特殊的不使用法术位的法术。你可以随意施放戏法，每日任意次数。戏法总是会自动升阶到你的等级的一半并向上取整——这通常等于你拥有的秘术师最高环法术位环级。例如，作为一个1级秘术师，你施放的戏法为1环；作为5级秘术师时，你的戏法是3环法术。

items.name: 秘术纽带
items.expectedDescription:
You form a bond between yourself and others, most typically your closest companions. Forming bonds is different for every mystic but always involves using a 10-minute activity related to the mystic's connection that requires you to be adjacent to the creature with whom you wish to bond. You can maintain a bond with up to 10 other willing creatures, and the bond lasts until you or the bonded creature are no longer willing to be part of the bond. You are always considered part of your own bond and don't count toward the 10-creature limit.

You always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, their Hit Point totals, and if they're conscious, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, or dead. This ability doesn't work across planes (including when in transit in the Drift), and some special magical or technological effects might interfere with your ability to detect your allies.
items.description:
你在自己和他人之间建立纽带，通常是与你最亲密的伙伴。秘术师们建立纽带的具体方式各不相同，但都需要花费一个和秘术师的联结相关的10分钟行动。你可以与至多10个其他自愿的生物建立纽带，并且纽带一直持续到你或某个被建立纽带的生物不再自愿成为纽带的一部分。你自己总是被认为是你纽带中的一部分，并且不计入10个生物的上限。

你总是知道其他联结生物的大致距离和方向，他们的生命值总数，以及它们是清醒、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]、@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]还是死亡。这种能力在跨位面（包括漂流域中的通行）时不起作用，一些特殊的魔法或科技效果可能会干扰你侦测盟友的能力。

items.name: 法术库
items.expectedDescription:
Mystic The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your chosen connection. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your chosen connection or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same rank to your spell repertoire. When you gain access to a new rank of spells, your first new spell is always the spell granted by your chosen connection, but you can choose the other spells. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your chosen connection and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might select a higher-rank version of a spell you already know so that you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your spell repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out epiphany spells or connection spells. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

Witchwarper The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and four cantrips of your choice as well as an additional spell and cantrip from your paradox. You choose these from the common spells from the tradition corresponding to your paradox. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell rank.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell to your spell repertoire of the same rank. At 2nd level, select another 1st-rank spell; at 3rd level, you gain a new spell from your paradox and two other 2nd-rank spells, and so on. When you add spells, you might add a higher-rank version of a spell you already have, so you can cast a heightened version of that spell.

Though you gain them at the same rate, your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, it wouldn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire

As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. This spell can be a cantrip, but you can't swap out spells gained from your paradox. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.
items.description:
秘术师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及来自你联结的额外法术和戏法。你从你联结对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术，或者从你获得许可的其他源自你魔法根源的法术中进行选择。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。当你获得新的法术环位时，你的第一个新法术总是对应环级的来自你联结的授予法术，然后你可以选择其他你获取的法术。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，可能会想替换之前学过的部分法术。每次你升级并学习新法术时，可以将一个旧法术替换为另一个同环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但你不能替换顿悟法术或联结法术。你也可以通过休整期重训替换法术。

织维巫师你可施放的法术集合被称为法术库。1级时，你将学会所选的两个1环法术和四个戏法，以及悖论赋予你的额外法术和戏法。你从你悖论对应的魔法根源中的常见法术里选择这些法术。你可以使用对应环级的法术位施展任何你法术库中的法术。

你在提升等级时也会在法术库中加入新法术。每当你获得一个法术位时，你将一个同环的法术加入法术库。2级时，你选择另一个1环法术；3级时，你获得一个新的授予法术并且选择其他两个2环法术，以此类推。当你添加法术时，你可以添加已有法术的高级版本，这样你就可以施展这个法术的升阶版本了。

虽然获得的速度相同，你的法术位和法术库中的法术是分离的。如果一个专长或者其他能力将法术加入你的法术库中，你不会获得另一个法术位，反之亦然。

替换你法术库中的法术

当你在法术库中获得新的法术时，你可能会想要替换之前学习的一些法术。每次你获得新的等级学习新的法术时，你可以将一个旧法术置换为一个同一环级的不同法术。被替换的法术可以是戏法，但是你不能替换悖论的授予法术。你也可以通过休整期重训来替换法术。

items.name: 宗-莎琳
items.expectedDescription:
The Embrace

Zon-Shelyn is the divine reunion of Shelyn the Eternal Rose and her estranged brother, the Midnight Lord Zon-Kuthon. Together, the siblings represent the concepts of overcoming suffering through art, finding beauty in strange and unusual places, and reunion with lost loved ones.

Areas of Concern art, alternative fashion, creativity, music, pain, strange beauty

Edicts channel your pain into art, seek beauty in all places, express yourself creatively according to your own aesthetics

Anathema suffer in silence, destroy or copy another's creative works, conform to society's beauty standards
items.description:
美暗拥一

宗-莎琳是永恒玫瑰莎琳与她疏远已久的兄长、午夜领主宗-库松的神性重聚。兄妹二神共同代表着通过艺术克服痛苦、在奇异罕见之处发现美，以及与失散的挚爱重逢的理念。

关注领域艺术、另类时尚、创造力、音乐、痛苦、奇异之美

典范将自身痛苦融入艺术，在所有地方寻找美，根据自己的美学创造性地表达自己

禁忌默默忍受痛苦，破坏或复制他人的创作作品，屈从于大众的审美标准
