items.name: 侦测魔法
items.expectedDescription:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).
items.description:
你发出一股标记魔法存在的脉冲。你不会获得魔法存在或不存在以外的任何信息。你可以选择忽略你完全知晓的魔法，例如你或者你盟友的魔法物品以及持续法术。仅当幻术魔法的环阶低于你的侦测魔法环阶时，你才能侦测幻术魔法。但是，具有幻术灵光但是没有在外表上做伪装的物品（例如一瓶隐形药水），通常能够正常侦测。

升阶（3环阶） 你能知晓法术侦测出的最强魔法效果的环阶或等级，具体由GM决定。

升阶（4环阶） 如3环阶，你也能指出最高环阶魔法的来源。如同一种模糊感官，你不会了解具体的位置，但是可以将来源锁定到5尺立方（或者最近的那个五尺立方，如果来源体积比这个区域更大）。

items.name: 虚构幻术
items.expectedDescription:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}
items.description:
你创造出简单的声音或图像的幻术。声音会为法术添加听觉特征，且不能包含能被理解的单词或复杂的音乐。图像会为法术添加视觉特征，但是它不能大于5尺边长的立方体，且在15尺的距离内观察会发现它的构造明显很粗糙且缺乏细节。当你施放或维持该法术时，你能尝试用幻术让人@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}，这会为你的欺骗检定提供+2环境加值。若对某个生物进行的此尝试失败了，该生物便识破虚构幻术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{法术效果：虚构幻术}

items.name: 伤口回响
items.expectedDescription:
You manifest an injury from the future or past to harm a creature in the present. Choose bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. The target takes 1d8 of the selected damage type with a basic Will save. If the target fails its save and then takes the same type of damage before the end of your next turn, it takes an additional @Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a failure increases by 1d4.
items.description:
你自未来或者过去具现出一道伤口来伤害当下的生物。选择钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，目标受到1d8所选类型伤害，具有一次基础意志豁免。如果目标豁免失败，并且在你的下个回合结束前受到了相同类型的伤害，其还会额外受到@Damage[ceil((@item.level)/2)d4[persistent,bleed]]伤害。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加1d8，豁免失败时的持续伤害增加1d4。

items.name: 光亮术
items.expectedDescription:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{Spell Effect: Light}

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).
items.description:
你创造一个光球，它发出由你选择的颜色的光芒，在20尺半径内产生明亮光照（以及接下来的20尺产生昏暗光照）。如果你在一个自愿生物所占据的空间内创造光球，你可以将光球连结到该生物，使光球在该生物附近悬浮，并随其移动。你可以维持法术以移动光球至多60尺，作为这个移动的一部分，你可以将光球连结到一个生物或是从一个生物上解除连结。

你可以解消该法术。若你已经有4个光亮术生效时施放此法术，你必须结束一个已存在的法术。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.cVVZXNbV0nElVOPZ]{法术效果：光亮术}

升阶（4环） 光球在60尺半径内产生明亮光照（并在接下来的60尺产生昏暗光照）。

items.name: 跌绊术
items.expectedDescription:
A burst of microgravity causes a tremor around the target, pulling it toward the ground. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 10 feet downward.

Critical Failure The target falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If the target was flying, swimming, or floating, it falls 20 feet downward.

Heightened (+1) If the target falls, it falls an additional 5 feet on a failure and 10 feet on a critical failure.
items.description:
一阵微弱重力会在目标周围造成震颤，将其拉向地面。目标尝试反射豁免。

失败目标会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]1轮。如果目标是在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落10尺。

大失败目标@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]。如果目标正在飞行、游泳或漂浮，则会向下坠落20尺。

升阶（+1） 如果目标在飞行，失败时会额外向下坠落5尺，大失败时会额外向下坠落10尺。

items.name: 力场飞弹
items.expectedDescription:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.
items.description:
你发射出一道固态的魔力碎片，射向一个你能看见的生物。它自动命中，并造成1d4+1力场伤害。你施放该法术时每额外使用一个动作，你射出的碎片增加一个，最大为3个动作发射三个碎片。你为每个碎片分别选择目标。如果你对同一个目标射击超过1个碎片，将伤害合计后再计算伤害加值，减值，抗力，弱点等。

升阶（+2） 你花费的每个动作额外射出一枚碎片。

items.name: 移变激涌
items.expectedDescription:
You release a surge of magical energy that temporarily changes the type of damage dealt by a weapon. The next Strike the weapon makes deals your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage and deals an additional 1d6 extra damage of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.

Heightened (+2) The extra damage increases by 1d6.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]
items.description:
你释放出一股魔法能量，暂时改变目标武器造成的伤害类型。使用该武器的下一次打击会造成酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰、音波中由你选择的一种伤害类型，并且额外造成1d6伤害，类型为武器正常的伤害类型。

升阶（+2）额外伤害增加1d6。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.pWm0NCsxjxTUCJ7y]

items.name: 雷击术
items.expectedDescription:
You call down a tendril of lightning that cracks with thunder, dealing 1d12 electricity damage and 1d4 sonic damage to the target with a basic Reflex save. A target wearing metal armor or made of metal takes a –1 circumstance bonus to its save, and if damaged by the spell is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 electricity and 1d4 sonic.
items.description:
你呼唤一道伴随着雷鸣之声的闪电，对目标造成1d12点电击伤害和1d4点音波伤害，基础反射豁免。穿戴金属护甲或者由金属构成的生物在豁免中承受-1环境减值，若它们受到该法术的伤害，会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙 1}，持续1轮。

升阶（+1） 伤害增加1d12点电击以及1d4点音波。

items.name: 曲织地形
items.expectedDescription:
You materialize terrain features from another reality within your quantum field. Choose one of the following effects, which lasts as long as your quantum field remains active, until you cast warp terrain again, or until you dismiss this spell.

  • You cause the area of your quantum field to become difficult terrain. You determine the appearance of the warped terrain. You and your allies can move through the warped terrain normally and can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover} using its features.
  • You suppress terrain in your field, turning any existing difficult or greater difficult terrain in your quantum field to normal terrain. This does not apply to effects that cause a creature to count squares as difficult terrain (such as a solarian's graviton-attunement attacks). If you're attempting to suppress terrain created by a spell or other magical effect, you must successfully counteract the effect.

Heightened (3rd) You can choose to have the quantum field fill with fog, smoke, or another phenomenon that obscures vision. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}. You can instead suppress one of these effects within your quantum field.

Heightened (6th) You can choose to have the quantum field become greater difficult terrain, or suppress greater difficult terrain.
items.description:
你自另一现实中具现覆写量子场域中的地形特征。从以下效果中选择一项，只要你的量子场域保持激活，它就会一直持续，直到你再次施放曲织地形或者将其解消：

  • 你使量子场域中变为困难地形。你可以决定曲织地形的外观。你和你的盟友可以正常通过曲织地形，并可以利用其地形特征来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]
  • 你抚平场域中的地形，将其中存在的任何困难地形或高等困难地形变为普通地形。这不适用于那些令一个生物将方格视为困难地形的效果（例如恒星武士的引力子调谐攻击）。如果你试图抚平由法术制造的地形或其他魔法效果，你必须成功反制这些效果。

升阶（3环）你可以选择令量子场域中填满雾气、烟尘或其他阻碍视觉的现象。这一效果等同@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]。你也可以转而尝试反制量子场域中的一个类似效果。

升阶（6环）你可以选择让量子场域变为高等困难地形而非困难地形。

items.name: 天生野望
items.expectedDescription: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field. You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class. You must meet the prerequisites, but you can select the feat later in the character creation process in order to determine which prerequisites you meet.
items.description: 你从小就壮志勃勃，并且为了出人头地一直在努力奋斗，这让你在你所选择的职业领域上的进步卓越。你获得你自身职业的一个1级职业专长。你必须满足先决条件，但可以在创建角色的过程中稍后再选择此专长，以确认自己满足哪些先决条件。

items.name: 锚定打击
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements Your quantum field is active.

Battle can be disorienting, but for you, the intense mental effort of striking your targets lends you additional clarity and focus. Make a Strike. The Strike gains the following success and critical success effects.

Critical Success The Strike gains the anchoring trait. You can reroll the damage dice rolled for this strike, but you must use the second result, even if it's worse.

Success The Strike gains the anchoring trait.
items.description:
需求你的量子场域激活

战斗可能会让人迷失，但对你来说，击中目标的强烈精神反馈会让你更加清晰和专注。进行一次打击，这次打击获得以下的成功和大成功效果。 大成功 这次打击获得锚定特征。你可以为此次打击重骰伤害骰，但你必须使用新的结果，即便它更差。 成功 这次打击获得锚定特征。

大成功该打击获得锚定特征。你可以重骰此打击的伤害骰，但必须使用第二次结果，即使更差。

成功该打击获得锚定特征。

items.name: 独立法阵
items.expectedDescription: You can cast spells directly into your quantum field. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.E7HvICcH9CRAVzGc] action.
items.description: 你可以直接向量子场域施展法术。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.E7HvICcH9CRAVzGc]动作。

items.name: 独立法阵
items.expectedDescription: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase the spell's range to 100 feet. That spell only affects targets inside your quantum field, and the area of the spell doesn't extend beyond your quantum field.
items.description: 如果你的下个动作是施展一个具有射程的法术，则将这个法术的射程提升至100尺。该法术只影响你量子场域内的目标，并且法术的区域不会延伸到你的量子场域之外。

items.name: 标志性法术
items.expectedDescription: You've learned to cast some of your spells more flexibly, granting you extra control over your spellcasting. For each spell rank you have access to, choose one spell of that rank to be a signature spell. You don't need to learn heightened versions of signature spells separately; instead, you can heighten these spells freely. If you've learned a signature spell at a higher level than its minimum, you can also cast all its lower-rank versions without learning those separately. If you swap out a signature spell, you can choose a replacement signature spell of the same spell rank at which you learned the previous spell. You can also retrain specifically to change a signature spell to a different spell of that rank without swapping any spells; this takes as much time as retraining a spell normally does.
items.description: 你学会了更灵活地施放部分法术，赋予你对施法的额外控制力。从每个你获得的法术环级上选择一个该等级的法术作为你的标志性法术。你不需要另外学习标志性法术的升阶版本；相反，你可以自由升阶这些法术。如果你学习了一个超过原本等级的标志性法术，你可以无需学习便施展这个法术的低级版本。如果你替换了标志性法术，你可以重新选择一个相同等级法术作为新的标志性法术。你还可以通过重训在不替换法术的情况下改变标志性法术，这会花费和通常重训法术相同的时间。

items.name: 曲织伤势
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger An enemy damages you.

Requirements An enemy or willing ally is in your quantum field.

Your reality shifts to partly overlap with another in which someone else was injured in your stead. You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering attack equal to half your level, and one enemy or willing ally in your quantum field takes damage of the same type equal to the amount of damage prevented this way, with a @Check[fortitude|against:witchwarper|basic] save against your class DC.
items.description:
触发一名敌人对你造成伤害。

需求一名敌人或自愿盟友处在你的量子场域内

你的现实与另一人部分重叠，让其代替你承受伤害。你获得对触发效果的所有伤害抗力，数值等于你等级的一半，而一名处在量子场域内的敌人或自愿盟友受到等同于你从中减免数值的同类型伤害，并进行一次基于你的职业DC的基础@Check[fortitude|against:witchwarper|basic]。

items.name: 保底（奥法）
items.expectedDescription:
Even in the worst circumstances, you can perform basic tasks. Choose a skill you're trained in. You can forgo rolling a skill check for that skill to instead receive a result of 10 + your proficiency bonus (do not apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, choose a different skill and gain the benefits for that skill.
items.description:
即使在最恶劣的条件下，你也能完成基本的任务。选择一项你受训的技能，你可以放弃为该技能的技能检定掷骰，改为获得等于10+你的熟练度加值的结果（不应用任何其它加值、减值或调整值）。

特殊 你可以多次选取本专长。每次选择不同的技能获得专长效果。

extraFields.expected: trained in at least one skill

items.name: 飞跑
items.expectedDescription: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
items.description: 你的脚步变得更快。你的速度提高5尺。

items.name: 保温织服
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.
items.description:
强化： 1

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普洛尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。

extraFields.expected: This device monitors your vital signs and automatically administers aid. When you have the dying condition while wearing this armor, the DC of your recovery checks is equal to 8 + your dying value (instead of 10 + your dying value).
extraFields.text: 该设备持续监测你的生命体征并自动施救。当你在穿戴此护甲时陷入濒死状态，你的复苏检定DC等于8+你的濒死值（而非10+你的濒死值）。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 跳跃术
items.expectedDescription:
Your legs surge with strength, ready to leap high and far. You jump 30 feet in any direction without touching the ground. You must land on a space of solid ground within 30 feet of you, or else you fall after using your next action.

Heightened (3rd) The range becomes touch, the target changes to one touched creature, and the duration becomes 1 minute, allowing the target to jump as described whenever it takes the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap} action.
items.description:
你的腿充满力量，以跳得更高更远。你向任何方向跳跃30尺且不会接触地面。你必须在30尺内的有坚实地面的空间上落地，否则你会在使用你下个动作后坠落。

升阶（3环） 该射程变为接触，目标变为一个接触到的生物，持续时间变为1分钟，目标每次进行@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}动作时，都能按上述方式跳跃。

items.name: 腐蚀转化
items.expectedDescription:
You launch a torrent of magical nanites that begin dissolving your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 3d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent acid damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 2d8, and the persistent acid damage increases by 1d6.
items.description:
你发射出一股魔法纳米粒子，开始溶解你的目标。对目标进行远程法术攻击检定。命中时，你会造成3d8酸蚀伤害加1d6持续酸蚀伤害。如果大成功，初始伤害加倍，但持续伤害不加倍。

升阶（+2）初始伤害增加2d8，持续酸蚀伤害增加1d6。

items.name: 解除魔法
items.expectedDescription: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
items.description: 你干扰法术或者效果中的魔法力量。尝试一次反制检定，对抗目标。如果你成功对抗一个魔法物品，该物品成为该类型的普通物品，持续10分钟。这不会改变物体的非魔法性质。如果目标是一件神器或者类似的物品，你自动失败。

items.name: 抵抗能量伤害
items.expectedDescription:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.
items.description:
元素护盾保护一个生物免受某一种类型能量的伤害。选择酸蚀，寒冷，电击，火焰或者音波伤害。目标和其装备获得对你所选择伤害类型的抗力5。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{法术效果：抵抗能量伤害}

升阶（4环） 该抗力增加到10，并且你能以至多两个生物为目标。

升阶（7环） 该抗力增加到15，并且你能以至多五个生物为目标。

items.name: 趴爪族
items.expectedDescription: Pahtras are a humanoid feline species from a nearby star system. They're highly competitive and known for their achievements in magic, music, and war. Their home world was recently freed from the Veskarium's occupation, and they've joined the Pact Worlds.
items.description: 趴爪族是来自邻近恒星系的猫科类人生物。他们好胜心强，以魔法、音乐与战争领域的成就闻名。他们的母星最近摆脱了维斯卡里姆的占领，加入了协约世界。

items.name: 梅耶尔选民趴爪
items.expectedDescription: You have an undeniable streak of luck that you believe is a blessing from your ancestral god Meyel. You might come from a long line of mystics. Perhaps you were born at a holy site on Pulonis, or you reached out in fervent prayer at a time of crisis. Most of Meyel's chosen can point to at least one past event when their goddess might have intervened to save them from death or some other awful fate. Whether metaphorically or literally, you always seem to land on your feet. The first time each day that you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll the saving throw as a free action; this is a fortune effect.
items.description: 你有一股无法否认的好运气，你相信这是来自先祖之神梅耶尔的祝福。你可能出身于秘术师世家，可能出生在普洛尼斯上的一个圣地，也可能只是在危机时刻虔诚地祈祷。大多数梅耶尔的选民至少都能说出一件往事，那就是他们的女神曾经出手将他们从死亡或其他可怕的命运中拯救出来。无论是比喻义上还是字面意义上，你似乎总能“站稳脚跟”。每天第一次在豁免检定中大失败时，你可以使用一个自由动作立即重新进行一次豁免检定；这是一个幸运效果。

items.name: 偶像
items.expectedDescription:
Everybody wants their 15 minutes of fame, but for you, it's somehow become a lifestyle. Whether by luck or dedication, you're a star performer, celebrity, or popular influencer. Your face, voice, and style are commodities across known space, but for every adoring fan, there's a hater spreading gossip or paparazzi looking to capture your flaws.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Media Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.
items.description:
人人都想出名15分钟，但对你来说，这似乎已成为一种生活方式。无论是运气还是努力，你是一个出色的表演者、名人或受欢迎的影响者。你的面容、声音和风格是整个已知空间的商品，虽然崇拜你的粉丝很多，但是传播流言蜚语的黑粉以及试图挖你黑料的狗仔也同样多。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是体质或魅力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的表演技能和媒体学识（Media Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]（Impressive Performance）技能专长。

items.name: 动人表演
items.expectedDescription: Your performances inspire admiration and win you fans. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} using Performance instead of Diplomacy. If you spend at least 10 minutes performing in front of an audience, you can Make an Impression targeting up to 10 members of the audience who were there for the whole performance, without taking the normal penalty. The number of targets increases to 20 for a 1-hour performance and 50 for a 2-hour performance.
items.description: 你的表演令人钦佩，为你赢得粉丝。你可以使用表演代替交涉来@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}。如果你在观众面前表演至少10分钟，就可以对完整观看了整场表演的至多10名观众建立印象，而不承受通常的减值。表演持续1小时时，目标数量增加至20名；持续2小时时，增加至50名。

items.name: 恒星武士
items.expectedDescription: You're a conduit for the stellar forces of the cosmos—a solar knight. The powers of gravity and light represent the extremes of these forces, and you can attune yourself between them. As an agent of this cycle, you manifest an array of solar equipment and use your own connection to stellar forces to empower them. Regardless of which extreme of the stellar spectrum you prefer, you can change your attunement between them to take advantage of solar powers earned through meditation and practice.
items.description: 你是传导宇宙星辰之力的媒介——一名恒星骑士。引力与光代表这些力量的两极，而你可以在二者之间调整自身的调谐。作为这一循环的代行者，你显现出一系列恒星武装，并利用自身与星辰之力的联系来强化它们。无论你偏爱恒星光谱的哪一极，你都可以在二者之间改变调谐，运用通过冥想和练习获得的恒星之力。

items.name: 恒星显象
items.expectedDescription:
Your deep understanding of the stellar forces of the universe manifests in a variety of tangible ways. You can create and maintain three different manifestations: a solar flare, solar nimbus, and solar weapon. Your manifestations temporarily vanish if you become unattuned.

Solar Flare

A small mote of solar power hovers nearby or appears embedded on some part of your body, such as the palm of your hand or on your face. This mote can unleash a directed blast of energy at short range. Your solar flare is a martial ranged weapon in the brawling weapon group with the attuned and solarian traits. It doesn't take up a hand and doesn't need to be held to be wielded. Your solar flare can't be targeted by other creatures or removed from your person, except for when you become unattuned. Your attunement determines the damage type and range increment of your solar flare. You add your Strength modifier to damage rolls with your solar flare. You can improve the damage of your solar flare with solarian crystals.

Graviton-Attuned 1d8 bludgeoning, range increment 15 feet. On a critical success, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} the target as a free action, ignoring range and multiple attack penalty, even if you don't have a free hand.

Photon-Attuned 1d6 fire, range increment 30 feet. On a critical success, the target additionally takes 1d6 persistent fire damage.

Solar Nimbus

A layer of stellar energy surrounds you, overlaying your body or worn armor. It appears as a layer of glowing light or solid darkness, depending on your current state of attunement. The general appearance and shape of the nimbus is your choice and could appear as a lattice of energy surrounding you or imposing spiked energy armor layered atop your existing equipment. This design has no impact on its function and doesn't provide any additional bonuses.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm] reaction.

Solar Weapon

Through sheer will, you call forth a tangible weapon forged from the essence of stars. This weapon is an extension of yourself, and you can change its form with meditation. When manifesting your weapon, it appears in a free hand of your choice. If it has the free-hand trait, it can manifest in any hand. Your solar weapon is a martial melee weapon. It deals 1d8 of your choice of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage with the attuned and solarian traits.

At first level, choose up to two of the following traits for your weapon. Alternatively, you can select the reach or two-hand 1d10 trait for your weapon instead of selecting two of the following traits.

  • Disarm
  • Free-Hand
  • Grapple
  • Nonlethal
  • Parry
  • Shove
  • Sweep
  • Trip
  • Versatile (B/P/S only)
  • Reach (counts as two traits)
  • Two-Hand 1d10 (counts as two traits)

You can select one of the following weapon groups for your weapon to be a part of.

  • Axe
  • Brawling
  • Club
  • Flail
  • Hammer
  • Knife
  • Pick
  • Polearm
  • Spear
  • Sword

Your solar weapon gains additional benefits based on your current attunement.

Graviton-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature using your solar weapon, that creature's space and all squares adjacent to it are difficult terrain for that creature until the end of its next turn.

Photon-Attuned When you successfully Strike a creature with your solar weapon, you deal an additional amount of fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up). Your solar weapon casts bright light in a 5-foot radius (and dim light for the next 5 feet).

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.uvtdqSfKD6oXNA29]
items.description:
你对宇宙中的星辰之力的深刻理解能够通过具象的形式显现出来。你可以创造并维持所有三种不同的现象恒星显象：恒星耀斑，恒星光晕亦或是恒星武器。当你变为未调谐时，你的恒星显象会暂时消失。

恒星耀斑

一粒微小的恒星能量微粒悬浮在你身边，或沁入在你身体个部位，例如手或脸。这粒微粒能在短距离内释放定向能量冲击。你的恒星耀斑是一件搏击武器组的军用远程武器，具有调谐与恒星武士特征。它不占手，无需持握或持用。其他生物无法以你的恒星耀斑为目标，也无法将其从你身上移除，除了你变为未调谐状态。你的调谐状态决定你恒星耀斑的伤害类型与射程增量。你可将力量调整值加到你恒星耀斑的伤害掷骰上。你可以使用恒星武士水晶来提升恒星耀斑的伤害。

引力子调谐1d8钝击，射程增量15尺。重击时，你可以用自由动作尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]目标，忽略射程与多重攻击减值，即便你没有空手。

光量子调谐1d6火焰，射程增量30尺。重击时，目标额外受到1d6点持续火焰伤害。

恒星光晕

一层星辰能量环绕着你，复盖在你的躯体或穿戴的护甲之上。它呈现为一层散发的亮光或凝固的暗影，取决于你当前的调谐状态。光晕的整体外观与形态可由你自由选择，既可化作环绕周身的能量网格，亦可化作覆盖现有装备的带尖能量护甲。此类设计不影响其功能，亦不提供额外加成。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.q7UDeO9Ko1EbPRWm]反应动作。

恒星武器

凭着纯粹的意志，你召唤出一把由星辰本源锻造的有形武器。此武器是你自身的延伸，可通过冥想改变其形态。当显化武器时，它会出现在你选择的空手中。如果该武器具有不占手特征，则可显化于任意手中。你的恒星武器是一件军用近战武器。它能根据你的选择造成1d8点钝击，穿刺或挥砍伤害，并具有调谐和恒星武士特征。

第一级时，为你的武器选择至多两项下列特征。或者，你可以为你的武器选择长触及或双手1d10特征替代选择两项下列特征。

  • 卸武
  • 不占手
  • 擒拿
  • 非致命
  • 格挡
  • 推撞
  • 横扫
  • 摔绊
  • 多用（仅限B/P/S）
  • 长触及（算作两项特征）
  • 双手1d10（算作两项特征）

你可以选择你的武器属于以下哪一个武器组。

  • 斧
  • 搏击
  • 棍棒
  • 连枷
  • 锤
  • 短刃
  • 镐
  • 长武
  • 矛
  • 剑

你的恒星武器根据你当前的调谐状态获得额外增益。

引力子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，该生物所处空间以及所有与它相邻的方格，对该生物变为困难地形，直至其下个回合结束。

光量子调谐当你使用恒星武器成功打击一个生物时，你额外造成等同于你等级一半的火焰伤害（向上取整）。你的恒星武器在5尺半径内散发出明亮光照（在此后5尺内散发昏暗光照）。

items.name: 星辰调谐
items.expectedDescription:
As a solarian, your existence cycles between the aspects of stars. You begin with two aspects: photon (the power of stars to emit heat, light, and plasma) and graviton (the power of stars to attract and imprison objects through gravity). At any time, you're considered graviton-attuned, photon-attuned, or unattuned. Many of your abilities have additional effects based on your current attunement, and some abilities swap your current state of attunement to another state.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] action.
items.description:
作为一名恒星武士，星辰面相间的循环决定了你的存在。你初始拥有两种面相：光量子（photon，星辰散发出热量、光以及等离子体的力量）或引力子（graviton，星辰通过引力吸引和束缚物体的力量）。在任何情况下，你都处在引力子调谐、光量子调谐、或未调谐三种情况之一。你的许多能力都会根据你的当前调谐产生额外的效果，而有些能力则会将你的当前调谐转变成另一种情况。

你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]动作。

items.name: 光晕涌动
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your nimbus surges with energy, forcing an opening in your foe's defenses. Make a melee Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

Graviton-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn.

Photon-Attuned If the Strike is a critical success, the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian] save against your class DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the start of its turn.
items.description:
触发 你触及范围内的一个生物使用操作或移动动作，进行远程攻击，或者使用移动动作时离开一个方格。

你的光晕迸发能量，强行撕开敌人的防御。对触发生物进行一次近战打击。这次打击不计入你的多重攻击减值，你的多重攻击减值也不应用于此次打击。

引力子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{力竭1}，直到其回合结束。

光量子调谐 若此次打击造成重击，目标必须通过一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian]豁免，对抗你的职业DC，否则陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{笨拙1}，直到其回合开始。

items.name: 重铸恒星武器
items.expectedDescription:
You spend 10 minutes focusing on the composition of your solar weapon. You can change your solar weapon's damage type (typically choosing between bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing), selected traits, and weapon group. Your weapon maintains your selections until the next time you Re-Forge Solar Weapon.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.UlFxEP3YrbseKA62]
items.description:
你花费10分钟的时间专注于调整你恒星武器的构造。你可以更改武器的伤害类型（通常情况下在钝击、穿刺或挥砍之中选择），所选的武器特征，以及所属的武器组。恒星武器会始终保留你的选择，直至你下一次重铸恒星武器。

Frequency once per round

You steady your body and mind and attune yourself to the stellar aspect of your choice. You become attuned to photon or graviton. You can also manifest any of your solar manifestations if they're currently dormant and if you have the free hands to use them.

Special In addition to the above usage, you can also Attune as a free action when you roll initiative.

频率 每轮一次

稳定身心，与所选的星辰面相调谐一致。你变得与光量子或引力子调谐。你可以也选择显现你的恒星显象，只要它们当前处于休眠状态，且你有一只空手来使用它们。

特殊 除了上述用法外，你可以在掷骰先攻时，以自由动作使用调和。

items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.
items.description:

此手枪每次射击后都会自动抛出空弹壳，并装填新弹药。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 实光套装
items.expectedDescription:
Upgrades: 1

A projector fastened to a belt or lapel encases the wearer's body in this shimmering hardlight shell. Military-issue hardlight armor follows a predictable standard, but private users enjoy a range of customizable fashion options.
items.description:
强化： 1

固定在腰带或翻领上的投影器，用这层闪耀的硬光外壳包裹穿戴者的身体。军用制式硬光护甲遵循固定标准，而私人用户则能享用一系列可定制的时尚款式。

items.name: 商用型医疗贴片
items.expectedDescription:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

Medpatches accelerate the body's natural healing. You regain @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] Hit Points and gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]
items.description:
启动 1 （操作）

医疗贴加速身体的自然愈合。你恢复 @Damage[(1d6)[healing]] 生命值，并在对抗疾病和毒素的豁免中获得+1物品加值，持续10分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.VKSOvJQMwUby4fba]

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。

items.name: 星辰冲刺
items.expectedDescription:
You rush forward with a blast of stellar energy, getting into the thick of combat with ease. Stride twice. You gain a +10-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed during these moves.

Graviton-Attuned When you finish your Strides, enemies within 15 feet of you must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save against your class DC. On a failure, they're pulled directly toward you, ending in an adjacent square if possible. You select the order these enemies are moved.

Photon-Attuned When you finish your Strides, you create a photon field in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] centered on you. Until the start of your next turn, creatures outside the photon field are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to creatures inside the field.
items.description:
你在星辰能量的加持下冲刺向前，轻而易举地深入战场的中心。行走两次。在此次移动期间，你的速度获得+10尺环境加值。

引力子调谐当你完成行走时，你15尺内的敌人必须尝试一次@Check[fortitude|against:solarian|options:area-effect,forced-movement]以对抗你的职业DC。失败时，敌人会被直线拉向你，直至其到达与你相邻范围内的一个方格（如果可能的话）。你可以选择敌人被拉向你的先后顺序。

光量子调谐当你完成行走时，你在以自身为中心的@Template[type:burst|distance:15]创造一个光量子场。直至你的下个回合开始，光量子场外部的生物对光量子场内的生物视作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]。

items.name: 争胜之心
items.expectedDescription:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger An ally attempts a skill check with a skill that you have trained or better proficiency rank in.

You push yourself to be the best by competing with the triggering ally. Until the end of your next turn, you can attempt the same skill check to perform the same action or activity that the triggering ally performed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this skill check. If you achieve at least one degree of success higher than the triggering ally, this use of Competitive Spirit doesn't count toward its frequency. If you roll a critical failure on this skill check, you take a –1 circumstance penalty to all skill checks attempted with that skill for the next hour as you try new techniques to improve your future attempts.
items.description:
频率每小时一次

触发一名盟友尝试进行你拥有受训或更高熟练度的技能检定

你通过与盟友竞争来激励自己变得更优秀。在你下一个回合结束之前，你可以尝试与触发争胜之心的盟友进行相同的技能检定，并且在此次技能检定中获得+2环境加值。如果你的成功度比触发该能力的盟友高一级，那么这次争胜之心不计入使用次数。若你在此项技能检定中出现大失败，接下来一小时内，当你尝试用新技巧改进后续尝试时，该技能的所有检定都将受到-1环境减值。

items.name: 星辰韧性
items.expectedDescription: Stellar energy flows throughout your entire being like an unstoppable tidal wave, strengthening both body and mind. Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to expert. When you roll a success on a Fortitude or Will save against a mental or incapacitation effect, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI] as a free action.
items.description: 星辰能量如汹涌海潮般贯穿你的整个躯体，强化身心。你在强韧豁免上的熟练度提升至专家。当你在对抗心灵或失能效果的强韧或意志豁免上骰出成功结果时，你可以用自由动作进行@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.3xDhpvORBmK6AtcI]。

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 碎星冲击
items.expectedDescription:
You pour all your effort into making a single attack with your solar weapon that's so powerful it shatters the weapon. Strike with your solar weapon. The Strike deals one additional weapon damage die. Your solar weapon shatters and must be manifested to continue using it.

Graviton-Attuned On a hit, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to Speed until the start of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]

Photon-Attuned On a hit, you additionally deal persistent fire damage equal to half your level, rounded up.
items.description:
你使用恒星武器使出倾尽全力的一击，其威力之强竟让你的恒星武器粉碎。使用你的恒星武器进行一次打击。此次打击额外造成一颗武器伤害骰的伤害。此后，你的恒星武器碎裂开来，你必须重新显现才能继续使用它。

引力子调谐命中时，目标在速度上承受-10尺状态减值，直到你的下个回合开始。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.Ll3uZdiSqaszP3fn]

光量子调谐命中时，你对目标额外造成等同于你等级一半的持续火焰伤害，向上取整。

items.name: 飞跑
items.expectedDescription: You move more quickly on foot. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
items.description: 你的脚步变得更快。你的速度提高5尺。

items.name: 轻身落
items.expectedDescription: Your catlike aerial acrobatics allow you to cushion your falls. Treat falls as 10 feet shorter. If you're an expert in Acrobatics, treat falls as 25 feet shorter and 50 feet if you're a master. If you're legendary in Acrobatics, you always land on your feet and don't take damage, regardless of the distance of the fall.
items.description: 模仿自猫的高空特技动作让你能够缓冲坠落的损伤。将坠落距离视为缩短10尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到专家，将坠落距离视为缩短25尺，达到大师后，缩短50尺。若你在特技技能上的熟练度达到传奇，无论坠落距离多高，你始终能够以脚着地，不会受到任何伤害。

items.name: 磁力靴
items.expectedDescription: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. While active, they grant you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb metal surfaces as well as a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you when you're standing on a metal surface. In areas of zero gravity, while wearing a pair of magboots, you can move your Speed across metal surfaces and don't gain the untethered condition.
items.description: 磁力靴可以用一个交互动作启动或关闭。激活时，它们使你在用于攀爬金属表面的运动检定上获得+1物品加值；站在金属表面上时，你对抗以下检定的强韧DC或反射DC还会获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊} 你（当你站在金属表面上时）。在零重力区域内，穿戴一双磁力靴时，你可以沿金属表面移动至多你的速度，且不会获得失重状态。

items.name: 便携式放大器
items.expectedDescription: This small device is typically synced up to an instrument, microphone, or the audio playback on a datapad. It amplifies the audio volume, reducing the DC of Perception checks to hear the audio by 5.
items.description: 这款小型设备通常同步连接至乐器，麦克风或数据板的音频播放器上。其能放大音频音量，将听到音频的察觉检定的DC降低5点。

items.name: 商用型太阳镜
items.expectedDescription: Sunshades make everyone look cooler.
items.description: 太阳镜让任何人都显得更酷。

items.name: +1武器潜能水晶（恒星耀斑）
items.expectedDescription: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
items.description: 此物品将模拟恒星活动所需的专注凝为晶体。恒星武器或恒星耀斑的攻击检定获得+1物品加值，且该武器或耀斑可以从一颗轨道水晶中受益。

items.name: +1武器潜能水晶（恒星武器）
items.expectedDescription: This item crystallizes the focus needed to replicate the actions of a star. Attack rolls with the solar weapon or flare gain a +1 item bonus, and the weapon or flare can benefit from one orbital crystal.
items.description: 此物品将模拟恒星活动所需的专注凝为晶体。恒星武器或恒星耀斑的攻击检定获得+1物品加值，且该武器或耀斑可以从一颗轨道水晶中受益。

items.name: 恒星武士武器专家
items.expectedDescription: Your connection to stellar forces make your weapons lethal. Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons, martial weapons, and unarmed attacks increase to expert. Whenever you get a critical hit with your solar flare or solar weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.
items.description: 你与星辰力量的联结令你的武器致命无比。你在简易武器、军用武器以及无武装攻击上的熟练度提升至专家。你使用你的恒星耀斑或恒星武器造成重击时，你获得其重击专精效果。

items.name: 光晕结界
items.expectedDescription:
Trigger You would be damage by an attack, spell, or other effect.

Requirements You're aware of the triggering effect and not offguard.

You harness your solar nimbus to protect yourself from harm. You gain resistance equal to half your level (rounded up) until the start of your next turn. You choose the type of resistance when you use this action, depending on your current attunement.

You can use Nimbus Ward as a reaction only when the requirements and trigger are met, but you can use it as a 1-action activity without the requirements or trigger being met.

Graviton-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of damage: bludgeoning, force, piercing, or slashing.

Photon-Attuned Your resistance can be one of the following types of energy damage: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.
items.description:
触发你将要被一次攻击，法术或其他效果伤害。

需求你能够意识到触发效果且没有措手不及。

你驾驭恒星光晕保护自身免受伤害。你获得等同于你等级一半（向上取整）的抗力，直到你的下个回合开始。你在使用此动作时，根据你当前的调谐状态选择抗力的类型。

你只能在需求与触发满足时，以反应动作使用光晕结界，但你可以将其作为1动作行动使用，而无需满足需求与触发。

引力子调谐你的抗力可以是下列伤害类型之一：钝击、力场、穿刺或挥砍。

光量子调谐你的抗力可以是下列能量伤害类型之一：酸蚀、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。

items.name: 战争眷恩
items.expectedDescription: You're an accomplished battledancer and warrior, blessed by seers, honed by ancestral tradition, and capable of feats beyond the natural abilities of your peers. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{Tailwind} as a 1st-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day.
items.description: 你是技艺精湛的战舞者与战士，得到先知祝福，受祖传技艺磨砺，能作出超越同族天生能力的壮举。你获得@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KcLVELhCUcKXxiKE]{顺风奔行}，作为1环原能内在法术，每日可以施放一次。

items.name: 战斗攀爬
items.expectedDescription: Your techniques allow you to fight as you climb. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while Climbing and can Climb with a hand occupied. You must still use another hand and both legs to Climb.
items.description: 你拥有一边攀爬一边战斗的技术。你在攀爬期间不会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}，并且能够在一只手被占用的情况下攀爬。你在攀爬时仍然必须用上另一只手和双腿。

items.name: 星辰感官
items.expectedDescription: Your careful training and honed senses give you increased awareness of your surroundings. Your proficiency rank for Perception increases to master. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls, making you faster to react during combat. This bonus increases to +3 if you have the Incredible Initiative general feat.
items.description: 你经过精心训练且敏锐的感官使你对周围环境的感知力大幅提升。你在察觉上的熟练度提升至大师。此外，你在先攻掷骰上获得+2环境加值，使你在战斗中反应更迅速。如果你同时还具有惊奇先攻通用专长，则该加值提升至+3。

items.name: 武器专精
items.expectedDescription:
Envoy, Operative, Witchwarper You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 damage if you're a master, and 4 damage if you're legendary.

Mystic You've learned to protect yourself and your allies with your weapons. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master and 4 if you're legendary.

Solarian You've learned how to inflict greater injuries with the weapons you've practiced with most. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master, and 4 if you're legendary.

Soldier You inflict greater injuries with the weapons you know best. You deal 2 additional damage with weapons and unarmed attacks in which you're an expert. This damage increases to 3 if you're a master, and 4 if you're legendary.
items.description:
使节、特工、织维巫师你学会了用自己最熟悉的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

秘术师你学会了用武器保护自己和盟友。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

恒星武士你学会了用自己最常练习的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

士兵你用最熟悉的武器造成更严重的创伤。使用具有专家熟练度的武器或无武装攻击时，你额外造成2点伤害。大师熟练度时，此伤害提高至3点；传奇熟练度时，提高至4点。

items.name: 强击水晶（商用型）（恒星耀斑）
items.expectedDescription: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.
items.description: 此宝石含有恒星的凝聚物质，将恒星武器或耀斑的武器伤害骰从一枚增加为两枚。

items.name: 强击水晶（商用型）（恒星武器）
items.expectedDescription: This gem contains the condensed matter of a star and increases the weapon damage dice of a solar weapon or flare to two instead of one.
items.description: 此宝石含有恒星的凝聚物质，将恒星武器或耀斑的武器伤害骰从一枚增加为两枚。

items.name: 恒星弹幕
items.expectedDescription: You can fire off multiple shots with your solar flare in short succession. Make three solar flare Strikes against different targets, each with a –2 circumstance penalty. These attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after you've made the attacks.
items.description: 你能够在短时间内迅速发射多枚太阳耀斑。对不同目标进行三次恒星耀斑打击，每次承受-2环境减值。这些攻击记入你的多重攻击减值，但直到你完成所有攻击后减值才会增加。

items.name: 迅速跳跃
items.expectedDescription: You can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump} as a single action instead of 2 actions. If you do, you don't perform the initial Stride (nor do you fail if you don't Stride 10 feet).
items.description: 你能够以单动作而非2个动作@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{跳高}和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{跳远}。若如此做，你无需先行走，也不会因未行走10尺而失败。

items.name: 鲤鱼打挺
items.expectedDescription: You stand up. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
items.description: 你起身。这个移动不会触发反应。

items.name: 仿生人
items.expectedDescription: Androids first emerged as synthetic beings crafted by many technologically advanced civilizations throughout the galaxy. The first androids were created by humanoid peoples in their own images, but after the technology that animated the living constructs spread, androids began displaying a fantastic diversity of forms. Androids in the Pact Worlds were originally designed as servants, but today androids and other robotic beings stand as equals to organic ancestries under the Pact. Some androids have formed their own independent communities, while most integrate seamlessly into Pact Worlds societies. Unlike many other technological constructs, androids are more than intricate synthetic organs and complex programming, and each possesses their own soul.
items.description: 仿生人最初是星系中许多科技发达的文明制造的合成生命。最早的仿生人是类人生物按照自身形象创造的，但随着赋予这些活体构装体生命的技术传播开来，仿生人也开始呈现出千姿百态的形貌。协约世界的仿生人最初被设计为仆役，但如今，根据协约，仿生人与其他机器人生命已与有机族裔享有平等地位。一些仿生人建立了独立的社群，大多数则顺利融入协约世界的社会。与许多其他科技构装体不同，仿生人并不只是精密的合成器官与复杂的程序；每个仿生人都拥有自己的灵魂。

items.name: 构装体
items.expectedDescription: Your synthetic body resists ailments better than those of purely biological organisms. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against diseases, poisons, and radiation.
items.description: 你的人造身体比单纯的生物机体更能抵抗疾患。你对疾病、毒素和辐射的豁免检定获得+1环境加值。

items.name: 改造狂热派仿生人
items.expectedDescription: You or your previous iterations have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades, enabling you to personally customize your body and its capabilities. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that you can use to install armor upgrades and that doesn't count toward your armor's total number of upgrades. You can install and uninstall armor upgrades into your personal upgrade slot using the Install Upgrade activity. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this armor upgrade already installed in your upgrade slot (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting upgrade).
items.description: 你或你前一次迭代已将你的身体兼容了护甲强化，可以让你自定义自己的身体和其功能。你的身体有一个护甲强化槽位。你可以使用安装强化模块（Install Upgrade）行动来安装或卸载护甲强化模块到你的强化模块槽位上。选择一项1级或以下物品等级的常见护甲强化模块。你初始时已在强化模块槽位上安装有此护甲强化模块（你不需要支付信用点来购买此初始强化模块）。

items.name: 黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets. The open networks known as infospheres are your home and the place you can do your best work. You're highly competent when it comes to cracking code or accessing secure data.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Computers skill and the Infosphere Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9] skill feat.
items.description:
你一直对计算机和虚拟空间很有天赋，并努力学习技术秘密。被称为信息圈的开放网络是你的家，也是你大展身手的地方。无论是破解代码还是访问加密数据，你都游刃有余。

选择两项属性提升。一项必须是敏捷或智力，另一项为自选属性提升。

你的计算机技能和信息圈学识（Infosphere Lore）受训。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]（Phreaker）技能专长。

items.name: 电话黑客
items.expectedDescription:
You've learned how to hack using alternative methods. You can use Computers to Disable a Device or Hack a system using any computer, comm unit, or terminal instead of a hacking toolkit. If you're an expert in Computers and the equipment you use is at least 3rd level, you gain a +1 item bonus to Disable a Device or Hack.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4] or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf] skill feat, you can use this feat to Combat Hack or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} without a hacking toolkit.
items.description:
你学会了以其他方法骇入。你可以用任意计算机、通讯器或终端，使用计算机技能解除装置或骇入系统，无需骇客工具包。如果你在计算机达到专家，且所用设备至少为3级，则你解除装置或骇入的检定获得+1物品加值。

特殊如果你具有@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]或@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]技能专长，就可以使用此专长，在没有骇客工具包的情况下进行战斗骇入或@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{分神}。

items.name: 特工
items.expectedDescription: You're a focused, quick-witted professional who thrives in high-stakes combat. Your deadly aim and tactical training give you an edge over the competition—for you, even the most powerful enemy is just another mark to take out. You have impressive prowess in your chosen field of specialization.
items.description: 你是专注而机敏的专业人士，在生死攸关的战斗中如鱼得水。致命的瞄准技巧与战术训练使你在较量中占优——对你而言，即使最强大的敌人也只是另一个需要解决的目标。你在自己选择的专精领域中拥有非凡的造诣。

items.name: 神射手
items.expectedDescription: You can spot a target's weak points, letting you deal additional precision damage with most types of ranged weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] action.
items.description: 你能看穿目标的弱点，令你可以用大多数类型的远程武器造成额外精准伤害。你获得@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]动作。

Choose an operative's specialization. This specialization grants you training in one skill, a skill feat for that skill, and an exploit. At 9th level, you gain the enhanced exploit granted by your specialization. The specializations presented in this book are as follows.

items.name: 瞄准
items.expectedDescription:
Requirements You're wielding a ranged weapon that doesn't have the area trait.

You take careful aim at a single creature that you're aware of, designating it as your mark until your next turn. Your ranged Strikes against your mark using the required ranged weapon deal an additional 1d4 precision damage and reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 1. These benefits only apply if your mark is within your weapon's first range increment. You can only have one mark at a time.

As your operative level increases, so does your ability to Aim. Increase the number of dice for the precision damage by one at 5th, 11th, and 17th levels. At 11th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 2 rather than 1. At 17th level, you reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your mark gains from cover by 4 rather than 2.
items.description:
需求 你持用一把不带有区域特征的远程武器。

你仔细瞄准一个你能感知到的生物，直到你的下一回合前将其指定为你的标靶。你使用需求的远程武器对标靶生物进行的远程打击会造成额外1d4精准伤害，并将你标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低1。这些增益只会在标靶处于你武器的第一射程增量内时有效。你同一时间只能有一个标靶。

随着你的特工等级提升，你的瞄准技巧也得到改进。在5、11、17级时，精准伤害的伤害骰增加一个。11级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低2而非1。17级时，你将标靶从掩蔽中获得的环境AC加值降低4而非2。

items.name: 游击兵
items.expectedDescription:
You specialize in close-quarters missions that require you to operate in crowded or tight spaces, such as inside buildings or vehicles, down narrow alleys, or in busy downtown streets. Whether you're a mugger, bodyguard, assassin, or urban mercenary, you favor pistols and can use them efficiently in tight spaces. You're trained in Acrobatics. You gain a skill feat for Acrobatics.

Exploit: You're trained to fight in close combat using pistols. Your ranged Strikes with one-handed ranged weapons don't trigger reactions that are triggered by a ranged attack.

Enhanced Exploit: Your point-blank shots are particularly deadly. When you make a successful Strike against an adjacent enemy with a one-handed ranged weapon, you calculate the damage as if the lowest-rolled weapon damage die for the attack had the maximum result instead. At 17th level, the two lowest-rolled damage dice increase to the maximum result.
items.description:
你专精于在拥挤和狭窄的空间中执行近距离任务，如建筑物内部、载具内、狭窄的小巷和繁忙的商业街。无论你是抢劫犯、保镖、刺客还是城市雇佣兵，你偏爱手枪，并能在狭小空间内高效地使用它们。你在特技上受训，并获得一个特技技能专长。

秘技：你受到训练，在近距离冲突中使用手枪战斗。你使用单手远程武器的远程攻击不会触发因远程攻击而触发的反应。

进阶秘技：你的近距离射击格外致命。当你用单手远程武器对相邻敌人进行一次成功的打击时，你将掷出的最低的武器伤害骰视为最大值。在17级时，你将掷出的最低的两个伤害骰变为最大值。

items.name: 四平八稳
items.expectedDescription: You can keep your balance easily, even in adverse conditions. Whenever you roll a success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} action, you get a critical success instead. You're not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while attempting to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground.
items.description: 即使在恶劣的条件下，你也能轻易保持平衡。每当你检定成功地使用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{保持平衡}动作时，改为大成功。你在狭窄平面和不稳地面尝试保持平衡时不会陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。

items.name: 迅捷处理器
items.expectedDescription: You can quickly identify your surroundings, and you can use that information to your advantage while in the midst of danger or while in the process of piloting vehicles in hazardous situations. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks for initiative rolls and a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks for initiative rolls.
items.description: 你可以快速识别周围的环境，你可以使用该信息来在危险中或在危险情况驾驶车辆时获得优势。你在用于掷骰先攻的察觉检定上获得+1环境加值，在用于掷骰先攻的驾驶（Piloting）检定上获得+2环境加值。

items.name: 机动瞄准
items.expectedDescription: You're rarely still, and you've learned to reliably hit your targets even while moving. You Stride and then @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC] with a gun you're wielding.
items.description: 你极少处于静止状态，并学会了在移动时也能准确地击中目标。你行走，然后用你正持握的一把枪械@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.sLikawnrJJzHMYeC]。

items.name: 通讯单元
items.expectedDescription:
A personal comm unit is a pocket-sized device that combines a minor portable computer and a cellular communications device, allowing instantaneous wireless communication with other comm units in both audio- and text-based formats at planetary range. A personal comm unit also includes a calculator, a flashlight (emits bright light in a 5-foot radius around you and dim light in the next 5 feet), a browser that accesses any local infospheres, and several entertainment options (including games).

Personal comm units integrated into armor have some voice-activated capabilities; you can communicate with other comm units in audio-based formats and receive responses without needing a free hand, but typing a message, browsing the infosphere, or using an app requires the use of at least one hand.

Comm units that function at longer ranges aren't as portable; they include built-in generators that provide the necessary amount of power and rely on active Drift beacons to communicate. Short-term use of these units can be purchased in most major settlements.
items.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

items.name: 商用型力场护盾
items.expectedDescription:
Force fields absorb damage. A force field's Hit Points are based on its version. While your force field is active, any physical or energy damage you would take is applied to the force field's Hit Points first before being applied to your Hit Points (including temporary Hit Points). If you have a shield raised, your force field and shield both take damage. If damage from an attack or effect reduces the force field to 0 Hit Points, you take any excess damage, the force field deactivates, and it can't be activated again for 10 minutes. Force fields replenish the indicated number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of your turn while they're active.

If your force field is tactical or better, it also protects you from deadly blows. Each time you're critically hit while your force field is active, attempt a flat check against the listed DC. On a success, it becomes a normal hit.

The force field has 6 Hit Points and replenishes 2 Hit Points on your turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.7CtHz1DQcMXLafOS]{Effect: Force Field 6}

Activate—Raise Force Field 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect Your force field becomes active. It remains active for 1 minute or until it's reduced to 0 Hit Points.
items.description:
力场护盾能够吸收伤害，其生命值取决于型号。启用期间，你将承受的任何物理或能量伤害，都会先从力场护盾的生命值中扣除，再从你的生命值中扣除，包括临时生命值。如果你举着盾牌，力场护盾和盾牌都会受到伤害。如果一次攻击或效果的伤害使力场护盾降至0生命值，你承受溢出的伤害，力场护盾关闭，并在10分钟内无法再次启动。启用的力场护盾每轮在你的回合开始时恢复所列数量的生命值。

如果你的力场护盾是战术型或更高型号，它还能保护你免受致命打击。每当你在力场护盾启用期间受到重击时，尝试一次对抗所列DC的纯骰检定。成功时，此次重击变为普通命中。

此力场护盾具有6生命值，在你的回合恢复2生命值。

items.name: 信用棒
items.expectedDescription:
Most people in Starfinder keep their wealth on a protected item known as a credstick. These devices are often flat and roughly the size of a human finger. They range in dimensions and quality, but at the end of the day, they're just a means of conveniently carrying and spending money. Usage of these devices is determined by the owner, and a credstick can accept or spend funds with as simple an action as tapping it near a suitable banking device. When more rigorous security is necessary, they can require audio or biometric imprints in order to activate. Some advanced credsticks even have a magical component that might require a mental password or the recitation of a specific spell to access stored funds.

Credsticks aren't gateways to the entirety of one's wealth, and larger stores of credits are often kept secured in banks, personal vaults, or secure databases. Instead, a credstick is a safe and anonymous means of moving credits around without being traced. Adventurers and common citizens alike often keep a credstick on their person to handle any purchases they might be called upon to make, while also only keeping just enough credits on them that losing the credstick wouldn't result in bankruptcy.

Individuals in the Pact Worlds often carry credsticks, and other civilizations that interact with the Pact often turn local funds into credits and thus carry them to spend their converted currency. Sometimes a person might carry several credsticks, dedicating each one to a different use, or simply trading the stick away if they want to make a purchase of a predefined amount. If ever the number of credsticks on a person becomes too cumbersome, it's easy enough to move the funds between individual sticks and discard emptied sticks to save on space, however a credstick always has a negligible bulk.
items.description:
在《寻星者》中，大多数人将钱财存放在一种受到保护的物品里，称为信用棒。这些装置通常扁平，大小与人的手指相仿。它们的尺寸和品质各不相同，但归根结底，只是方便携带和花钱的工具。持有者可以决定这些装置的使用方式，信用棒只需靠近合适的银行设备轻触一下，就能收取或支付资金。需要更严格的安全措施时，信用棒可以要求语音或生物特征印记才能启用。有些先进的信用棒甚至含有魔法部件，可能要求心灵密码或吟诵特定法术，才能存取其中的资金。

信用棒并不提供存取一个人全部财富的途径；较大笔的信用点通常安全存放在银行、私人金库或安全数据库中。信用棒的作用，是让人能安全、匿名地转移信用点，而不留下可被追踪的痕迹。冒险者和普通市民常随身携带信用棒，以支付可能需要购买的东西；同时，他们只在其中存放适量信用点，以免丢失信用棒便导致破产。

协约世界的居民常携带信用棒；与协约世界来往的其他文明也常将当地货币换成信用点，因此也会携带信用棒，花费换来的货币。有时，一个人会携带多根信用棒，让每根各有用途，或在支付预定金额的交易时，直接把信用棒交给对方。若身上的信用棒多得不便携带，只需在各根信用棒间转移资金，再丢弃空棒，就能节省空间。不过，一根信用棒的负载始终可忽略。
